## “品牌已认证”服务

要开通“品牌已认证”服务，需同时满足以下条件：

- 品牌相关文件已通过审核并获得“已批准”状态；

- 商品或品牌的相关文件须为最新有效版本；

- 账户余额有足够资金。

“品牌已认证”服务费用为：每个品牌每天 500 卢布（含增值税），按服务提供当日的
[换算汇率](/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate/)
 计算。

当品牌下任一商品卡片上显示“品牌已认证”徽章，并可供购买时，视为“品牌已认证”服务已提供。

如果您销售的是热门品牌商品，且该品牌在市场上经常被仿冒，则展示徽章需要提供权利人文件。文件审核通过后，我们可免费展示徽章。如果您不是权利人，请缴纳
[保证金](/policies/product-rules-and-documents/documents/originality-confirmation/security-deposit/)
。

如发生以下任一情况，Ozon有权单方面暂停或终止“品牌已认证”服务：

- 出现涉嫌侵犯知识产权的情况；

- 品牌文件已过有效期和/或文件因复审未通过被拒；

- 账户连续3天出现欠款。

## “快速收集评价”服务

> > 条件自2026年6月1日起生效。
>

该工具帮助卖家收集商品评价。我们会通过商品精选集模块和向买家发送推送通知来推广商品。仅在收到评价或评分后收取服务费用。

服务费用按服务提供日期的俄罗斯联邦中央银行汇率计算，公式如下：

Х × S

其中：

- Х——报告期内收集到的评价和评分数量；

- S——固定出价，250卢布。

[了解服务条件详情](/work-with-customers/points-for-reviews/)

> > 相关规则自2026年4月6日起生效。
>

该工具可帮助卖家收集商品评价。您可以选择商品和评价类型：文本评价、带图片评价、带视频评价或详细评价。我们会为商品添加“留评获分”徽章，并通过精选商品集和向买家发送推送通知的方式进行推广。只有在收到所选类型的评价后，才会扣除相应出价。

服务费金额按照服务提供当日俄罗斯联邦中央银行汇率，按以下公式计算：

Х × S × 1,2

其中：

- Х——报告期内收集到的评价数量；

- S——在个人中心中填写的卢布出价金额；

- 1,2——出价系数。

[了解有关服务条款的更多信息](/work-with-customers/points-for-reviews/)

## “星星商品”服务

> > 条件自2026年6月1日起生效。
>

在忠诚度计划中，Ozon买家可以：

- 使用Ozon银行卡消费时累积星星，并将其兑换为特别精选中的您的商品，仅需1卢布。买家需另行支付关税。

- 使用Ozon银行信用卡支付您的商品，享受最长140天的免息期。

服务费率：每件商品卖家设定价格的1.5%，按合同约定的委托方货币，以客户下单日期为准。我们会统计服务有效期内下单，并在计算服务费用的报告期内完成销售的订单。此外，我们会向已接入“星星商品”忠诚度计划的卖家补偿商品费用：这些商品是买家从精选集中以1卢布购买的。

Ozon可以自动开通“星星商品”服务。

试用期：首次开通或自动接入时，前30个日历日不收取服务费。如果您在试用期结束前关闭服务，剩余天数不会失效，可在下次开通时使用。试用期结束后，我们将开始收取“星星商品”服务使用费。

[了解更多关于忠诚度计划的信息](/accounting/discounts-for-customers/star-goods/)

## “自动群发”服务

推送通知是在Ozon应用程序中弹出的消息。您可以在
**[买家 → 分发](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/crm/mailings?tab=auto)**
部分创建自动推送通知群发。选择发送群发所依据的买家行为，并设置月度预算。

预算是最大扣款金额。实际金额可能更低，取决于已发送通知的数量。当预算用完时，通知会停止发送，并在下个月恢复。

如果至少送达一条通知，我们会认为服务已提供。向一名接收人发送一条通知的资费为2卢布。货币换算按发送时的俄罗斯联邦中央银行汇率进行。

[关于自动群发的更多信息](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/work-with-customers/automated-notifications)

## “收集首批评价”服务

> > 可以从2026年7月15日起开通“收集首批评价”工具，但我们会在启动后7天才开始把您的商品推荐给顶级作者撰写评测，即从7月22日起。
>

该工具帮助卖家从顶级作者那里获得商品的详细评价。我们仅对非匿名的5星评价收费，评价需包含视频和不少于5个字符的文字。评价会发布在“评价动态流”中，并固定在商品卡片上。只有在没有“评价管理”或Premium Pro有效订阅的情况下，评价才会被固定；固定有效期为30天。仅在收到评价后收取服务费。

费用按卖家合同中的币种收取。应付金额以卢布计算，并按照商品下单日期的俄罗斯央行汇率换算，公式如下：

单条评价费用 = S + P + B

其中：

- S——固定出价，金额为300卢布；

- P——商品销售价格，已包含所有折扣和促销活动；

- B——买家使用的Ozon积分。

P + B的金额不得超过10,000卢布。

**

示例
**

购买时，商品销售价格在包含所有折扣和促销活动后为1000卢布。买家使用了已累积的Ozon积分——200卢布，实际支付800卢布。我们将对该条评价扣除：300 + 800 + 200 = 1300卢布。买家将获得1000卢布等值的积分。

折扣和试用期：2026年7月15日至2026年9月15日，单条评价的固定出价300卢布享受折扣。使用服务时，我们仅扣除可变部分——向顶级作者发放的积分数量，金额等于商品购买时已包含所有折扣和促销活动的卢布销售价格，但不超过10,000积分。

如果评价在发布后被修改、编辑或删除，费用不予退还。

[了解服务条款](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/work-with-customers/collecting-first-reviews/overview)

[积分折扣](/accounting/discounts-for-customers/discount-points/)
，并且佣金金额取决于销售模式和商品类目。

代理佣金金额不超过表中所示金额——不考虑

。

销售佣金适用于2025年12月1日起期间下单商品。在此日期之前下单的商品，则继续适用2025年11月1日至2025年11月30日期间的销售佣金规则。

销售佣金金额取决于卖家个人中心价格以及下单日的

- 5000卢布及以下——适用于商品售价在1501至5000卢布之间的情况。

- 超过5000卢布——适用于商品售价高于5000卢布的情况。

根据
[俄罗斯联邦法律](/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/?country=CN#2-list-of-prohibited-products)
及

## 关于折扣积分佣金的计算方式

> > 您个人中心中的商品价格与实际销售价格之间的差额将以积分形式发放。
> [有关折扣积分的详细信息](/accounting/discount-points)
>

当需要提高特定商品的销售量时，我们可以代表您设置折扣。 如果商品以折扣价购买，我们将以积分形式退还您的价格与销售价格之间的差额。1积分=1合同货币单位。

我们将扣除积分以支付佣金 —— 最高可达99%。积分只能在它们被积累的结算期内使用。它们不能转移到其他结算期。

为商品提供安全存储及定期盘点。

| 存储期限 | 费用

 USD/立方米/天 |
| --- | --- |
| 1–30 天 | 包含在标准操作费中 |
| 31–60 天 | 1 |
| 61–90 天 | 8 |
| 超过 91 天 | 16 |

存储天数按每一批商品自验收之日起单独计算。 商品按照 FIFO 原则发运——先验收的商品优先发运。

## 错误指数超标

我们将收取错误指数超标罚款。错误指数按最近 14 天计算，并每天重新计算一次。指数值会影响罚款金额。罚款的计费时间点为对订单信息进行修改的日期。对于每一笔因卖家主动取消或因卖家原因导致取消的订单，都会收取错误指数超标罚款。

罚款金额按计费时的
[汇率](/accounting/conversion-rate/)
计算，每笔订单最高不超过 1500 卢布。

| 错误指数区间 | 罚款金额 |
| --- | --- |
| 0–4%

绿色区域 | — |
| 4,01–10%

蓝色区域 | 取消订单中商品金额的 4,5%。 |
| 10,01–20%

黄色区域 | 取消订单中商品金额的 9%。 |
| 20,01–40%

橙色区域 | 取消订单中商品金额的 13,5%。 |
| 40,01–100%

红色区域 | 取消订单中商品金额的 13,5%。

 可能会封锁账号。

[了解更多关于封锁的信息](/ratings/cancellation-percentage/#封锁) |

罚款计费将在次日按计费当时的汇率反映在账单中。

[了解更多关于 realFBS 错误指数的信息](/ratings/cancellation-percentage/)

**

 realFBS 错误指数计算示例
**

今天是 5 月 10 日。错误指数将按 4 月 26 日至 5 月 9 日的周期计算。

在该周期内，您应发运 900 个货件，但取消了其中 45 个。

取消货件指数按公式计算：45 ÷ 900 = 5%。

[查看错误指数](/ratings/cancellation-percentage/#查看错误指数)

**计算示例**

5 月 9 日，您取消了 2 笔订单，订单金额分别为 5000 ¥ 和 300 ¥。

罚款比例为 4,5%。取消当日的汇率为：1 ¥ = 12 ₽。

- 计算订单金额的百分比：

订单 1：5000 ¥ × 4,5% = 225 ¥；
订单 2：300 ¥ × 4,5% = 13,5 ¥。
换算为卢布：

订单 1：225 × 12 = 2700 ₽；
订单 2：13,5 × 12 = 162 ₽。
适用上限，每笔订单不超过 1500 ₽：

订单 1：2700 ₽ > 1500 ₽ → 1500 ₽；
订单 2：162 ₽

订单 1：1500 ₽ ÷ 12 = 125 ¥；
订单 2：162 ₽ ÷ 12 = 13,5 ¥。
两笔订单合计罚款为：125 + 13,5 = 138,5 ¥。

模块中的支出项“其他服务与罚款”，其下的“罚款“子项。

## 在商品卡片中发布违规内容的罚款

如果您在商品卡片中发布违规内容，我们可能会处以罚款并隐藏该商品。每次罚款1000卢布。罚款将在次日按照扣款时的汇率进行换算。

违规内容包括：

- 商品卡片中的联系方式：电话号码、社交网络链接、网站、即时通讯工具、电子邮箱、卖家实际地址；

- 商品描述中引导联系的内容：通过联系方式联系、访问卖家网站或其他第三方网站进行购买或了解商品种类、引导解决与商品相关的问题；

- 提供销售
[被平台要约或俄罗斯联邦法律禁止销售](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/policies/product-rules-and-documents/product-rules/special-categories)
的商品。

在收到通知后24小时内，您可以删除商品中的违规内容；如果SKU尚未创建，也可以删除该商品。

在收到通知后7天内可对罚款提出异议：请向我们提交异议及相关证据，证明商品卡片符合平台要求。

## OGL费用

**OGL费用包括：**

- 开通Ozon物流平台的电子服务——按每件货件价值的2%收取，每件不低于15卢布，不高于200卢布。

- **OGL**
组织将货件国际运输至客户的
**服务费用**
根据Ozon货运代理确定的货件重量和体积特征数据确定，计算方式如下：

** **
资费的固定部分（
**fix**
）+ 取决于货件计费重量的资费变动部分（
**var**
）。
 资费由评分组确定，评分组取决于货件重量以及货件中商品的总价值（按创建订单时卖家个人中心中设定的价格*计算）。
** 如果货运代理OGL服务的币种与卖家币种不同，费用将按俄罗斯联邦中央银行在订单日期设定的交叉汇率换算为卖家币种。*

![ogl_cn_1](../../images/30bd2b82ae09230b.png)

[了解有关OGL服务费率与条款的更多信息，自2026年8月24日起](https://cdn.ozone.ru/s3/ozon-disk-api/Partner_Delivery/OGL_ENG_CN_24_08_26_added_Pick-up_1786697358.xlsx)

## 所用定义

货件价值——按创建订单时卖家个人中心中设定的价格计算的货件内商品总价值。

- 货件计费重量：

除
**Big**
和
**Premium Big外，**
所有组均使用Ozon货运代理确定的货件实际重量。
对于
**Big**
和
**Premium Big**
组，计费重量取实际重量与体积重量中的较大值，其中体积重量按公式（长 × 宽 × 高（厘米）/ 密度系数）计算，密度系数为12立方厘米/克。
[了解OGL服务详情](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/ogl/ogl-work-scheme)

## 向买家配送费用的计算示例

### 示例1

货件重量——80克

- 货件尺寸——10厘米 × 8厘米 × 5厘米

- 货件价格——60 CNY（673卢布，按创建订单当日的换算汇率11.2174计算）

- 评分组——Extra small

- 货件计费重量——80克

- 针对买家的配送费用：2.9 CNY + 0.0247 CNY * 80 =
**4.9 CNY**

### 示例2

- 货件重量——2200克

- 货件尺寸——100厘米 × 60厘米 × 6厘米

- 货件价格——435 CNY（4879卢布，按创建订单当日的换算汇率11.2174计算）

- 评分组——Big

- 货件计费重量——3000克（采用商品体积重量=100厘米 × 60厘米 × 6厘米 / 12）

- 针对买家的配送费用：34.82 CNY + 0.0164 CNY * 3000 =
**84.02 CNY**

丢失货物的赔偿根据申报价值和个别系数进行全部或部分赔偿，个别系数取决于服务类型和
**商品价格**
类别。

### 赔偿金额的计算

货位丢失的赔偿金额按以下公式计算：

- 对于未注明商品组成的OGL货位：

*[赔偿金额] = [卖家发运申请中所有商品的申报价值 / 卖家在个人中心中填写的货位数量] * [Light赔偿系数]*

丢失商品的赔偿根据以下公式进行全部或部分计算：

- 对于OGL：

- *[赔偿金额] =（[商品申报价值] × [OGL赔偿系数]）*

- 针对Aggregator：

*[赔偿金额] =（[商品申报价值] × [Aggregator赔偿系数]）*

- 针对FBP：

*[赔偿金额] =（[商品申报价值] × [FBP赔偿系数]）*

- 通过WHD仓库退货时：

*[赔偿金额] =（[商品申报价值] × [WHD赔偿系数]）*

不合格退货的赔偿金额按以下公式计算：

- 对于OGL：

*[赔偿金额] = ([商品申报价值] × [OGL赔偿系数] × [赔偿比例])*

- 针对Aggregator：

*[赔偿金额] = ([商品申报价值] × [Aggregator赔偿系数] × [赔偿比例])*

- 针对FBP：

*[赔偿金额] = ([商品申报价值] × [FBP赔偿系数] × [赔偿比例])*

- 通过WHD仓库退货时：

*[赔偿金额] = ([商品申报价值] × [WHD赔偿系数] × [赔偿比例])*

> > 申报价值是卖家在创建特定客户订单时设定并记录在个人中心的商品价值
>

### 系数是如何确定的？

赔偿系数根据卖家个人中心中商品的类目、类型和价格、订单日期的
[换算汇率](/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate)
以及所提供服务的类型，按照下表确定：

- 1500卢布以下（含）——适用于商品价格不超过1500卢布的情况；

- 5000卢布以下（含）——适用于商品价格在1500.01至5000卢布之间的情况；

- 5000卢布以上——适用于商品价格高于5000.01卢布的情况。

###  计算示例

订单取消60天后，卖家就OGL模式下丢失的货件联系客服申请赔偿。该货件包含一条裙子（申报价值25.54 USD）和一个包（价值1128.00 USD）。该货件在目的地国家运输过程中丢失。赔偿金额将按以下方式计算：

赔偿金额 = 25.54 USD*0.71 + 1128.00 USD*0.7 = 807.74 USD

[关于合同中赔偿金额的更多信息](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor#4-6-payment-of-compensations)

[关于索赔程序的更多信息](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor#4-9-applicable-law-and-dispute-resolution)

[下载赔偿系数表（XLSX）](https://cdn.ozone.ru/s3/ozon-disk-api/Partner_Delivery/Сompensation_coefficient_RU-CN_1786713265.xlsx)

## 退货、未认购及取消相关费用

* 文件：`markdown/commissions/ozon-fees/returns-expenses.md`
* 路径：`/commissions/ozon-fees/returns-expenses`

本文适用于发往俄罗斯联邦的订单。

| 退货类型 | 描述 |
| --- | --- |
| 取消 | • 订单在配送给买家前被取消。

 • 买家在订单保管期届满前未取货。

 • 买家在收到前拒收订单。 |
| 未认购 | 买家在取货点检查商品后，部分或全部拒收订单。已认购商品状态变更为“已签收”，未认购商品状态变更为“已取消”。 |
| 客户退货 | 买家提交已收货商品的退货申请，我们审核通过后，在取货点接收商品并向买家退款。 |

商品处理方式取决于Ozon的规则及您在个人中心的设置。

费用取决于退货发往何处：

- [通过WHD仓库发送退货](#通过whd仓库发送退货)
——使用Ozon配送服务；

- [退货发送到Ozon合作伙伴仓库](#FBP与realFBS取消、未认购及客户退货的其他服务费用)
——若指定了物流合作伙伴或退货服务商；

- [由Ozon销毁退货](#通过-whd-仓库进行商品销毁)
——若指定了Ozon销毁。

## 通过WHD仓库发送退货

对于取消、未认购、客户退货，Ozon组织退货商品的接收并将其发往仓库，以便在平台上进行转售。

若仓库发出的商品发生重复取消、未取货或客户退货，我们将安排将该商品发往仓库。

将商品发往仓库需同时满足以下所有条件：

- 您的
[发货至仓库](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/returns/rfbs/settings?fromRfbs=true)
设置可用且未关闭。

- 客户
[未对商品质量提出索赔](/fulfillment/rfbs/refunds/returns-3pl/?country=CN#质量合格商品的退货条件)
 ，且商品符合合格商品标准。若仓库收货时发现轻微瑕疵，例如包装损坏，该商品将进行减价处理。

[关于减价商品的更多信息](/products/price-reduction/)

- 商品可在仓库接收，且不属于
[禁售商品清单](/policies/product-rules-and-documents/product-rules/special-categories/)
。

- 按订单当日
[换算汇率](/accounting/conversion-rate/)
 计算，个人中心中的商品价格超过500卢布。

当取消或未取货商品送达仓库进行转售时，我们将按照已签收订单的标准收取
[Ozon合作配送费用](/commissions/ozon-fees/partner-delivery-rates/)
。

转售时将适用22%的增值税，Ozon将代您向俄罗斯联邦预算缴纳该税款。同时，面向买家的最终价格保持不变，而卖家实收价格将扣除相应税费的金额。

商品退回仓库时，Ozon提供一系列服务，每项服务单独计费。

| 服务 | 包含内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 逆向物流 | 接收取消、未认购、客户退货并将其发往仓库。 |
| 取消及未认购商品处理/Ozon退货处理 | 仓库收货及商品状态检查。 |
| 存储 | 仓库存放及存储，最长不超过120天。部分存储期限已包含在“物流”服务费率中。超出后——付费存储。 |
| 物流 | 再次下单时的拣货、包装、仓库分拣及运送至分拣中心。 |
| 非标准商品处理 | 搬运非标准商品时，在仓库使用特殊设备、多名员工、非标准托盘和运输固定装置。 |
| 配送至取货点 | 订单从分拣中心配送至客户取货点 —— 取货点、自助提货柜、邮局及其他地点。 |
| Ozon合作伙伴处理 | 合作伙伴在取货点接收重复未取货或退货。 |
| 销毁 | 商品销毁条件如下：

• 商品入库已满120天；

• 商品严重损坏或变质。 |

### 逆向物流

**自2026年5月6日起**

我们将收取取消、未认购或客户退货的接收、发往仓库及必要时进行商品状态检查的服务费用。

“取消及未认购商品处理”和“Ozon退货处理”服务费用已包含在逆向物流费用中。

逆向物流费率等同于服务提供时生效的“物流”服务费率。

服务提供时刻：退货入库仓库。

汇率换算：按俄罗斯联邦中央银行在服务提供时的汇率计算。

### 仓库存储

**自2026年5月6日起**

商品最长存放期限为120天。

每件商品在一定天数内不收取额外费用——相关费用已包含在“物流”服务费率中。

部分类目适用特殊费率。对于此类商品，我们在特定时期内延长免收额外费用的天数。

[免收费用存储期限（XLSX）](https://cdn.ozone.ru/s3/ozon-disk-api/Partner_Delivery/terms_of_placement_01_03_2026_1773823956.xlsx)

每日按每升商品收取费用，含增值税：

- 普通商品——每升每日2.50卢布；

- 超大货物——每升每日0.10卢布；

- 易燃商品——每升每日0.60卢布；

- 轮胎仓库商品——每升每日0.14卢布。

服务提供时刻：商品入库当日结束时。

汇率换算：按俄罗斯联邦中央银行在服务提供时的汇率计算。

| 商品类目 | 特征 |
| --- | --- |
| 超大货物 | • 长度：45–220厘米，

 • 宽度：45–220厘米，

 • 高度：32–80厘米，

 • 重量：最高120公斤 |
| 易燃商品 | 除
[仓库销售限制](/policies/product-rules-and-documents/product-rules/special-categories/?country=CN)
范围内的危险类目商品 |
| 普通商品 | 不属于上述类目的商品 |

若商品自收货之日起120天内未能转售，将发往
[销毁](#通过-whd-仓库进行商品销毁)
。

**存储期限计算**

免费存放期限自商品入库之日起计算——根据入库时的类目及条件确定。费率变更时，已存储商品的期限保持不变。

### 转售物流

**自2026年5月6日起**

物流费用包括拣货、包装、仓库内商品分拣、包装材料成本，以及从发运集群到目的集群的配送。

运输费率取决于体积及具体配送方向。

[下载费率表（XLSX）](https://cdn.ozone.ru/s3/ozon-disk-api/Partner_Delivery/Logistics_06_04_2026_1774594690.xlsx)

若因技术原因无法确定发运集群或目的集群，我们将根据商品体积按通用费率收费。

[关于集群的详细信息](/prices/regional-price/)

服务提供时刻：商品送达分拣中心。

汇率换算：按俄罗斯联邦中央银行在订单创建时的汇率计算。

[计算仓库商品体积](/fulfillment/fb-global/volume/)

### 非标准商品处理

> > 自2026年6月1日起生效。
>

该服务适用于搬运时需要使用特殊设备、多名员工、非标准托盘和运输固定装置的商品。这些商品包括：

- 重量超过25公斤的商品，

- 表格中列出的类目商品：

[下载非标准商品表格](https://cdn.ozone.ru/s3/ozon-disk-api/global-education/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/returns-expenses/non_standard_items_CHN_1779443737.xlsx)

服务费用为卖家在个人中心设置的商品价格的3%，但不超过280卢布，按订单日期的
[换算汇率](/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate/)
计算。

服务提供时间：商品配送至分拣中心。

### 配送至取货点

**自2026年5月6日起**

订单从目的集群的分拣中心配送至客户取货点：订单取货点、自助提货柜、邮局、买家地址或其他地点。

若服务由以下方提供：

- 执行者合作伙伴——我们将收取“合作伙伴配送至取货点”服务费用，该费用取决于合作伙伴的最终报酬，但不超过25卢布 (不含增值税)。 Ozon为吸引合作伙伴而支付的报酬已包含在销售报酬中。

- Ozon——我们将收取“Ozon配送至取货点”服务费用。服务费用为25卢布。适用于Ozon未能吸引执行者合作伙伴进行配送的情况。例如，航空配送、跨境配送或第三方承运商未覆盖的偏远地区配送。

汇率换算按俄罗斯联邦中央银行在订单创建时的汇率计算。

若发生取消、未认购或客户退货，我们将收取该服务费用。

### Ozon合作伙伴在取货点的处理服务

**自2026年5月6日起**

向取货点支付的费用，用于合作伙伴在取货点接收和处理重复未取货或客户退货。

费率：每件商品15卢布 (不含增值税)。

服务提供时刻：在取货点接收未认购或客户退货。

汇率换算：按俄罗斯联邦中央银行在服务提供时的汇率计算。

### 通过 WHD 仓库进行商品销毁

**自2026年5月6日起**

服务费用根据销毁原因按商品重量单独计算并收取。每公斤单价乘以商品重量 （精确至克），不进行四舍五入。

对于重量不足1公斤的商品，按1公斤费率计算。

销毁费用不得超过该服务的最高费用。

服务费率：

| 原因 | 每公斤费率，含增值税（卢布） | 服务最高费用，含增值税（卢布） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 退货及取消自动销毁 | 25 | 125 |
| 库存自动销毁 | 25 | 125 |
| 您订购的销毁服务 | 25 | 125 |
| 因包装而损坏 | 75 | 375 |
| 已损坏，曾位于买家处 | 25 | 125 |
| 禁售商品 | 75 | 375 |
| 保质期已过 | 75 | 375 |
| 因包装缘故而溢出/洒出 | 75 | 375 |

服务提供时刻：商品发往销毁时。

汇率换算：按俄罗斯联邦中央银行在服务提供时的汇率计算.

## 未认购及客户退货的其他服务费用

如果退货发往仓库不适用或您已禁用该选项，我们将执行：

- 商品销毁；

- 通过物流合作伙伴或退货服务商将退货转交至合作伙伴仓库。

### 销毁

适用于在通过WHD仓库配送之前即被送去销毁的商品；其余情况请参见WHD模块。

发生取消、未认购商品和客户退货时，Ozon不会向您收取逆向货件的处理费用，包括销毁费用。

商品的权利和义务转移给接收商品的合作伙伴，此后有关商品的决定由其自行作出，Ozon不参与。

### 转交至合作伙伴仓库

商品的权利和义务转移给接收商品的合作伙伴，此后有关商品的决定由其自行作出，Ozon不参与。

[关于仓库设置的更多信息](/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/warehouse/)

Ozon在取货点处理取消、未认购商品和退货的服务不额外收费。

[关于处理取消与退货的更多信息](/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/)

## 运费计算

* 文件：`markdown/commissions/ozon-fees/volume-weight-for-partner-delivery.md`
* 路径：`/commissions/ozon-fees/volume-weight-for-partner-delivery`

您可以借助于
[计算器](https://globalcalculator.ozon.ru/)
计算运费。

为计算商品运输服务成本，物流公司可以使用包裹的实际重量或体积重量。

实际重量是商品及其包装的重量总和。 例如，如果您运送一个 500 克的马克杯，而包装重量（包括保护材料）为 150 克，则实际重量为 650
 克。

为计算体积重量，测量您商品包装的长度、宽度和高度，然后将所得数字除以某个指标。商品包装的长度、宽度和高度是在
[商品创造阶段](/products/upload/upload-types/)
指定的。

![](../../images/fb1abcca9b967c47.png)

承运商有不同的计算运费方式：

- 根据货件的实际重量或体积重量计算，这取决于货件的尺寸；

- 根据货件重量的最大值计算。

**货件重量计算示例**

> > 示例中的费率可能会变化。
> [有关承运商费率的更多信息](/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/partner-delivery-ozon/?country=CN#配送方式介绍揽收点清单及承运商条件)
>

承运商——Ural Express
 Big。商品将配送至Ozon取货点。

计费方法：如果物理重量大于体积重量，则按物理重量计费。如果体积重量超过物理重量，则按体积重量进行计费：长×宽×高（厘米）÷
 12000。三边之和不得超过250厘米，最大一边不得超过150厘米。

**运费计算示例**

货件重量为上述示例中的3公斤，边长分别为120厘米、50厘米和50厘米。

因此，货件体积重量为120×50×50÷12000=25公斤，超过了3公斤的物理重量。定价将根据体积重量进行。

Ural Express
 Big费率：每个货件36元+每1克包裹重量0.033元。

Ozon取货点的总运费为36+25000×0.033=861元。

## 如何避免包装货件时的错误

如果您的配送方式包括航空运输，请务必考虑货件的体积重量。包裹的长度、宽度和高度越大，体积重量就越高，即使商品本身很轻。不正确的包装可能会增加配送费用。

例如，不应将手机壳放入电脑包装盒中 ——
 这会增加货件尺寸，导致额外的费用。包装应保护商品，但不应使货件的尺寸过大。

## 奥宗科技服务费率

* 文件：`markdown/commissions/ozon-technology-fees/expenses-for-other-services.md`
* 路径：`/commissions/ozon-technology-fees/expenses-for-other-services`

本版本自2026年10月1日起生效。我们会提前公布费率变更。我们会提前公布费率变更：如果本页规则尚未生效，请查看上一版本。

计算时，我们采用下单时有效的费率。

服务提供方的服务费用不含增值税。如果根据俄罗斯联邦法律，任何服务需缴纳增值税，服务提供方将按现行税率计算税款，并在服务费用之外另行向委托方收取。

如果根据委托方所在国法律，委托方被认定为扣缴义务人，则由委托方自行计算并缴纳税款，费用自负。支付给服务提供方的款项不因上述税款而减少。

服务付款程序：

- 服务费用依据委托方的委托，通过“从Ozon余额中扣款”的方式支付，按扣款当日汇率计算。

- Ozon会针对每笔扣款生成扣款通知，并每月生成扣款报告。

- 在Ozon从Ozon余额中扣除资金并向个人中心发送扣款通知之时，相应金额的服务付款义务即视为已履行，无论Ozon随后何时向服务提供方划转资金总额。

### Premium订阅

## 对遵守反贪污及规管法例的保留

* 文件：`markdown/contracts-for-sellers/anticorrupzionnaya-ogovorka.md`
* 路径：`/contracts-for-sellers/anticorrupzionnaya-ogovorka`

## 适用法例的定义

适用法律—适用的法律、法规、规则、与公司和/或交易对手方有关的司法管辖区以及合同各方的关系，包括:

- 禁止贿赂和商业贿赂的反腐败法律;

- 禁止参与、便利或隐瞒有助于发展非法活动和资助恐怖主义的金融交易的反洗钱法;

- 经济或金融制裁限制、相关司法管辖区政府当局实施、管理或执行的贸易禁运;

- 有关出口管制措施的法律、命令、条例，管制或以其他方式规定为国家安全或其他外交政策目的对货物或技术的销售、出口、再出口或转让的要求或限制，其法律适用或规定适用于这种销售、出口、再出口或转让货物（例如美国制定的出口管制措施（出口管理条例））;

- 打击非法贸易领域的法律，包括分销假冒，假冒或侵犯版权;

- 禁止使用强迫劳动或童工的法律;

- 当事人保密和内幕信息保护领域的法律。根据适用于该等内幕信息的证券和交易法或证券交易所规则本公司的机密信息可能潜在地包含本公司及其关联公司的内幕信息因此交易对手方可。

## 保证和保证

- 双方确认，在提供这些保证和保证时，他们在协议期限内承担义务并遵守所有适用法律的要求。双方确认他们不采取任何可能导致违反适用法律的行为，不促进，鼓励或鼓励任何人参加此类活动。

- 双方保证，在履行本协议规定的义务时，双方本身、其雇员、代表和附属机构（考虑到一方控制将这些义务扩展到这些人的合理能力）不参与贿赂、商业贿赂、不付款、不提供付款和不允许直接或间接向任何人支付任何资金或贵重物品, 影响这些人的行动或决定，以取得任何非法利益或达到其他非法目标。

- 双方确认实施充分和有效的内部控制报告制度和防止和发现违反适用法律的措施，其中包括在合同双方关系框架内发现和防止涉及和（或）针对其雇员和承包商的贿赂和商业贿赂的措施。

- 双方保证，在开展活动时，他们遵循俄罗斯联邦和其他国家或协会的适用监管法律行为，这些国家或协会对某些法律实体和个人、经济部门、司法管辖区和领土（包括但不限于伊朗、叙利亚、朝鲜、克里米亚）实施制裁或出口限制。 对手方还保证，在提供这些保证时，它没有作出或在提供这些保证时，也没有作出有意或过失直接或间接违反、违反或因此可能违反制裁或出口限制的行动。交易对手方还证明，在提供这些保证时，其集团成员、董事、高级职员均未收到任何主管当局就制裁或出口管制对其提出的任何索赔、措施、诉讼、诉讼或调查的通知，而且不知道这些通知。

- 交易对手在订立合同之前和/或在根据公司内部程序对交易对手进行可靠性初步核查期间提供的所有文件和资料都是可靠有效、准确和没有误导性的，包括核查可靠性的程序、打击洗钱领域的检查和列入制裁名单（如适用）。

- 如果一方违反本节规定的保证，另一方有权单方面退出合同的履行，适用《俄罗斯联邦民法典》第406.1（1）条（由于另一方不履行本节规定的义务而造成的任何损失，以及罚款或处罚，应由第三方，包括政府机构向另一方赔偿，并要求该方赔偿。遭受损失的一方）。以本节为由要求终止合同的一方不得向另一方赔偿损失。

## 交易对手的义务

- 除提供给本公司的文件外，在初步可靠性检查期间，交易对手承诺应本公司的要求提供文件，作为本公司定期验证交易对手可靠性的一部分。

- 在协议期限内，交易对手保存可靠地反映交易对手与协议有关的业务运作的会计和报告文件，并根据适用法律执行内部会计控制。交易对手应公司的书面要求提供该等文件的副本。在因任何原因终止/终止协议后，交易对手有义务保留指定协议下的会计和报告文件（在法律规定的期限内），并应公司的书面要求提供此类文件的副本。

- 通过签署本节，交易对手还确认其同意公司反腐败和道德商业政策的基本原则（交易对手政策的版本发布在公司网站上：插入标签
[https://corporate.ozon.ru/social#policies](https://ir.ozon.com/en/sustainability)
并承诺跟随他。

- 交易对手方承诺不与违反适用法律或在适用法律框架内被列入限制性名单（制裁，出口限制，恐怖分子名单等）的交易对手方或本协议下的客户建立或保)。

- 如果交易对手发现潜在或现有的违反适用法律的行为，以及对交易对手和/或交易对手集团的任何成员、该交易对手的官员实施的任何制裁、出口限制，交易对手立即通过使用公司网站上的合规热线部分或插入标签邮箱中指定的详细信息与合规热线联系通知公司compliance@ozon.ru。

- 交易对手应真诚地协助公司对涉及交易对手的已识别或涉嫌违反适用法律的行为进行调查。

- 如果交易对手违反本节规定的义务，公司有权单方面退出合同，适用俄罗斯联邦民法典第406.1（1）条（公司因以下原因而遭受的任何损失：交易对手未履行本节规定的义务，以及第三方因违反本节规定的义务而对公司进行罚款或处罚，包括政府机构在内，并要求发生的损失的交易对手。

## 来自国外货物添加到 Ozon 平台上的协议（cross-border）

* 文件：`markdown/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor.md`
* 路径：`/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor`

> > Revision of October 1, 2026.
>

This revision is effective as of October 1, 2026. We publish changes to the contract in advance: if the rules on this page are not already in effect, see the
[previous version](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/spisok-izmenenii-v-dogovore/)
.

## 1. SUBJECT, CONCLUSION, AMENDMENT AND TERMINATION OF THE CONTRACT

### 1.1. Subject of the Contract

Ozon undertakes to provide, and the Seller undertakes to accept and pay for the following services:

(a) for a fee and at the expense of the Seller to carry out transactions related to the sale of the Seller’s products through the Platform, including to provide the Seller with an access to Products placement on the Platform, transfer information about orders of the Seller's products, provide information support of the Clients;

(b) to develop, maintain and administer the Seller's PA;

(c) to provide the Seller with services in accordance with the Sections hereto;

(d)  to provide other services hereunder.

The rights and obligations under transactions related to the sale of the Seller's products and concluded on its behalf arise directly with the Seller (Art. 1005 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation).

### 1.2. Conclusion and term of the Contract

The Contract is concluded by sending Ozon the text of the Contract (an offer) with the Activation notice and any subsequent actions of the Seller in the PA to fulfill the terms of the Contract within 365 days from the date of Activation (term for acceptance). The performance by a potential Seller of any actions in the PA before Activation is not considered an acceptance. Transactions made by the Parties through actions in the PA are recognized as made in a simple written form using a simple electronic signature. All actions of the Seller in the Personal Account during the period during which the Seller is successfully authenticated in the Personal Account by Ozon ID shall be legally binding. The contract is deemed concluded on the date of sending the notice of Activation. The Contract is concluded for an indefinite period and extends to the relations between its Parties arising from the date of registration of the Seller on the Platform.

The Contract with the Platform Aggregator is concluded through the sending of a notification regarding the relevant amendment to the Contract (offer) and any subsequent actions of the Seller in the PA to fulfill the terms of the Contract within 365 days from the date of receipt of such notification (term for acceptance). The Contract with the Platform Aggregator is deemed concluded on the date the Platform Aggregator sends the notification regarding the relevant amendment to the Contract in the PA.

For Sellers who have expressed an intention to enter into a new contract with Ozon, the conclusion of the Contract with Ozon and the Contract with the Platform Aggregator takes place simultaneously in the manner prescribed in the first paragraph of this clause. Any action taken by such a Seller that constitutes acceptance of the offer is deemed to be simultaneous acceptance of the Ozon offer and the Platform Aggregator offer.

### 1.3. Refusal of Activation

Ozon may refuse Activation by sending a Notice indicating the reasons if the potential Seller provided details with errors or did not pass the verification of Ozon's counterparties, including if the potential Seller commits violations of the terms of contracts previously concluded with Ozon, as well as attempts to commit fraud or in other cases.

If Ozon notifies about refusal of Activation, then the Contract is considered not concluded.

The potential Seller has the right to object the refusal of Activation by providing evidence of the absence of reasons for the refusal, and Ozon is obliged to consider the objection and provide a reasoned response within 7 calendar days. In the absence of an objection or failure to provide evidence, the potential Seller does not become a Seller and does not have the right to demand recognition of the Contract as concluded by Ozon, and Ozon may not consider objection of the Activation refusal on similar grounds in the absence of additional evidence and information.

### 1.4. Contract Performance Suspension by Ozon

Ozon shall be entitled to unilaterally suspend, in whole or in part, the performance of its obligations under the Contract if:

(a) the Seller's service quality indicators downgrades to critical values determined by Ozon;

(b) the Seller has a debt to pay any amounts under the Contract;

(c) any specific Product has defects not agreed upon between the Parties or the condition of a Product does not comply with the provisions of the Product Description Page or this Contract or a Product has defects not agreed upon between the Parties;

(d) the Seller does not comply with the contractual terms or Ozon's instructions regarding the Platform operation, or violates third parties' rights;

(e) on technical or other grounds. During the suspension period, no fee shall be charged for the services directly affected by such suspension;

(f) the Seller has not provided payment details for the specified method of settlements in his/her PA.

### 1.5. Contract Amendment

Ozon shall be entitled to unilaterally amend the Contract by sending a Notice to the Seller:

(a) at least 7 (seven) calendar days prior to such amendments become effective – in case of any amendments, except as provided by the paragraph “b”;

(b) at least 1 (one) calendar day prior to the entry into force of such amendments in cases of:

- any improvement of the Seller’s position, including the granting of new rights, benefits, discounts or expansion of the technical functionality of the Platform;

- a reduction of the Ozon’s remuneration or a change in the procedure for determining it, provided that such change does not entail an increase thereof;

- adding or changing the services or technical capabilities of the Platform without increasing the remuneration;

- adding or changing services or their cost, which the Seller selects and connects to the Personal Account on his own;

- changing the
[List of Prohibited Products](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#2-list-of-prohibited-products)
 for the purposes of complying with legal requirements, as well as protecting the life and health of Clients or Ozon employees;

- complying Contract’s terms with changes in the legislation;

- any editorial, technical, reference or clarifying amendments.

The Seller should regularly monitor the PA and the e-mail for amendments to the Contract.

In case of disagreement with the proposed amendments to the Contract, the Seller should send Ozon a request to rescind the Contract within 7 (seven) calendar days as of the date of the amendments notice. Otherwise, such amendments shall be deemed approved by both Parties as of the date of their entry into force, shall be applied to their relations, and shall become an integral part of the Contract.

### 1.6. Contract termination

Either Party has the right to rescind the Contract extra-judicially by submitting the Notice. The termination date shall be the last calendar day of the reporting period following the reporting period in which the Party submitted the notice.

The Seller has the right to unilaterally extra-judicially repudiate the Contract in case of disagreement with the amendments to the Contract.

Ozon has the right to unilaterally extra-judicially repudiate the Contract by submitting a Notice with indication of reasons:

(a) if any of the Representations is found to be unauthentic, invalid, incorrect or misleading;

(b) if the Seller has committed any material violation of the obligations under the Contract, including but not limited to: provision of false information about the products, failure to provide information at Ozon's request within 3 days from the request date, violation of the intellectual or other rights of third parties, repeated attempts to place for sale on the Platform and/or transfer for sale low-quality, prohibited, substitute products, transfer of defective products, products different from description in the Product Description Page, or products that are counterfeit under the laws of the Seller’s Country or the Country of destination, transfer of products other than those ordered by the Client, sale without actually sending products to the Client, violation of the requirements of the Section
[“Communication Rules with Clients and Ozon”](/zh/policies/communication/)
, violation of payment obligations, violation of the terms of the “Confidentiality and Personal Data” Section, “Representations and warranties” Section.

The Seller has the right to object Ozon’s refusal to fulfill the Contract by providing evidence of the absence of violations or the reliability and completeness of the Representations and Warranties, and Ozon is obliged to consider the objection within 7 calendar days. If Ozon has provided a reasoned refusal to objections, Ozon may not consider subsequent objections on the same grounds.

The Contract shall be terminated as follows:

(a) on the notice date Ozon shall cease the provision of the Services (except for the services related to Client’s returns), including payment of funds due to the Seller prior to the preparation of the final reconciliation report under the Contract, and make the Seller’s products unavailable for sale;

(b) not later than on the termination date (or as soon as possible in case of unilateral repudiation of one of the Parties), Ozon shall send to the Seller reconciliation report, which the Seller shall approve within 3 (three) business days or send revised version of the reconciliation report, otherwise the reconciliation report is considered agreed by the Parties.

The terms of the Contract shall remain in force after the termination date, to the extent applicable, until the Parties conduct the final reconciliation of mutual settlements.

#### 1.6.1. Ozon's right to refuse to perform the Contract

Ozon has the right to refuse to perform the Contract unilaterally and extra-judicially at any time without cause by sending a Notice to the Seller.  In this case, Ozon pays the Seller a termination fee (clause 3, Article 310 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation), that is calculated as the amount of Ozon's debt to the Seller on the date the last reconciliation report preceding the Notice.

Termination fee shall be made within 30 (thirty) days from the date of sending the Notice.

The termination date shall be the date of sending the Notice of termination to the Seller

## 2. SALE OF GOODS

### 2.1. Conclusion of deals between the Seller and the Client

The Seller and the Client enter into a sales transaction based on the
[Terms of sale of goods for Individuals](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/pravila-prodayoi-i-rekvizity/usloviya-prodayoi-tovarov-dlya-fizicheskih-lits-v-ozon-ru/)
 (including the section
["Terms of sale of goods with delivery from abroad"](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/pravila-prodayoi-i-rekvizity/tovary-dostavlyayutsya-iz-za-rubeyoa)
). The Seller shall discharge his/her obligations under the deal with the Client while complying with the terms of the Requirements for Order Processing Section and other provisions of the Contract applicable to the Order processing.

In case of concluding any transaction for the sale of products between the Seller and the Client through the Platform, the Seller is the direct seller of the products and bears all the relevant rights and obligations of the seller in accordance with the laws of the Russian Federation, the Seller's Country and the Country of destination and is indicated as a seller in the sales contract, shipping documents, fiscal and any other documents confirming the conclusion, execution and (or) settlement between the Seller and the Client.

### 2.2. Product price

The Seller shall set forth the Product price which includes the Product delivery cost and shall indicate it in the PA.

### 2.3. Product pricing procedure

The Seller sets the price of the products:

(a) in the Personal Account in the currency chosen by the Seller in accordance with clause 3.3.7 of this Contract.

(b) on the Website for the Client in Russian rubles or in the other currency of the Country of destination. On behalf of the Seller, Ozon undertakes to convert the prices for products specified by the Seller in the currency chosen in the PA into:

- a. Russian rubles at the
[Conversion Rate](/zh/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate)
 and demonstrate prices in Russian rubles for the Clients.

- b. the currency of the Country of destination (except Russian rubles) in real time and demonstrate prices in the currency of the Country of destination for the Clients, and settlements with the Seller are made based on the price set in PA in the chosen currency.

The Seller instructs Ozon, without further agreement with it, in order to increase sales of the Seller's products when delivering products to
[clusters of regional coefficients](/zh/prices/regional-price/)
, to offer Clients to purchase the Seller's products with an increase in price.

The Seller instructs Ozon, without further agreement with it, in order to promote products on the Platform to determine and implement
[a campaign of promotion of sale of Seller’s products](/zh/promotion/product-promotions/product-promotion#product-promotion-coefficient)
 by providing a set of electronic services, in this regard, the Seller instructs Ozon to offer Clients to purchase the Seller’s products with an increase in price.

Ozon retains the amount of the price increase as an additional component of the Ozon’s remuneration as compensation for the execution of the campaign to promote the sale of the Seller's products.

### 2.4. Product discounts. Points for discounts

The Seller instructs Ozon to provide a discount on the Product for its promotion on the Website on behalf and at the expense of the Seller with the subsequent accrual of Points for discounts (hereinafter referred to as “Points”).

As part of such instruction, the Seller connects to the mechanics of calculations with Points, and Ozon accrues Points, which the Seller uses to receive a discount on the Fee (in the amount of accrued Points) or on the Ozon services under the Contract, the list of which is set forth in the Fees and Tariffs Section, services for the promotion of products and advertising services. In this case, the Fee is calculated based on the Product price without taking into account discounts provided in accordance with this paragraph.

Points shall be used for the same reporting period in which they were awarded and cannot be used in other reporting periods.

The Seller is connected to the mechanics of calculations using Points from the moment the Contract is concluded and has the right to refuse participation by sending a request to the Personal Account and Ozon disables Points calculations for discounts within 3 business days from the date of receipt of the request. The Seller, after disconnection, may send a request for participation at any time, and Ozon enables calculations with Points for discounts within 3 business days from the date of receipt of the request.

Points shall be awarded as follows:

For every 1 (one) unit of the Seller’s currency, 1 (one) Point is awarded as a discount on the Product price in this currency in the reporting period in which the Product was sold to the Client.

When returning products, Ozon reduces the number of Points accrued in the reporting period of return by the Points that were awarded to the Seller for these products. If the number of Points for a returned Product exceeds the number of Points accrued in the reporting period, Ozon shall invoice the Seller with a fee  for overspending Points at the rate of 1 Point = 1 unit of the Seller’s contract currency.

If, after using Points for a discount on the Ozon Fee or on the Ozon services under the Contract, the list of which is set forth in the Fees and Tariffs Section, services for the promotion of products and advertising services, the Seller has a balance of unused Points, Ozon pays the Seller a bonus for providing a discount as part of Points settlement in the equivalent of 1 point = 1 unit of the Seller’s contract currency. This bonus does not change the cost of services provided.

Information about accrued and used Points is available to the Seller in the Personal Account. The final calculation of Points due to the Seller is carried out at the end of the reporting period. Other information in the Personal Account regarding the accrual, write-off and use of Points is preliminary and is provided for informational purposes only.

Discounts provided by Ozon since the entry into force of this clause, subject to subsequent amendments and additions, shall reduce the Fee in the amount of the discount provided.

Calculation of the amount of the Fee is specified and agreed by the Parties in the Report on the results of the reporting period.

### 2.5. Communication with the Clients and responses to Support Service requests

#### 2.5.1. Communication ways with Clients

The Seller may directly communicate with Clients on issues related to the products via a chat as well as through answers to reviews and questions in the Product Description Page. The Seller shall guarantee that all decisions made and actions performed when communicating with the Client via all communication channels comply with the Section
[Communication Rules with Ozon Clients](/zh/policies/communication/)
 and the requirements of the Contract and consumer protection laws. Support Service directs requests to the Seller from the Clients. The Seller shall respond within the time frame specified in the request.

#### 2.5.2. Chat with the Client

The Client and the Seller have an option to start a chat. The Seller is entitled to provide the Client with its contact details (information about its own website, telephone number, e-mail address and other contact details, if any) only via chat with the Client. If fraudulent activity is suspected, the chat may be suspended.

#### 2.5.3. Dedicated number

When it is necessary for the Seller to organize the delivery of products to the Client on their own or with the involvement of delivery services, the Seller also has the right to contact the Seller using a special dedicated Ozon number. To control the quality of using the Platform, placing and fulfilling Orders, as well as fulfilling the terms of the Contract by the Seller, Ozon may record calls.

### 2.6. Other Terms and Conditions of Sale

The Seller shall instruct Ozon to determine all other terms and conditions for the sale of products through the Platform, except for the Product price. The terms and conditions of return are determined by Ozon in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and/or the Country of destination and Terms of sale of products for Individuals and may improve Clients’ position in comparison with the law or the Contract. The Seller agrees to these terms in full.

### 2.7. Order cancellation

#### 2.7.1. Ozon's right to cancel the order

Ozon has the right to cancel orders for the Seller's products in the event of improper fulfillment by the Seller of its obligations, including, but not limited to, if the orders are not submitted within the specified time frame and incorrect indication of the delivery address to the Client, shipment of products with characteristics that do not correspond to the Product Description Page, shipment of products prohibited by this Contract for the sale, mass complaints of Clients about the quality of products, repeated indication of incorrect track numbers. Such cancellation of the order is not recognized as a violation by Ozon of its obligations under the Contract. The Seller is responsible for all negative consequences associated with such actions, including possible claims and/or claims made by the Client in connection with such a cancellation of the order, as well as a decrease in service quality indicators up to the suspension of the provision of services under the Contract.

#### 2.7.2. Seller's right to cancel the order

The Seller has the right to cancel his orders, but is responsible for all negative consequences associated with such actions, including possible claims and claims made by the Client in connection with such a cancellation of the order. The cancellation of the order by the Seller is also recognized as receiving information from the Delivery Service selected by the Seller about the cancellation of the order.

## 3. REMUNERATION, REPORTING DOCUMENTS AND PAYMENT

### 3.1. OZON’S REMUNERATION

Ozon's remuneration shall comprise:

(a) interest of the Product price, established by the Seller in the PA in the Seller’s contract currency (Fee);

(b) remuneration for the rendering of the services specified in the Contract.

The amount of the Fee and the cost of the services hereunder shall be established in the
[Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/)
.

### 3.2. REPORTING DOCUMENTS

#### 3.2.1. Sending Reporting documents to the Seller

Ozon shall, within 5 (five) calendar days after the end of each reporting period (a calendar month), deliver to the Seller via the Seller’s Personal Account the following documents (the “Reporting Documents”):

(a) a sales report;

(b) UPD‑1, which shall include the Sales Remuneration (if applicable) and all categories of services provided by Ozon;

(c) a report and a certificate of services rendered in connection with carrying out the instruction to conclude transactions with third parties at the Seller’s expense, where such third parties are retained to perform certain obligations relating to the sale of the Seller’s goods through the Platform. Ozon reserves the right to include in such report and certificate services rendered in prior periods if the necessary information is received late from the retained third parties;

(d) any other documents, if necessary.

Ozon prepares an interim report at the request of the Seller about his sales as a result of the provision of services (the Interim report) as of the 15th (fifteenth) calendar day of the reporting month. Interim report shall be for information only and shall be used solely for settlements hereunder. The Report contains information on the name and quantity of products sold and returned, as well as on the amount of Ozon's remuneration.

#### 3.2.2. Approval of Reporting documents

Within 3 (three) business days upon the date of sending of the Reporting documents by Ozon, the Seller shall:

(a) sign the documents on its part if there are no disagreements; or

(b) in case of disagreements, submit to Ozon reasoned objections executed in the form of the statement of disagreements. Upon receiving the statement of disagreements, Ozon shall introduced the amendments accepted and submit to the Seller the amended documents and the Seller shall sign these amended documents.

#### 3.2.3. Acceptance of services in absence of feedback from Seller

If the Seller fails to sign the Reporting documents in due time, the documents signed by Ozon unilaterally shall be deemed:

(a)    duly approved by the Parties (the last day of the period provided for the Seller's feedback shall be the document approval date); and

(b)    a due confirmation of the Seller's approval of all amounts and other terms specified therein and the due basis for payment.

#### 3.2.4. Reconciliation report

At the end of each calendar quarter, no later than the 15th (fifteenth) day of the following month, Ozon may place a reconciliation report for the past calendar quarter in the PA.

The Seller, within 15 (fifteen) business days after Ozon sent the reconciliation report, is obliged to:

(a) press the "Accept" button in the PA – in the absence of disagreements; or

(b) in case of disagreements, press the "Reject" button in the PA and send Ozon revised version of the reconciliation report, which indicates the documents on which disagreements arose, otherwise the Seller’s objections will be considered unreasonable.

Ozon considers any objections within 5 (five) business days and sends the reconciliation report to the Seller with amendments agreed by Ozon.

The Seller shall agree on a new reconciliation report in the PA or indicate his objections within 3 (three) business days after sending the reconciliation report. In any case, the Parties shall agree on the reconciliation report before the end of the next calendar quarter.

If the Seller does not report any objections within the prescribed period or does not indicate the documents to which the Seller has such objections, the reconciliation report placed by Ozon in the PA is considered:

(a) duly agreed by the Parties (in this case, the date of reconciliation is the last day of the above term for feedback from the Seller), and

(b) duly accepted by the Seller with respect to all amounts and other provisions specified in the reconciliation report.

Reconciliation shall be done on a quarterly basis only. Ozon does not provide an interim reconciliation report at the request of the Seller.

#### 3.2.5. Legal force of documents

The Parties acknowledge the legal force of documents received during communication via electronic or other communication, including using the information and telecommunications network "Internet", as well as other documents.

The Parties acknowledge that the submission of the Accounting Documents to the PA is the required and adequate confirmation of:

(a) Ozon's proper performance of its obligation to submit the Accounting Documents;

(b) the acceptance of the services provided by Ozon in full if the Seller has not submitted any objections following the procedure established herein.

The Parties acknowledge that the data of Ozon's accounting systems, displayed in the PA, are the primary and reliable source of information regarding the performance by the Parties of their respective contractual obligations.

### 3.3. PAYMENT

#### 3.3.1. Features of Money Transfer Services

On behalf of the Seller Ozon enters into agreements with third parties on the name of Ozon and at the expense of the Seller for the provision of services on organization of payment acceptance from Clients (acquiring). The amount of Ozon's remuneration and the procedure for determining the amount of money for third party services are set out in the
[Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/commissions-for-other-services/)
. All money received by Ozon for the products sold on the basis hereof shall be the Seller s' property and shall be held by Ozon which acts as an agent in own name, but on behalf and at the expense of the Seller until the time of settlements with the Seller.

#### 3.3.2. Transfer of money to the Seller

Ozon shall transfer the money for the Seller's products ordered and received by Clients during the reporting month (less the amounts due to Ozon) twice a month as follows:

(a) not later than on the 25-27 (twenty fifth-twenty seventh) day of the reporting month Ozon shall transfer money to the Seller on the basis of the Interim Sales Report in the PA as of the 15th (fifteenth) calendar day of the reporting; and

(b) not later than on the 10-12 (ten-twelve) calendar days as of the date of approval of the Reporting documents Ozon shall transfer to the Seller the difference between the amount under the Reporting documents and the amount paid pursuant to the paragraph (a) of this clause.

If the money are transferred on the last day of the specified term, such transfer shall be realized on the next working day of Ozon Bank.

The money are transferred to the bank account of the Seller or the Payment service provider. The method available for mutual settlements is specified in the PA.

The Seller shall provide Ozon with complete and accurate payment details, as well as keep such information up-to-date. Upon receipt by the Seller of the notice about the need to change the method of mutual settlements or to provide the details in other currency, the Seller undertakes to promptly ensure the change of payment details in the PA.

In case the Seller has provided Ozon with different payment details for several concluded Contracts, if it is impossible to make payment due to reasons beyond Ozon's control using the payment details of one of such Contract, Ozon is entitled to use the Seller’s payment details of the other Contract to fulfill its payment obligation under the first Contract.

#### 3.3.2.1. Transfer of money to the Seller using the Payment service provider or third parties

Ozon has the right to offer the Seller the method of mutual settlements only through the Payment service provider. In this case, Ozon transfers funds to the bank account of the Payment service provider, indicating the information required by the Payment service provider for further transfer of funds due to the Seller under the Contract. Ozon reserves the right to engage Payment service providers at its own discretion.

For the avoidance of any doubt, the Parties hereby agree that if the Seller chooses settlements involving the Payment service provider:

(a) such a choice shall be deemed to be a direct instruction by the Seller to fulfill Ozon's obligations arising under the Contract, by transferring funds to the bank account of the Payment service provider;

(b) any monetary obligations of Ozon to the Seller under the Contract shall be deemed to be duly executed on the date of debiting the funds from Ozon's bank account (in accordance with clause 3.3.8 of the Contract).

Ozon may engage third parties (subagents) to transfer funds to the Seller within the time frame and amount established by the Contract.

The activities of a subagent in the Republic of Turkey shall constitute the activities of a commercial agent as specified in Article 12(2)(b) of the Law No. 6493 on Payment and Securities Settlement Systems, Payment Services and Electronic Money Institutions.

#### 3.3.3. Minimum Amount to Be Transferred

If the amount of the money collected during the reporting period to pay for the Seller's products does not exceed 1000 (one thousand) US dollars or 1000 (one thousand) euro or 6500 (six thousand five hundred) yuan or 3800 (three thousand eight hundred) UAE dirham or 60000 (sixty thousand) Russian rubles, Ozon shall transfer the money collected to the Seller on the nearest payment date upon reaching the amount specified.

#### 3.3.4. Deduction of Money

Ozon shall deduct the following amounts under the liabilities from the money to be transferred to the Seller:

(a) Amounts to be returned to the Clients concerning the orders cancelled or following consideration of their claims, including claims for late delivery (when the Client rejects the order due to delivery delays), as well as concerning the Cancellations which have not changed its status to "Delivered" within 40 (forty) calendar days as of the shipment date.

(b) Amounts reserved for claims under consideration (when the Client has contacted the Seller via the Platform but no decision has been made in his/her relation in the billing period). If the claim is resolved in favor of the Seller, the money for such claims shall be transferred to it with the next payment in accordance with the Contract provisions.

(c) Ozon's remuneration calculated from the amount in the Seller's contract currency.

(d) amounts of re-charged expenses, penalties and losses due to Ozon. Deduction of the specified amounts is carried out in the Seller's contract currency, and Conversion is carried out at the exchange rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation on the date of placing the relevant order or on the date of accrual of penalties and losses;

(e) the cost of delivery paid by the Client if the Product was returned by the Client and the dispute in respect of the Product was resolved in favor of the Client. Deduction of the specified amount is carried out in the Seller's contract currency at the exchange rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation in accordance with the provisions of the Contract.

#### 3.3.5. Invoicing

In case of the negative balance and arrears in payment, Ozon sends to the Seller an invoice for payment, which the Seller must pay within 7 (seven) calendar days.

#### 3.3.6. Offset Right

Ozon has the right to make unilateral offsets for counter monetary obligations of the Seller arising under the Contract and other agreements concluded between the Parties, with the sending to the Seller of a document confirming the offset of counter claims.

The Parties agreed that if Ozon and the Seller have counter monetary obligations denominated in different currencies, the Seller’s monetary obligation is updated into a monetary obligation expressed in the same currency as Ozon’s counter obligation, for the subsequent offset of the specified homogeneous obligations of the Parties and without conclusion of a separate agreement on this, by sending Ozon a notice of novation. The date of such novation of the original obligation into a newly arising obligation is the date of notice of the novation by Ozon. The amount of the novated monetary obligation and the amount of the newly arising monetary obligation are determined based on the novation notice sent by Ozon and if it is necessary to convert the currency, the novation is carried out at the exchange rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation on the date of novation. For the avoidance of doubt, the Parties have agreed that such a novation terminates the obligations associated with the original obligation, and under no circumstances terminates other obligations of the Parties under the Contract.

#### 3.3.7. Seller’s contract currency

If the funds from Clients for orders placed on the Website shall be accepted by Ozon in the Russian rubles, Ozon transfers funds to the Seller in the contract currency (available to the Seller upon registration in the Personal Account) chosen by Seller, at the rate specified in
[“Conversion rate” Section](/zh/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate)
 on the date of placing the relevant order.

If the funds from Clients for orders placed on the Website shall be accepted by Ozon in the other currency of the Country of destination, Ozon transfers funds to the Seller in the contract currency (available to the Seller upon registration in the Personal Account) chosen by Seller based on the price set by the Seller in the Personal Account.

The Seller’s contract currency and the payment currency can be determined based on the Seller's Country or the currencies available in the Seller’s Country automatically during the registration of the Seller or during the term of the Contract.

When performing the Conversion and mutual settlements under the Contract, the Parties agreed on the following procedure:

(a) Funds due to the Seller as of 31 July 2022, but not transferred in accordance with the clause 3.3.2 (b) of the Contract shall be transferred in the Seller's settlement currency at the exchange rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation as of July 31, 2022.

(b) The funds due to the Seller for the products, the sales of which will be reflected in the Reporting documents, starting from August 2022, will be transferred in the manner specified in clause 3.3.7 of this Contract, with the exception of clause (a) above.

#### 3.3.7.1. Change of payment currency

Ozon has the right to change the payment currency to the currency of the Seller's Country or other currency available in the Seller's Country by sending a notice in the PA. From the date of receipt of the notice, the funds due to the Seller in the contract currency, will be transferred in the currency changed at the cross rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation on the date of the bank remittance order made by Ozon. The latter is also valid when the funds are transferred to the Seller from the account of a third party on behalf of Ozon.

#### 3.3.8. Payment

The obligation to pay any amount under the Contract shall be deemed fulfilled from the moment the funds are debited from the Ozon current account or from the account of a third party on behalf of Ozon.

#### 3.3.9. VAT

The cost of Ozon services is exclusive of VAT. If any Ozon services should be subject to VAT under the laws of the Russian Federation, this tax will be accounted for by Ozon at the effective rate and invoiced to the Seller in addition to the cost of services.

#### 3.3.9.1. VAT according to the legislation of the Client

If, in accordance with the legislation of the Client's country, Ozon is obliged to pay VAT or other similar tax in relation to products sold by the Seller through the Platform, the Client shall pay the selling price of the products set by the Seller and the amount of applicable tax.

The amount of tax that the Client pays when paying for the products, Ozon credits to its own account and transfers to the budget of the state that established such tax, in the manner and terms provided by law. The tax amount does not increase the sales price for the Seller and is not reflected in the Seller's Reporting documents.

#### 3.3.10. Suspension of the transfer of money to the Seller

If there are cases of violation by the Seller of the provisions of the Contract (including transfer of products different from the one ordered by the Seller, transfer of products that are counterfeit under the laws of the Seller’s Country or Country of destination), as well as if Ozon does not have (the Seller fails to provide) the complete and accurate Seller’s payment details, including in terms of the changed method of mutual settlements in the PA or details in the currency of the Seller’s Country, Ozon has the right to suspend the transfer of money until the circumstances of the violation are clarified or complete and accurate payment details are received from the Seller. Ozon notifies the Seller about the occurrence of the circumstances specified in this clause.

The Parties confirm that, within the meaning of this clause, no interest shall accrue for the use of other persons’ funds.

#### 3.3.11. Responsibility for payment information

The Seller shall be responsible for any negative consequences of the indication of payment details during registration or in the Personal Account (for any chosen method of settlement), failure to provide and/or provision of incomplete or inaccurate payment details, as well as for the consequences with respect to the internal policy and/or regulation of bank and/or Payment Service Provider of which the Seller is a client.

## SECTION "LIABILITY"

### 1. General liability provisions

In case of non-performance or improper performance by one of the Parties of its obligations under the Contract, the Parties shall be held liable pursuant to the Contract and, in the part not regulated by the Contract, pursuant to the laws of the Russian Federation.

After the elimination of the circumstances that caused the impossibility of Ozon's performance of its obligations, Ozon shall resume performance thereof to the extent that Ozon deems such performance possible, taking into account the condition of the goods, transport routes and the consequences of the relevant events.

### 2. Seller’s liability

2.1. The Seller undertakes to independently settle any claims of any nature whatsoever brought against Ozon by third parties, state and/or municipal authorities, to defend Ozon’s interests, and to shield Ozon from any adverse consequences related to such claims, provided that the grounds for the lodging thereof are the actions or omissions of the Seller and/or third parties engaged by the Seller.

2.2. The Seller undertakes to compensate Ozon for any losses or damages caused if they arise as a result of the actions or omissions of the Seller and/or third parties engaged by the Seller, including, without limitation, in the following cases:

(a) infringement of the rights of third parties, including intellectual property rights;

(b) violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation;

(c) breach of the Seller’s obligations set forth in or related to the Contract, if such breach has resulted in losses to Ozon;

(d) issuance of orders, claims, complaints, and lawsuits against Ozon;

(e) breach of the obligations, representations and warranties of the Seller set forth in Section
[“Representations and Warranties”](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#section-“representations-and-warranties”)
;

(f) breach of the obligations established in Section
[“Confidentiality and Personal Data”](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#section-“confidentiality-and-personal-data”)
;

(g) infringement of the intellectual property rights of Ozon or third parties;

(h) provision of incomplete, inaccurate or incorrect information and data, which has resulted in losses to Ozon;

(i) violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation (if Russian Federation is the Country of destination) or other Country of destination on taxes and fees, as well as violation of representations and warranties with respect to taxes and fees, as a result of which the Seller is obliged to reimburse Ozon for the amount of additional accrued and paid in the territory of the Russian Federation (if Russian Federation is the Country of destination) or other Country of destination on the basis of an act of a state body, including a decision of a tax authority or decisions to initiate a criminal case, taxes, contributions, penalties, fines for relevant tax violations, losses (expenses) incurred by Ozon as part of an appeal against claims from tax authorities caused by the Seller’s violation of the representations and warranties specified in the Contract, within the framework of pre-trial / judicial settlement.;

(j) occurrence of any other adverse consequences.

2.3. The Seller undertakes to compensate Ozon for property losses caused by any circumstances related to the Seller’s goods and/or its activities on the Platform, as well as in the event of civil, administrative or tax liability. Such indemnification shall be carried out in accordance with Article 406.1 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, regardless of the existence of any wrongful actions or omissions on the part of the Seller and/or third parties engaged by the Seller, and regardless of the causal connection with such losses.

The amount of compensation for property losses by the Seller, depending on the case, is determined on the basis of documents confirming:

(a) the making of a payment by Ozon to third parties, state and/or municipal authorities;

(b) the incurrence by Ozon of an obligation to make such payments;

(c) expenses incurred by Ozon in connection with the settlement of claims, complaints, applications, orders, lawsuits or other demands of third parties, state and/or municipal authorities.

Such supporting documents shall include, without limitation: final and binding court judgments, writs of execution, decisions, orders and other enforcement acts of state or municipal authorities, payment documents, claims of third parties, documents evidencing the settlement of claims, and any other documents confirming the amount of pecuniary losses or Ozon’s obligation to incur the same.

2.4. Upon identification of the discrepancies specified in this clause, the Seller shall assume the risk of any adverse consequences arising therefrom and shall undertake to indemnify Ozon for any losses caused thereby, including, without limitation, in the following cases:

(a) if the wrong product (assortment discrepancy) has been included in the Shipment, as a result of which the Client refuses to accept the goods — in such case, the Parties shall effect settlements in a manner analogous to the return of goods by the Client;

(b) if there is a shortage of the product declared in the Shipment — in such case, Ozon shall withhold from the Seller the amount actually paid by the Client for such product, without refunding the Remuneration therefor, to cover the processing of such shortage;

(c) if the Seller has transferred the Shipment after the expiry of the recommended time slot and/or has failed to transfer the Shipment after multiple postponements of the delivery date to the Client — in such case, Ozon shall have the right to cancel the Order.

2.5. Ozon shall be entitled to suspend the listing on the Platform of one or more of the Seller’s goods until the circumstances of any of the following violations are remedied or clarified:

(a) transfer of goods whose characteristics do not correspond to those stated in the Product Description Page;

(b) transfer of goods in breach of the shelf‑life requirements;

(c) failure to confirm the readiness of the Order for transfer within the timeframe required under the realFBS sales scheme;

(d) provision of inaccurate information regarding the delivery timeframes and geography, the Seller’s warehouse operating hours, as well as any other information required to be provided;

(e) actions or omissions on the part of the Seller as a result of which Ozon cancels the Client’s order;

(f) use and dissemination of the Client’s personal data received from Ozon for purposes other than those specified in the Contract;

(g) inclusion of advertising inserts in Orders for the purpose of promoting the Seller’s own trademark and/or a third‑party website;

(h) other cases of breach by the Seller of its obligations under the Contract.

In the event of repeated violations by the Seller of the aforementioned obligations, Ozon shall have the right to unilaterally withdraw from the provision of services with respect to the Seller’s goods in respect of which such violations have occurred. Such actions shall not be deemed a breach by Ozon of its obligations under the Contract.

#### 2.6. Claim and Withholding Procedure

Any losses, damages, pecuniary losses and other amounts payable by the Seller shall be calculated and paid on the basis of a claim submitted by Ozon to the Seller via the Seller’s Personal Account or via e‑mail, including by means of withholding from funds due to to be transferred to the Seller.

The Seller shall be entitled to submit reasoned objections within 5 (five) calendar days after the claim is submitted; failing which, the claim shall be deemed to have been accepted by the Seller in the version set out by Ozon.

#### 2.7. Penalties

In the event of failure to fulfill or improper fulfillment of obligations under the Contract, the Seller shall pay Ozon a penalty in the amount established in the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/fines)
 Section. Ozon will notify the Seller of the violated provision of the Contract in a Notice, after which the Seller has the right to submit reasoned objections within 14 (fourteen) calendar days unless otherwise stated in the Contract. The penalty is waived if the Seller submit its objections on time and Ozon deems them reasoned.

### 3. Ozon’s liability

#### 3.1. Limitation of Ozon’s liability

The Parties agree that any claims against Ozon arising under or in connection with the Contract shall be limited to compensation for duly documented actual damages. Ozon shall compensate actual damages only upon the simultaneous fulfilment by the Seller of the following conditions:

(a) the Seller promptly (within 24 hours as of the date of discovery thereof) notified Ozon of the occurrence of the damage or of the receipt of the relevant claim;

(b) the Seller provided Ozon with the documents and information necessary to verify the circumstances, the. amount of the damage and the grounds for Ozon’s liability;

(c) the Seller involved Ozon in the examination of the relevant claim, if such claim has been brought by a third party;

(d) the Seller notified Ozon of its claim within 30 (thirty) calendar days from the date when the Seller became aware or should have become aware of the grounds for such claim, unless a different time period is established by the Contract;

(e) Ozon is at fault for the non-performance or improper performance of the relevant obligation, provided that in the absence of such fault, Ozon’s liability shall be excluded.

Ozon shall not be liable for lost profits, indirect losses or consequential damages, nor for any other losses which do not constitute duly documented actual damages.

3.2. Ozon shall be liable for loss or damage to the Seller’s goods or Shipment only if such event occurred due to Ozon’s fault during the period when the goods or Shipment were in Ozon’s possession.

Ozon shall not be liable for loss or damage to the goods or Shipment if:

(a) this occurred prior to Ozon’s receipt of the Shipment or after the transfer of the Shipment to the Client or the return of the undelivered Shipment to the Seller or the Seller’s Partner;

(b) the cause was improper packaging of the goods, the properties of the goods, or the contents of the Shipment;

(c) the absence of goods, damage to goods, or their inadequate quality could not be detected upon acceptance without opening the packaging;

(d) the Client reported the absence of goods or their inadequate quality upon receipt of the Shipment with intact packaging;

(e) during return pre‑moderation, the Seller automatically approved the Client’s claim with respect to goods whose price was below the price threshold set by the Seller in the Personal Account;

(f) the goods were transferred to the Client and subsequently returned (including directly upon receipt).

Ozon shall not be liable for:

(a) Shipments or goods contained therein that are detained, seized, or not released by state authorities, including, but not limited to, customs authorities, in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Seller’s country or the country of destination, with possible subsequent disposal;

(b) duplicate Shipments (second and subsequent Shipments bearing the same logistics label), unidentified Shipments, or damaged Shipments unfit for transportation. Ozon shall not be liable to the Seller for such Shipments and shall have the right to dispose of them without any subsequent compensation to the Seller;

(c) Shipments not listed in the Order list on the Platform. Ozon shall not be liable to the Seller for such unlisted Shipments and shall have the right to dispose of them.

3.3. Ozon shall not be liable:

(a) for non‑performance or improper performance of its obligations if the Seller has not notified Ozon of its claim within 30 (thirty) days from the date when the Seller became aware or should have become aware of the grounds for such claim (unless a different period is established in the Contract);

(b) for transactions relating to the sale of goods to Clients and shall under no circumstances be liable for the quality of the goods transferred by the Seller to the Client;

(c) for non‑performance or improper performance of its obligations if the Seller has provided Ozon with inaccurate, incomplete, incorrect or misleading representations or information. Any claims of Client and supervisory authorities arising from incomplete, inaccurate or incorrect information and data shall be settled at the Seller’s expense;

(d) for non‑performance, delay in performance or improper performance of services due to malfunctions/outages in information systems, during data exchange and in integration processes via the Ozon Seller API. Such malfunctions/outages shall not constitute a refusal to perform obligations within the meaning of Articles 310 and 782 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation and shall not be deemed a breach of the terms of the Contract;

(e) for non‑performance or improper performance of its obligations in the event of circumstances that pose a risk of harm to the life and health of employees and partners during their activities in a certain territory (including military operations; counter‑terrorist operations; martial law or a state of emergency; a state of emergency response; a maximum response level regime; any other special legal regime; mass riots; unsanctioned gatherings, rallies, demonstrations, marches or pickets; crash of unmanned aerial vehicles or other military equipment; restrictions on movement, including blocking of transport infrastructure; and similar events). Upon the elimination of these circumstances, Ozon shall be obliged to resume performance of its obligations if such performance remains possible;

(f) for non‑performance or improper performance of Ozon’s obligations caused by the fault of the Seller, the Delivery Service or the Customer;

(g) for dry runs and/or downtime of the Seller’s or the Delivery Service’s vehicles;

(h) for opening, damage to, or absence of the transport packaging on the Shipment returned to the Seller;

(i) for downtime of the Seller’s vehicles that have arrived for the transfer of Shipments in breach of the agreed time window;

(j) in other cases provided for in the Contract.

### 4. Allocation of entrepreneurial risk

In accordance with Article 2, Article 211 and clause 1 of Article 401 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, the Parties have agreed that the risks of loss, shortage and damage of goods, as well as the Seller's direct and indirect losses related to such circumstances arising from the following events or their consequences, shall be attributed to the Seller's entrepreneurial risk and shall not be subject to compensation by Ozon:

(a) combat, military and/or defensive actions and/or operations, regardless of whether war has been declared;

(b) martial law or a state of emergency, a counter‑terrorist operation regime, a state of emergency response, a maximum response level regime, or any other special legal regime;

(c) mass riots, unsanctioned gatherings, rallies, demonstrations, marches or pickets;

(d) launch, use, impact, hit or crash of manned or unmanned aerial vehicles of any kind, stratostats, probes and other aircraft and objects, as well as their parts, cargo, fragments, debris, projectiles and individual components;

(e) launch, use, activation, impact, hit or crash of missile weapons, anti‑missile or air defence systems, combat aircraft, multiple launch rocket systems, operational‑tactical missile systems, missiles of any kind, projectiles of any kind, bullets, grenades, other means of destruction of personnel and equipment, as well as their parts, fragments, debris, projectiles and individual components;

(f) collision with military, special or other vehicles and transport means used in the course of any operations or measures of a military or counter‑terrorist nature, and any restrictions on movement, including blocking of transport infrastructure;

(g) shelling from any weapon, targeted explosion/detonation of any device, if such shelling or explosion/detonation directly or indirectly resulted from the events specified in this clause;

(h) detonation of mines, shells, ammunition, torpedoes, bombs, other weapons, devices or instruments of war, including those remaining after special measures for their neutralisation carried out by authorised state authorities, even if an official document on the safety of the area has been issued by them;

(i) effects of noise and blast waves;

(j) leakage or dispersion of any polluting or poisonous substances (liquid, solid or gaseous);

(k) fire, ignition, smoke emission, explosion, collapse or destruction of buildings, structures, premises, Warehouses, pick-up points, sorting centers, vehicles, utility networks or other Ozon infrastructure, flooding, interruption of electricity, heat, gas or water supply, damage to communication systems, as well as other damage or destruction of property, if such consequences are directly or indirectly caused by the events specified in these sub-clauses of this clause 4;

(l) the imposition by state authorities, local self-government bodies or other authorized persons of prohibitions and restrictions related to the events specified in these sub-clauses, including restriction of access to territories and facilities, evacuation, cordoning off, closure of facilities, suspension or restriction of traffic, carrying out investigative, operational, emergency rescue and other mandatory measures.

### 5. Compensation for lost or damaged goods of the Seller

5.1. In the event of fault on the part of Ozon or the person providing transportation services to Ozon in the interests of the Seller (excluding persons providing services directly to the Seller), such person shall compensate the Seller for the value of the lost or damaged goods, subject to the provisions of this clause.

5.1.1. Compensation shall be made in full or in part on the basis of the following formula:

For OGL services: [Amount of Compensation] = [Declared Value of the product] × [OGL Compensation Ratio]

For services of Logistics Partners: [Compensation Amount] = [Declared Value of Goods] × [Aggregator Compensation Ratio]

For services of Fulfilment Partners of the Seller: [Compensation Amount] = [Declared Value of Goods] × [FBP Compensation Ratio]

Upon return via Warehouse: [Compensation Amount] = [Declared Value of Goods] × [WHD Compensation Ratio]

where:

(a) Declared Value of Goods means the value of the goods set by the Seller at the time of creation of a specific Client Order and recorded in the Personal Account.

(b) The Compensation Ratio shall be determined depending on the category and type of goods, the type of delivery and the price category, in accordance with the table set out in the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/poryadok-opredeleniya-koefficienta-vozmeshcheniya)
 Section.

Payment of compensation shall be made in the Seller’s currency.

5.1.2. Ozon shall have the right to request from the Seller documentary evidence of the amount of compensation (documents on the basis of which the goods were acquired, containing their value, including waybills, invoices, reports on market value, documents containing information on the costs of production of the goods incurred by the Seller), and the Seller shall be obliged to provide such documents within 5 (five) business days. Ozon shall have the right to determine the amount of compensation in accordance with the documents provided.

The final amount of compensation shall not exceed:

(a) the amount calculated in accordance with the formula, if the compensation amount is determined by the formula; or

(b) the amount confirmed by the submitted documents, if the compensation amount is determined on the basis of

such documents.

Ozon shall compensate the Seller for the value of lost and/or damaged goods in the calendar month following the calendar month in which Ozon made a positive decision on the Seller’s claim, but not earlier than the date on which the payment of funds for the goods received by Clients during the reporting month is made, in accordance with the procedure provided for in the Contract.

If the loss and/or damage to the goods occurred:

(a) as a result of an event the risk of which is insured by Ozon; and

(b) there are grounds for compensation recognised by the insurer and Ozon,

then the amount of compensation to the Seller shall be determined based on the amount of insurance compensation actually paid by the insurer to Ozon in respect of the Seller’s goods, and shall not exceed such amount.

Payment of compensation to the Seller in such case shall be made within 20 (twenty) business days from the day following the date of receipt by Ozon of the insurance compensation. If the insurance compensation is received in part, the payment to the Seller shall be made in the corresponding part. Until Ozon receives the insurance compensation for the relevant event, the payment deadline for compensation to the Seller shall not be deemed to have commenced, and the Seller’s claim for payment of compensation prior to the occurrence of such circumstance shall not be subject to satisfaction.

Ozon has the right to refuse to pay compensation if the barcode (for example, EAN or OZN), which is pasted on the product, was not indicated in the product description page when the Shipment was transferred.

#### 5.2. Ozon’s actions in the event of discovery of goods previously deemed lost

In the event that Ozon discovers goods for which it has previously paid compensation to the Seller due to their loss or shortage in accordance with the terms of the Contract, Ozon shall have the right to withhold the amount of the compensation previously paid and, at its sole discretion, either sell such goods on behalf of the Seller or return the goods to the Seller in accordance with the Section
[“Return, removal and disposal”](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#section-“return-removal-and-disposal”)
.

### 6. Force majeure circumstances

The parties shall not be held liable for failure to discharge or for improper discharge of their obligations under the Contract if it is caused by extraordinary and unavoidable circumstances arising upon acceptance of the order (force majeure) which are confirmed with documents of the competent bodies. If the force majeure persists for more than 6 (six) months, either Party may rescind the Contract without any compensation to the other Party. The Party affected by the circumstances mentioned above is obliged to notify the other Party within 5 (five) calendar days from the date of occurrence of the circumstances mentioned above.

## SECTION “SALES FROM THE SELLER'S WAREHOUSE”

### 1. Sales schemes from the Seller's warehouse

For the sale of goods from its own warehouse, the following sales schemes shall be available to the Seller:

(a) OGL – Ozon Forwarder delivers Shipment to the Client;

(b) realFBS – the Seller shall deliver the Shipments to the Client by any of the following methods: with the involvement of integrated or third‑party Delivery Services, or with the involvement of Logistics Partners (Aggregator).

### 2. Reception and processing of the Client’s Order

#### 2.1. Information about Seller’s warehouses

The Seller in the PA indicates information about one or several Seller’s warehouses, from which the products are shipped, remaining responsible for the relevance of this information and also selects the delivery method available under the relevant OGL or realFBS sales scheme. At the same time, the Seller undertakes to indicate in the PA all the information necessary for filling out about the warehouse and preparing the order. Ozon has the right to set the minimum and maximum time required to prepare an order for shipment to the Seller.

If there has been no shipment from the Seller’s warehouse for 30 (thirty) calendar days, Ozon has the right to transfer the warehouse to the archive in PA.

#### 2.2. Information about the products available for sale

The Seller is obliged to indicate in the PA the quantity of each of the products that he is ready to sell to Clients from each of the Seller’s warehouses, and to keep the data on such quantity up-to-date in real time. Such products become available on the Website for ordering.

#### 2.3. Confirmation of the readiness of orders

The Seller undertakes to indicate the completion of the assembly and packaging of the order by putting down the appropriate status of the order in the PA.

The Seller undertakes to indicate the completion of the Order assembly and packaging by indicating the corresponding Order status in the Personal Account.

Upon receipt of the Order, the Seller shall:
