(a) package the goods to ensure their safety and neat appearance during delivery, taking into account the requirements specified in the
["OGL"](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#“ogl”)
 and
[“realFBS”](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#“realfbs”)
 Sections.

(b) deliver the Shipment strictly in accordance with the list in the Order, taking into account the specifications specified in the
["OGL"](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#“ogl”)
 and
[“realFBS”](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#“realfbs”)
 Sections.

### “OGL”

> > The availability of the sales scheme is displayed in the Personal Account
>

#### 1. Subject and cost of services

**1.1.**
 Ozon undertakes, for a remuneration, to execute, on the instruction of the Seller, on its own behalf and at the expense of the Seller, transactions with Ozon Forwarder related to the provision of freight forwarding services for the organization of international transportation by the latter of Shipments of the Seller to the Client (Ozon Global Logistics (OGL) Services), including customs clearance of Shipments and to undertake other actions on its own behalf, but at the expense of the Seller.

The Seller instructs Ozon to independently determine with Ozon Forwarder the conditions for the provision of freight forwarding services for the organization of international transportation of the Seller's Shipments, including, but not limited to, the delivery time of the Shipments to the Clients, the terms for the provision of other services provided by Ozon Forwarder, the cost of the services of Ozon Forwarder, the procedure for providing services.

**1.2.**
 The Ozon Forwarder provides the following OGL Services when selling goods from the Seller's or the Seller's Partner's warehouse:

(a) OGL Service for the transfer of Shipments by the Pick-up method;

(b) OGL Service for the transfer of Shipments by the Drop-off method;

(c) OGL Service for the transfer of Shipments by the Self-drop method;

(d) other services specified in the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees)
 Section and available in the PA, and additionally agreed upon by the Parties.

**1.3. Moment of fulfillment of OGL Service**

The Seller's Instruction to Ozon and the OGL Services in respect of each Shipment transferred to the Ozon Forwarder for the purpose of delivery to the Client shall be deemed duly performed upon the occurrence of any of the following moments:

(a) At the moment when the Shipment is deemed delivered to the Client based on the "Delivered" status in the Personal Account; or

(b) At the moment when the Shipment is deemed returned through the Warehouse based on the "Returned through Warehouse" status in the Personal Account.

**1.4. **
The procedure for interaction with the Seller when selling goods from the Seller's Warehouse is governed by the Contract, as well as by the
["OGL work scheme"](/zh/fulfillment/ogl/ogl-work-scheme)
 Section.

**1.5.**
 The amount of Ozon's remuneration and the cost of OGL Services are set forth in the
["Fees and Tariffs" ](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees)
Section. The cost of OGL Services shall be determined based on the weight and dimensional characteristics of the Shipment, as determined by the Ozon Forwarder.

#### 2. Transfer and acceptance of Shipments

**2.1. Procedure for Transfer of Shipments**

**2.1.1.**
 The Seller shall, at its own expense and by its own means, form Shipments from the goods in the Order and consolidate them into cargo places for transfer to the Ozon Forwarder. The Seller is obliged to package the goods into Shipments and the Shipments into cargo places in such a way as to ensure its safety during the delivery process and an accurate appearance, including in accordance with the requirements set forth in the
["rFBS Order Packaging Requirements"](/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/order-packaging-requirements)
.

The Seller, for the purpose of transferring Shipments, shall indicate in the Personal Account the number of cargo places and its structure (if applicable) and generate it in accordance with the requirements set forth in
["Shipment generation"](/zh/fulfillment/ogl/shipping-from-your-warehouse/shipment-formation)
 Section.

**2.1.2. Methods of Transfer of Shipments **

To transfer a Shipment as part of a cargo place, the Seller shall select one of the following methods, which shall apply to all Shipments:

(a) Pick-up method – the Ozon Forwarder collects the Shipment from the Seller's warehouse;

(b) Drop-off method – the Seller delivers the Shipment to the Ozon Forwarder's shipment acceptance points;

(c) Self-drop method – the Seller independently delivers the Shipment to the Ozon Forwarder's warehouse specified in the Personal Account.

**2.1.3.**
 The Ozon Forwarder shall be entitled to discontinue acceptance of Shipments at the selected acceptance point by offering the Seller another available point.

**2.1.4. **
The Seller is obliged to transfer the cargo places no later than the recommended time slot set forth in the Personal Account for each of the methods of transfer of Shipments, and in accordance with the procedure provided for in the
["Shipping from your own warehouse"](/zh/fulfillment/ogl/shipping-from-your-warehouse/)
 Section.

**2.2. The procedure for acceptance of Shipments by the Ozon Forwarder**

**2.2.1.**
 After the Seller has transferred the cargo places to the Ozon Forwarder, the Ozon Forwarder shall commence acceptance of Shipments from the cargo places and inspect the Shipment for compliance with the label, the declared weight and dimensional characteristics, as well as compliance with the
["realFBS Order Packaging Requirements"](/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/order-packaging-requirements)
.

The Ozon Forwarder shall be entitled to selectively open any packaging (including damaged packaging) to inspect the safety and quality of the goods. If damage is detected, the Ozon Forwarder shall be entitled to refuse acceptance of the Shipment.

If during acceptance any unidentified Shipments, duplicate Shipments (the second and subsequent Shipments bearing the same logistics label), or damaged Shipments that cannot be transported further, or Shipments exceeding the established weight and dimensional characteristics limits are discovered, the Ozon Forwarder shall be entitled to dispose of such Shipments, it being presumed that the Seller has duly expressed its consent to such disposal. The Ozon Forwarder shall not reimburse the Seller for the value of the goods if disposal was carried out on any of the grounds set forth in this clause.

If the weight and dimensional characteristics falls within the limits but does not correspond to the declared data, the Ozon Forwarder may accept the Shipment with adjusted data or refuse acceptance.

**2.2.2. **
The Ozon Forwarder shall send information on the accepted Shipments to the Seller's Personal Account. The fact of acceptance of Shipments shall be recorded by a status in the Personal Account:

(a) "In Delivery" — upon acceptance by the Pick-up method;

(b) "In Delivery" — upon acceptance by the Drop-off method;

(c) "In Delivery" — upon acceptance by the Self-drop method.

The Seller is obliged to monitor in real time in the Personal Account the change of statuses of accepted Shipments. The statuses of Shipments in the Personal Account shall take precedence over any other data and documents. In the event of a discrepancy between the statuses in the Personal Account and the Shipments actually transferred by the Seller, the Shipments shall be deemed transferred in the quantity accepted by the Ozon Forwarder, as indicated in the Seller's Personal Account. The Seller may submit reasoned objections regarding the acceptance of Shipments in accordance with the procedure set forth in this Section.

Ozon provides the Ozon Forwarder with Seller’s contact details and Seller’s warehouse address to ensure such interaction between the Ozon Forwarder and the Seller within this Section.

#### 3. Compensation for lost or damaged goods of the Seller

**3.1.**
 Ozon Forwarder is liable to the Seller for the loss or damage of the Shipment if they occurred due to the fault of Ozon Forwarder during the period from the moment the Shipments were accepted by Ozon Forwarder, as confirmed by the "In Delivery" status in the Seller's Personal Account, and until the occurrence of any of the following moments:

(a) delivery of the Shipment to the recipient designated by the Client; or

(b) the Seller's receipt of the "Returned through Warehouse" status in the Personal Account; or

(c) return of the Shipment to the Seller or the Seller's Partner in accordance with the procedure provided for in the
["Returns to Ozon Pick-up Points"](/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/refunds/pick-up-point-returns)
 Section; or

(d) disposal of the Shipment in accordance with the procedure provided for in the
["Return, Removal and Disposal" ](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#section-“return-removal-and-disposal”)
Section.

**3.2. **
Within 5 (five) business days from the moment the status of the unaccepted Shipment changes from the "In Transit to CW" status to the "Ready for Shipment" status, which confirms the absence of the Shipment declared for transfer to the Ozon Forwarder, the Seller shall be entitled to submit reasoned objections to the acceptance of Shipments transferred in cargo places, specifying its composition, in accordance with the requirements set forth in
["Disputed orders when transferring to OGL logistics"](/zh/fulfillment/ogl/dispute/disputed-orders)
 Section, by providing the composition of the cargo place and a video recording of the assembly of the cargo place meeting the requirements of
["Video Recording of Order Packaging"](/zh/fulfillment/ogl/shipping-from-your-warehouse/video-recording)
. If the Seller fails to submit reasoned objections within the said period, the data on the acceptance results in the Personal Account shall be deemed agreed by the Parties as per Ozon's version. The date of agreement shall be the last day of the period for providing feedback by the Seller.

**3.3. **
Product contained in Shipment accepted by the Ozon Forwarder shall be deemed lost:

(a) for Client’s Returns, Non-Purchases and Cancellations — no later than 30 (thirty) days after the Seller's request stating that:

- product not subject to disposal has not been returned through the Warehouse or the Seller's Partner's warehouse in accordance with the procedure provided for in the "Return, Removal and Disposal" Section within 60 (sixty) days after acceptance of the product from the Client, the Client’s refusal of the product, or the expiration of the storage period of the product for delivery to the Client, or cancellation outside the territory of the Seller's Country; or

- product has not been returned to the Seller in accordance with the procedure provided for in
[“Returns to Ozon Pick-up Points”](/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/refunds/pick-up-point-returns)
 Section within 60 (sixty) days after cancellation of the Order if the Shipment containing such product was located in the territory of the Seller's Country at the time of cancellation of the Order;

(b) in other cases — no later than 90 (ninety) days after the Seller's claim regarding the loss of product in a Shipment accepted by the Ozon Forwarder.

Product shall not be deemed lost if it is actually in the possession of the Ozon Forwarder or Ozon, including in case of delay in its transfer to the Seller.

**3.4.**
 In the event of fault on the part of the Ozon Forwarder it shall compensate the Seller for the value of the lost or damaged goods. The amount of damages for loss or damage of goods shall be determined in accordance with the procedure provided for in the
["Liability"](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor#section-liability)
 Section.

**3.5.**
 In the event of loss of a cargo place transferred by the Pick-up or Drop-off method due to the fault of the Ozon Forwarder prior to acceptance at the Ozon Forwarder's warehouse, compensation shall be paid in full or in part based on the relevant formula:

(a) If the Seller has transferred cargo places without specifying the composition of the cargo place in the Personal Account upon loss of the cargo place by the Pick-up or Drop-off method:

[Amount of Compensation] = [Declared Value of all goods in the Seller's shipment request / Number of cargo places set by the Seller in the request] × [Light Compensation Ratio]

(b) If the Seller has transferred cargo places with specification of the composition of the cargo unit in the Personal Account by the Pick-up or Drop-off method:

[Amount of Compensation] = Σ ([Declared Value of each product in the lost cargo place] × [OGL Compensation Ratio for each product])

Where:

(a) Declared Value of the goods means the value of each product set by the Seller at the time of creation of the specific Order by the Client and recorded in the Personal Account.

(b) The Compensation Ratio is determined depending on the category and type of goods, type of delivery and price category in accordance with the table set forth in the
["Fees and Tariffs"](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees)
 Section.

In the event of transfer of cargo places with Shipments by the Seller using the Self-drop method, the Ozon Forwarder shall be liable from the moment of acceptance of the Shipments.

### “realFBS”

#### 1. DELIVERY SERVICE

#### 1.1. Choosing the Delivery Service

The Seller in the PA indicates the delivery method from among the available ones or his own Delivery Service (if such option is available in the PA). Ozon places information about the Seller’s Delivery Service in the Seller’s Product Description Page. Ozon has the right to ask the Seller for documentary confirmation of the conclusion of an agreement with the chosen Delivery Service.

#### 1.2. Delivery parameters

The Seller in his PA specifies his own delivery parameters (delivery geography, order shipment and delivery time, etc.). With a Non-integrated delivery method, the Seller undertakes to deliver by courier-to- door delivery. With an Integrated delivery method, the required delivery parameters are displayed in the Seller’s PA based on the parameters specified by the Delivery Service.

#### 1.3. Updating information about the Delivery Service

With the Non-integrated delivery method, the Seller is responsible for the validity of the specified delivery time. If, according to information available to Ozon, the delivery time specified by the Seller differs from the actual delivery times to the Client, Ozon may unilaterally adjust such delivery time settings.

With the Integrated delivery method, Ozon, on behalf of the Seller, may update the necessary delivery parameters without obligation to notify the Seller.

#### 1.4. Transfer of Orders from the Seller to the Delivery Service

**1.4.1. Order transfer procedure**

The procedure for transferring the generated orders is determined by the agreement between the Seller and the Delivery Service. Prior to the transfer of the order to the Delivery Service, the Seller undertakes to check the status of the order to ensure that the order has not been canceled or otherwise changed in status by the Client or Ozon. The Seller bears any negative consequences associated with the transfer of the order after the order has been cancelled. The Seller is responsible for the discrepancy between the transferred products to the Delivery Service and the Client's order.

**1.4.2. Terms of transfer of orders**

The Seller undertakes to assemble the order, indicate the appropriate status of the order in the PA, and also transfer the order to the Delivery Service no later than 24 (twenty-four) hours before the date of shipment of the Order. The order (properly packaged) shall be accepted by the Delivery Service before the shipment deadline. Otherwise, Ozon has the right to cancel the order by notifying the Seller no later than 2 calendar days before the actual cancellation of the order.

**1.4.3. Notice of the transfer of the order to the Delivery Service**

The Seller within 24 (twenty-four) hours shall transmit to Ozon the information about the transfer of the order to the Delivery Service, including the correct track number the tracking of which displays the status confirming the acceptance of the order by the Delivery Service.

**1.4.4. Delivery status**

With the Non-Integrated delivery method the Seller within 1 (one) calendar day from the moment the order is actually delivered to the Client indicates the current status in the PA. If the delivery status is not updated in time, Ozon has the right to cancel the order.

**1.4.5. Track number**

The Seller is obliged to provide Ozon with a valid track number to track the order using systems commonly used to track shipments moved by delivery services. If the provided track number is not tracked, Ozon may send a request to the Seller about the need to correct the track number. With the Integrated delivery method, the Seller is obliged to send a request to the Support Service to correct the track number within 2 (two) calendar days from the date of receipt of the request from Ozon.

With the Non-integrated delivery method, the Seller is obliged to correct the track number on his own in the PA within 2 (two) calendar days from the date of receipt of the request from Ozon.

Ozon has the right to cancel the order with incorrect or untraceable track number.

**1.4.6. Reliability of status**

The Seller shall be fully responsible for the accuracy of the information about the delivery status of the order. If the Seller does not timely enter information on the status of the order delivery, then Ozon has the right to cancel the order, as well as lower the quality indicators of the Seller's service, while the Seller bears the risk of all negative consequences of order cancellation. If the Order, which Ozon canceled as a result of the Seller's late provision/failure to provide the status, was actually delivered to the Seller, then Ozon is under no circumstances responsible for the negative consequences resulting from such an action/failure to act by the Seller. In the event the track number is not updated, or is updated incorrectly by the Delivery Service, as well as with the Non-integrated delivery method, Ozon, on behalf of the Seller, has the right to track the track number on its own, including through the tracking systems, and update information on the delivery status. Ozon is under no circumstances responsible for the negative consequences in case of receiving false information about the status of the order from the Seller or the Delivery Service. Ozon is under no circumstances responsible for negative consequences in case of receiving false information about the order status from the Seller or the Delivery Service.

**1.4.7. Breach of the transfer deadlines**

If the Seller does not transfer the order within the specified time frame or untimely sends Ozon information about the transfer of the order to the Delivery Service, the order is deemed not transferred, and Ozon has the right to cancel the Client’s order, as well as lower the Seller’s service quality indicators.

**1.4.8. Breach of delivery time**

If the Seller does not ensure compliance with the delivery time of the order to the Client, Ozon has the right to cancel the Client's order. Ozon has the right to send a request to the Seller to clarify the actual delivery time. The Seller is obliged to respond to Ozon within 1 (one) calendar day from the receipt of the request.

#### 2. LOGISTICS PARTNER (AGGREGATOR)

#### 2.1. Subject and cost of services

Ozon undertakes, for a remuneration, to execute, on the instruction of the Seller, on its own behalf and at the expense of the Seller, transactions with Logistics Partners related to the provision of freight forwarding services for the organization of international transportation by the latter of Shipments of the Seller to the Client, and to undertake other actions on its own behalf, but at the expense of the Seller in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Section.

**2.1.1. Conditions for the provision of freight forwarding services**

Ozon enters into the transactions with the Logistics Parnters on the terms and conditions determined by this Section and the
[Logistics Partners Regulations (when providing freight forwarding services for organizing the international transportation)](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/partners/logistics/crossborder-regulation/)
.

The Seller instructs Ozon to independently determine with Logistics Partners the conditions for the provision of freight forwarding services for the organization of international transportation of the Seller's Shipments, including, but not limited to, the delivery time of the Shipments to the Clients, the terms for the provision of other services provided by Logistics Partners, the cost of the services of Logistics Partners, the procedure for providing services.

The Seller instructs Ozon to independently make changes in the delivery parameters of the Seller’s Shipments in the following cases, notifying the Seller thereof:

(a) in case of errors in the parameters set by the Sellers that do not allow delivery of the Shipment;

(b) when improving the parameters of delivery of Shipments;

(c) in
[other cases](/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/partner-delivery-ozon/#修改配送参数)
.

**2.1.2. Informational and technical support of Ozon**

Ozon within the framework of this Section shall provide informational and technical support of Shipments delivered to Clients, with the exception of Cancelled Shipments and other Shipments not delivered to the Client for any reason, for which Logistics Partner and the Seller interact independently without the involvement of Ozon, including, but not limited to, mutual settlements, return delivery and/or return of the Shipments to the Seller for any possible reason and/or their disposal. Ozon provides the Logistics Partner with Seller’s contact details to ensure such interaction between the Logistics Partner and the Seller.

**2.1.3. The moment of fulfillment of obligations**

Ozon’s obligations, specified in this Section, in respect of each Shipment transferred to Logistics Partner for the purpose of delivery to the Client, are considered to be properly executed at the time of delivery of the corresponding Shipment to the Client when the Shipment is considered delivered based on the Status “Delivered” or at the moment when the Status “Returned through Warehouse” assigned to the Shipment.

**2.1.4. Risk of accidental destruction or damage**

Logistics Partner is responsible for the non-safety of the product and/or the Shipment that occurred after it was accepted for transportation and until the moment it was handed over to the Recipient. Non-safety means not only the loss of the Shipment, but also its shortage or damage.

Logistics Partner bears the risk of accidental loss or damage to the product transferred to him for the purpose of international transportation, from the moment of acceptance from the Sender until the moment of delivery to the Recipient.

2.1.5. Agency fee of Ozon and rates of Logistics Partners for the provision of freight forwarding services under this Section are set out in the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/partner-delivery-rates)
 Section.

#### 2.2. Procedure for provision of services

2.2.1. The conditions for the provision of freight forwarding services for the organization of international transportation are set out in the
[Logistics Partners Regulations (when providing freight forwarding services for organizing the international transportation)](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/partners/logistics/crossborder-regulation/)
.

**2.2.2. Confirmation of readiness of Shipments**

The Seller is obliged to confirm the readiness of the Shipment for transfer before the Cut-off. If the Seller fails to do so within the specified period, Logistics Partner may not accept the Shipment for delivery and Ozon may cancel the Client’s order.

The Seller, prior to the transfer of the Shipment, is obliged to indicate the actual weight of each product, otherwise the Seller will not be able to confirm the readiness of the Shipments for transfer.

**2.2.3. Order Processing**

The Seller, with his own forces and at his own expense, forms the products in the Order into a Shipment for the transfer to Logistics Partner. The Seller is obliged to pack the product in such a way as to ensure its safety during delivery and a neat appearance.

**2.2.4. Transfer of the Shipment**

The Seller transfers the product strictly in accordance with the list in the Order. In case of non-compliance, the Seller assumes the risk of any negative consequences and compensates for all documented losses in connection therewith. If it is found that the declared products are missing (shortage) in the Shipment, Ozon withholds from the Seller the amount actually paid by the Client for the product, without refunding the Fee as a fee for processing the shortage.

**2.2.5. Information about the number of Shipments in the Order**

After the receipt of the Order, but before confirmation of the readiness of the Shipments for transfer to Logistics Partner, the Seller is obliged to provide information on the number of Shipments included in the Order.

**2.2.6. Drop-off transmission**

The transfer of Shipments from the Seller to Logistics Partner is carried out by the “Drop-off” method: Logistics Partner accepts the Shipments at its warehouse.

**2.2.7. Information for the transfer of Shipments**

For the “Drop-off” method of receiving Shipments, the Seller selects an address for receiving from among the available warehouses of Logistics Partners. If the Seller has not transferred any of the Shipments to the selected warehouse of Logistics Partner within 30 (thirty) calendar days, as well as in other cases when the Seller’s service at the selected warehouse is impossible, Ozon may, with prior notice to the Seller, stop the possibility of accepting the Shipments at the selected warehouse and offer the Seller to choose another one from among those available (if any).

**2.2.8. Delivery times for Shipments**

If the Cut-off for Orders is set on the current day, the Seller transfers the Shipment to Logistics Partner on the same day.

Logistics Partner within the time limits specified in the Seller's Personal Account (no more than 10 (ten) calendar days). In case of violation of the terms of transfer to Logistics Partner due to the fault of the Seller, Logistics Partner may refuse to accept Shipments.

**2.2.9. Accompanying documents**

The Seller shall transfer Shipments to Logistics Partner with the accompanying documents printed from the Personal Account that are relevant at the time of transfer (subject to possible cancellations): Acceptance Certificate of the Shipments, the bill of lading, or another transfer document. At the request of Ozon, the Seller is obliged to provide scans of all documents confirming the actual transfer of Shipments to Logistics Partner within 5 (five) business days from the date of the relevant Notification.

The Seller shall transfer Shipments strictly in accordance with the list in the accompanying documents. In the event of non-compliance, the Seller assumes the risk of any negative consequences and compensates Ozon for documented losses incurred when returning the erroneously transferred Shipment.

Logistics Partner shall accept Shipments based on the number of Shipments. In the event of a discrepancy in the number of Shipments, the Seller is responsible for the compliance of the Shipments with the list in the accompanying documents.

**2.2.10. Shipment Statuses**

Logistics Partner checks the compliance of the weight characteristics with the characteristics of the product declared in Shipments.

If Logistics Partner has identified discrepancies, it may, at its option:

(a) not accept such Shipment and send it back to the Seller;

(b) accept the Shipment if the packaging requirements are met and change the data on the weight characteristics. The Seller agrees to a possible change in the cost of the services of Logistics Partner re-billed by Ozon to the Seller, based on the actual data on the Shipment.

Upon completion of the acceptance of Shipments at the warehouse of Logistics Partner, the status of Shipments in the Personal Account is subject to change indicating:

(a) Full compliance of the received Shipments with the accompanying documents. In this case, the Parties acknowledge that Shipments have been transferred by the Seller to Logistics Partner in the quantity and numbers according to the accompanying documents; or

(b) Partial compliance of accepted Shipments. Ozon sends to the Seller in the Personal Account and/or by e- mail a Certificate of Discrepancy in the list of Shipments with accompanying documents.

**2.2.11. Coordination of number of received Shipments**

The Seller, no later than the day of the next Shipment after the dispatch of the Certificate of Discrepancy, has the right to raise reasoned objections and, within 3 (three) business days, to provide evidence of the transfer of the number of Shipments declared in the Acceptance Certificate (including, but not limited to, video recordings of the assembly process of Shipments or cargo space that allow the disputed Shipments to be identified). If the Seller does not provide evidence within the specified period, the Parties consider the Certificate of Discrepancy as agreed by the Parties, and the Shipments are accepted by Ozon in the quantity and by numbers in accordance with the Certificate of Discrepancy. If unidentified Shipments are detected upon acceptance, the Seller undertakes to remove them from the address specified by Logistics Partner within 7 (Seven) calendar days from the date of approval of the Certificate of Discrepancy.

**2.2.12. Logistics Partner Liability Limits for Shipments and Goods**

Logistics Partner is liable to the Seller for the loss or damage of the Shipment if they occurred due to the fault of Logistics Partner during the period from the moment the Shipments were received by Logistics Partner until the Shipments were handed over to the Clients.

Logistics Partner shall reimburse the Seller for the cost of lost/missing/damaged product and Ozon will exert its best efforts to ensure that the relevant reimbursement is made no later than the date on which funds are transferred under the Contract based on the results of the approval of reporting documents for the month in which a positive decision on the Seller's claim was made.

In case of Client’s Returns, Non-Purchases or Cancellations, the Seller may submit a claim regarding a Shipment that has not been received at the Warehouse, the Seller's warehouse, or the Seller's Partner's warehouse within 60 calendar days, not later than 30 calendar days from the date of expiration of the specified 60-day period, subject to the
[terms of the Logistics Partners Regulations (when providing freight forwarding services for organizing the international transportation)](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/partners/logistics/crossborder-regulation/)
. 

#### 2.3. Transfer of rights and obligations under an agreement with Logistics Partner in respect of Cancelled Shipments

2.3.1. The Parties have agreed that Ozon’s rights and obligations under the agreement with Logistics Partner with respect to Cancelled Shipments shall be transferred to the Seller no later than the date of occurrence of the Cancelled Shipment. For the avoidance of doubt, Ozon's rights and obligations under the agreement with the Logistics Partner with respect to Non-Purchase shall not be transferred to the Seller.

2.3.2. Ozon, by sending a notice to the Seller in the Personal Account, transfers its rights and obligations under the agreement with Logistics Partner in relation to Cancelled Shipments, the standard terms of which are located at:
[https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/partners/logistics/crossborder-delivery/](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/partners/logistics/crossborder-delivery)
. If the Seller fails to contact the Logistic Partner within 30 (thirty) calendar days from the date of notice to the Seller, the Logistic Partner is entitled to dispose of such Cancelled Shipments.

2.3.3. The rights and obligations under the agreement with Logistics Partner are considered transferred to the Seller on the date the latter receives the relevant notification in the PA.

2.3.4. Upon notification to the Seller, Ozon shall notify Logistics Partner of the transfer to the Seller of the rights and obligations under the agreement with Logistics Partner in respect of Cancelled Shipments, including Ozon shall be entitled to provide the Logistics Partner with the Seller's contact details so that the Logistics Partner can independently contact the Seller regarding such Cancelled Shipments.

2.3.5. The cost of transferred rights and obligations under the agreement with Logistics Partner is included in the current Ozon remuneration specified in this Section.

2.3.6. Logistics Partner disposes Cancelled Shipments in accordance with the terms and conditions of the delivery method chosen by the Seller in the PA specified in the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/partner-delivery-rates)
 Section, unless the Contract provides otherwise.

2.3.7. Logistics Partner has the right to dispose of Cancelled Shipments, the price of Goods in which does not exceed 1500 rubles at the
[Conversion Rate](/zh/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate)
 on the date of the relevant Order in the Personal Account.

2.3.8. In case of disposal of Cancelled Shipments in accordance with the terms of the Contract, the cost of the disposed Cancelled Shipments shall not be reimbursed to the Seller.

## SECTION “SALES FROM THE SELLER’S PARTNER’S WAREHOUSE”

### 1. Sales schemes from the Seller’s Partner’s warehouse

For the sale of goods from the Seller’s Partner’s warehouse, the following sales schemes shall be available to the Seller:

(a) FBP — The Seller transfers the Shipments for delivery to the Client from the warehouse of the Partner engaged by the Seller.

### “FBP”

#### 1. Integration with the Partner’s warehouse

If the opportunity to choose the Partner’s warehouse is available to the Seller in the Personal Account, Ozon integrates, on the Seller’s instruction, with such Partner (Fulfillment Partner) of the Seller for the purpose of transmitting statuses (including acceptance, processing, storage, shipment of products) on behalf of the Seller. Services under this Contract may be provided by the Partners.

Ozon organizes the interaction between the Seller and the Partners, with whom the Seller concludes the contract.

#### 2. Terms of interaction with Fulfillment Partner

Ozon transmits to the Fulfillment Partners the Seller’s contact details provided by the Seller during registration on the Platform or later in the Personal Account. The Seller has the right to provide the Fulfillment Partner with the access to his/her Personal Account, thereby instructing the Fulfillment Partner to perform actions in the Personal Account, which are necessary to perform such instructions. Ozon shall not be held liable for the Fulfillment Partner’s actions in the Seller’s Personal Account.

## SECTION “RETURN, REMOVAL AND DISPOSAL”

### 1. Product return

Subject to the consumer protection legislation of the Russian Federation the Client may refuse the products at any time before receiving them as well as return products to the Seller in accordance with the
[Terms of sale of goods for Individuals](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/pravila-prodayoi-i-rekvizity/usloviya-prodayoi-tovarov-dlya-fizicheskih-lits-v-ozon-ru/?country=RU)
, taking into account the specifics established in the Contract.

The Seller instructs Ozon to determine the conditions for return of products from Clients, including Non-Purchase and Client’s Returns, that do not worsen the Client's situation as compared to the requirements of the legislation of Country of destination, including determining the period for returning products.

### 2. Terms for pre-moderation of Client’s Returns

Ozon provides the Seller with the functionality of pre-moderation of Client’s Returns in the PA, which is the process of preliminary consideration by the Seller of Clients’ requests for the return of products and making a decision on the request within 1 (one) calendar day.

The Client makes a request for product return and chooses the method of transferring the products to the Seller from among the available ones in the Client’s personal account.

The Seller shall consider such a request and within 1 (one) calendar day make one of the following decisions (pre-moderation of return):

(a) agree on the transfer of the products by the Client for return;

(b) return the money to the Client without actually transferring the products for a return;

(c) partially compensate the cost of the products or the cost of the repair of the products to the Client (if such option is available in the PA) without actually transferring the products for a return;

(d) reasonably refuse to approve the return of a product.

The Seller informs Ozon on the return decision, based on which Ozon refunds the money paid for the product to the Client. Settlements between the Parties shall be made in accordance with the procedure stipulated by the Section 3 of the Contract.

In case the price of products in the Personal Account does not exceed 1800 rubles at the
[Conversion Rate](/zh/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate)
 on the date of the Order, the Seller instructs Ozon to carry out the pre-moderation of Client’s Return on behalf and at the expense of the Seller and make a decision on the return independently.

The Client is entitled to challenge the Seller's decision by making request to the Support Service. Ozon considers the Client's request and verifies the reasonableness of the Seller's negative decision. If the decision to refuse to approve the return is unreasonable, the Seller acknowledges and agrees that Ozon has the right to approve the Client's request, make a refund of funds for the products and deduct these funds from the Seller.

In addition, the Client and the Seller have the right to involve Ozon in the proceedings on the request, recognizing Ozon's decision as binding on the Parties.

The Seller agrees that in case of repeated unreasonable refusal to approve the return requests or no decision on return request within 24 hours Ozon has the right, at its own discretion, to refuse to allow the Seller to carry out the pre-moderation of return and make a decision on the return independently. In this case, Ozon will carry out the pre-moderation of return on behalf and at the expense of the Seller.

Ozon has the right, at its own discretion, to impose restrictions on the Seller's pre-moderation of returns for certain return reasons.

#### 2.1 Partial compensation of the cost of the products

If there is a possibility of partial compensation of the cost of products in the Personal Account, the Seller has the right to offer partial compensation to the Client, the amount of which shall be approved by the Client. In this case, the Seller instructs Ozon to return funds to the Client in the amount of such partial compensation. If the Client doesn’t approve the amount of partial compensation, the Seller shall consider the Client’s request again and make a decision based on the options available to him in the PA. Ozon is entitled to offer partial compensation to the Client on behalf and at the expense of the Seller, subject to the provisions of clause 2 hereof. As part of such partial compensation, the Seller instructs Ozon to offer the Client to repair the products in a service center, as well as to compensate the Client for the expenses incurred (at the expense of the Seller).

The Client who has received compensation has the right to return the product for other reasons and Ozon will return to the Seller the paid amount for partial compensation.

### 3. Processing of Individual Cases of Returns

#### 3.1. Procedure for considering a claim and appeal

Ozon receives the Client’s claim and/or the appeal regarding the improper quality of the products and forwards it to the Seller for consideration in the order and terms specified in the clause 2 hereof.

Ozon or the Seller shall inform the Client the address for returning the products within 1 (one) calendar day. In the absence of a full and correct address of the Seller’s warehouse for accepting the returned products, the Seller instructs Ozon to make a refund to the Client without the obligation to transfer the products. The Seller shall provide a full and correct address written in Latin or Cyrillic in the Personal Account for accepting the returned products.

The Seller instructs Ozon to compensate the Client for the return shipment when the Client provides a receipt for the shipment of products of improper quality by deducting the cost of shipment from the funds to be transferred to the Seller under the Contract.

#### 3.2. Refund based on expert opinion

If the Client provides an expert opinion confirming the manufacturing defect, the return is possible within a reasonable time, but in any case no more than two years from the date of receipt of the products. The Seller compensates the Client for the cost of the products, the costs incurred for the examination, as well as the costs of returning the products of improper quality upon presentation by the Client of the receipt of the products dispatch.

### 4. Costs of returning products and funds to the Client

The Seller bears all possible costs, including those related to exchange rate differences in case of money return to the Client.

The Seller is obliged to reimburse Ozon for the cost of the returned products indicated in the PA at the moment of execution of order by the Client (by deducting funds in accordance with the Contract), as well as the costs of delivery of the returned products to the Partner (if any) in case of returning product to the pick-up point through the Partner.

### 5. Checking the product after receipt by the Seller

Except for the return of products by the Client in accordance with the clauses 6 and 7, the Seller shall receive and check the products within 40 (forty) calendar days from the date of sending the products by the Client, as well as notify the Support Service about the products receipt. Otherwise, Ozon will return the money for the products to the Client without agreement with the Seller. The products are considered received by the Seller on the 41st (forty-first) calendar day of shipment.

### 6. Return of products through the Partner (to the pick-up point)

The Seller instructs Ozon to organize acceptance of the Client’s Returns and Non-Purchases, which includes products receipt from the Client and handling over the products returned by the Client to the Seller.

The Seller instructs Ozon to transfer the products accepted from the Client in the pick-up point to the Seller’s Partner, in whose system the Seller is or will be registered. By registering in the Partner's system, the Seller instructs Ozon to transfer the returned products to such Partner as if the product was transferred directly to the Seller.

If the Seller has no registration in the Partner’s system or the work with the Partner is suspended or terminated in case of return of products to the pick-up point of Ozon, the Seller undertakes to collect the products from the sorting center or the pick-up point within 10 calendar days from the time the products are ready for collection.

Ozon also may assign a part of its obligations to the Partner, including the obligation to transfer the product returned by the Client to the Seller. Such assignment will be deemed executed at the moment of transfer of product from Ozon to the Partner, about which the Seller will be notified in the Personal Account.

From the date of transfer/assignment the obligation to return the product arises directly from the Partner to the Seller, without Ozon's involvement. Ozon's obligation to return the product to the Seller is deemed terminated from the date of receipt by the Seller of the notification of the assignment (transfer of products to the Partner) in the Personal Account.

Ozon notifies the Seller of the status of receipt of products from the Client and transfer of products to the Partner in the Personal Account. The Seller is obliged to timely check the Personal Account for information about the status of returned products.

The condition of the returned products shall not be assessed during the acceptance. The Parties acknowledge that the packaging of the products may differ from that one in which the Seller handed over the products, but shall ensure the safety of the products inside the shipment.

The address of the Partner's warehouse and the time limits for the Seller to take out the products (but not more than 14 (fourteen) days) shall be indicated in the Personal Account.

If the Seller fails to remove the products within the specified time limits, the Partner of Ozon has the right to realize the Disposal of the products, and the cost of the disposed products shall not be compensated to the Seller.

After the Client has handed over the returned products to the Partner, the Seller shall deal directly with the Partner (without Ozon's involvement) on any issues regarding such products, including any claims.

### 7. Return of products through the Warehouse

The Seller instructs Ozon to organize acceptance of Client’s Returns, Cancellations and Non-Purchases from the Client or the Delivery Service through the Warehouse for the purposes of re-selling product by indication in the Personal Account if the Product simultaneously meets all the specified criteria:

(a) the Client has not claimed on the quality of the Product;

(b) the Product may be accepted at the Warehouse and not included in the list of prohibited products;

(c) the price of the Product exceeds 500 rubles in the Personal Account at the
[Conversion Rate](/zh/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate)
 on the date of the Order.

The Seller instructs Ozon to reduce the price of the product to be returned through the Warehouse by the amount of the applicable VAT rate or other similar tax in respect of the products upon its re-sale with respect to the provisions of clause 3.3.9.1. of the Contract.

Ozon has the right to identify specific products and categories that are or are not subject to return through the Warehouse based on legal requirements, logistical constraints and customer needs.

From the moment of delivery to the Warehouse, the Product becomes available to the re-selling on the Platform.

When returning Client’s Returns, Cancellations and Non- Purchases through the Warehouse Ozon provides the Seller with following services:

(a) return logistics – reception of Client’s Returns, Cancellations and Non-Purchases and delivery to the Warehouse;

(b) processing of Client’s Returns, Cancellations and Non-Purchases – acceptance of product by the nearest Warehouse and, if necessary, check of its condition;

(c) processing of Client’s Returns, Cancellations and Non-Purchases by Ozon Partners – delivery of the return by courier to the nearest pick-up point or pick-up point’s fee for receiving, processing and transfer of Client’s Return, Cancellation or Non-Purchase to Ozon;

(d) logistics – collecting, packing products into orders, sorting and handling in a Warehouse and delivering;

(e) delivery to the pick-up point — delivery of the order to the pick-up point for the Client;

(f) other services.

The cost of the service is set in the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees)
 Section.

Services are deemed rendered:

(a) return logistics — receipt of the Client’s Return, Cancellation, Non-Purchase to the Warehouse;

(b) processing of Client’s Return, Cancellation, Non-Purchase — acceptance of the Client’s Return, Cancellation, Non-Purchase in the Warehouse;

(c) processing of Client’s Returns, Cancellations and Non-Purchases by Ozon Partners – acceptance of the Client’s Return, Cancellation, Non-Purchase at the pick-up point;

(d) logistics — at the time of delivery of the product to sorting center;

(e) delivery to the pickup point — at the moment the product is handed over to the Client, or upon Cancellation, or in case of Non-Purchase.

#### 7.1. Check of the product returned through the Warehouse

To ensure safety, compliance with the rules of placement and additional quality control, Ozon has the right to re- determine the readiness of the product for sale by moving it inside the Warehouse and checking it, including opening any package.

In order to resell the product, Ozon has the right to unilaterally determine the Seller’s need for the product in other Warehouses and, if necessary, move the product from one Warehouse to another Warehouse.

#### 7.2. Discount

Ozon has the right to provide the Client with a discount on any product at the Seller's expense in case of damage to its packaging or other minor defect, indicating such a defect in the Product Description Page (discount). The discount amount is determined based on the degree of damage to the product or its deficiency in accordance with the
[Terms of the discount](/zh/products/price-reduction/)
, provided that the price of the product after applying the discount is not less than the minimum product price. The Seller has the right to set a different discount.

If the Seller does not agree with the discount when returning through the Warehouse, it has the right to refuse to apply discounts to its products by sending a Support request, which Ozon reviews within 5 business days.

#### 7.3. Liability of the Parties for the Return of products through the Warehouse

Ozon is responsible for the loss or damage of the Seller’s goods caused by Ozon, except in cases where:

(a) with respect to Client’s Return and Non-Purchase, this occurred prior to the acceptance of the product from the Client, the Client’s refusal of the product, or the expiration of the storage period of the product for delivery to the Client;

(b) with respect to the Cancellation, — this occurred prior to the transfer of the product to the Warehouse and could not be detected by Ozon, including the product shortage in the cargo place with undamaged packaging;

(c) the reason was incorrect packaging.

The product accepted in the Warehouse is considered lost no later than 30 calendar days after the Seller’s request that the product was not delivered to the Warehouse within 60 calendar days after the product was accepted from the Client, the Client’s refusal of the product, expiration of the storage period of the product for delivery or Cancellation.

7.4. The provisions of clause 2.3. of the Section
[“Logistics Partner (Aggregator)”](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor#2-3-transfer-of-rights-and-obligations-under-an-agreement-with-logistics-partner-in-respect-of-cancelled-shipments)
 do not apply to products returned through the Warehouse.

### 8. Product Disposal

#### 8.1. Grounds for Disposal of products

Ozon destroys the products and provides the Seller with a Disposal service:

(a) at the Seller's request via the Personal Account if it is technically possible;

(b) with the Seller's implied consent, at any time and without further notice to the Seller.

Ozon destroys the products in a way that meets the requirements of the laws. Ozon displays in the Seller's Personal Account the status of Disposal of products. The Seller is obliged to timely check the Personal Account for information about the statuses of Disposal.

The Disposal service shall be charged in accordance with the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/returns-expenses)
 Section and is deemed rendered at the time when the products are assigned the status of "For Disposal"/"Disposed of". Ozon shall not compensate the Seller for the cost of the products if the Disposal has been carried out on any of the grounds set out in the Contract.

#### 8.2. Disposal of products with the Seller’s implied consent

The Seller is deemed to have duly consented to the Disposal in the following cases:

(a) if the Seller fails to collect the returns in the manner and within the time limits specified in the clause 6 of this Section, at the date of expiration of such time limit;

(b) if the Client returns to the pick-up point a product, the price of which does not exceed 5000 rubles in the Personal Account at the Conversion Rate on the date of the Order, and for which the Seller has not indicated a return through the Warehouse in the Personal Account, at the date the Client returns the products to the pick-up point.

(c) if, after the Client returns the products, Ozon discovers damage that renders the products unsuitable for further transport, at the date when Ozon discovers such damage;

(d) if the product was returned through the Warehouse and was not sold within 120 calendar days from the date of acceptance at the Warehouse, at the date of the expiration of such period;

(e) if the product, upon return through the Warehouse, was not sold in accordance with the
[established number of re-sale attempts](https://global-help.ozon.com/en/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/where-send-returns#under-what-circumstances-the-product-is-disposed-of)
 for product category (as a result of Client’s return, Cancellation or Non-purchase) — on the date of the last unsuccessful re-sale attempt;

(f) if upon termination of the Contract the Seller has goods available for sale through the Warehouse, at the date of Contract termination;

(g) if the Seller has transferred to Ozon products from the
[List of Prohibited Products](/zh/policies/product-rules-and-documents/product-rules/special-categories)
, at the date when Ozon discovers such products.

In case of disagreement with the Disposal, the Seller has the right to submit reasoned objections for compensation of the cost of the disposed Product within 30 calendar days from the date of the Disposal specified in the Personal Account. The Seller shall attach a video of its batching to the objections on damaged product, in the absence of which Ozon shall refuse to consider the objections.

## SECTION “PROMOTION SERVICES FOR SELLER’S GOODS AND ADVERTISING SERVICES”

### 1. SUBJECT

#### 1.1. Services for the promotion of products and advertising services

In addition to the obligations set forth by the Contract, Ozon may provide the Seller on its behalf with following services:

(A) Electronic services for the promotion of certain products or brand available to the Seller and other electronic services, including provision the Seller with an access to the analytics data and Technical services (services of technical and information nature) as well as other services;

(B) Advertising services that include the placement of the Advertising Materials of the Seller in the Recommendation Blocks on the Platform and on other websites in order and within the terms hereunder;

(C) Other types of services separately agreed by the Parties.

### 2. GENERAL PROVISIONS

#### 2.1. Rights of Ozon

Ozon shall have a right:

(a) to change format and design of the Recommendation Block without the Seller's consent;

(b) not to accept for placement the Advertising Materials that do not comply with requirements of the
[Requirements for Advertising Materials Section](/zh/promotion/media-ads/requirements/)
;

(c) to determine independently a list of Ozon partner websites for placement of the Recommendation Blocks with the Seller's products;

(d) to delete data in the Advertising Campaign Section upon expiry of six months after the turning off, without a possibility of further data recovery;

(e) in order to increase quality of provided services, to conduct tests, in the framework of which the Advertising Materials display in the Recommendation Blocks can take place with changes in format, design of the Recommendation Block and the terms of display;

(f) to suspend the provision of the services to the Seller due to technical, technological and other problems delaying the provision of the Services, while eliminating these problems.

#### 2.2. Guarantee of compliance with the law

The Seller guarantees compliance with the effective laws of the Russian Federation, including compliance with the requirements of the Federal Law No. 38-FZ dated March 13, 2006 "On advertising".

#### 2.3. Documents request

At the request of Ozon, within 1 (one) calendar day, the Seller shall provide Ozon with documents confirming compliance with the laws of the Russian Federation, including the Federal Law No. 38-FZ dated March 13, 2006 "On advertising".

### 3. PROCEDURE FOR THE PROVISION OF SERVICES

#### 3.1. List of Advertising materials

The Seller shall determine independently the list of products for promotion and the Advertising Materials by adding them to the Advertising Campaign Section in the PA. Ozon shall verify Banners for compliance with the Advertising Materials Requirements Section within 2 (two) business days. Ozon shall be entitled to refuse provision of services for the promotion of products, as well as advertising services in relation to any Advertising Material, including without explaining the reasons.

#### 3.2. Type of advertising campaign

The Seller shall determine independently the type of advertising campaign from the number of available ones for each of the Advertising Materials.

#### 3.3. Advertising material placement

The Seller shall determine independently a place for each Advertising Material placement from the number of available ones.

#### 3.4. Rate definition

The Seller shall determine independently the Rate of Ozon Remuneration for each of the Advertising Materials within the limits agreed upon by the Parties. The more is the Rate amount, the higher is the probability of Display in the Recommendation Block, subject to other factors (relevance of the offer for specific Client, etc.).

#### 3.5. Start of advertising services

Ozon shall start to provide advertising services in the following events:

(a) in relation to all Advertising Materials added to the Advertising Campaign Section, when the Seller sets a "Turn On" status in the Advertising Campaign Section in the PA, at the same time, if the Seller did not fix the Rate amount, the minimal rate will be applied;

(b) in relation to specific Advertising Material, when the Seller adds it to the Advertising Campaign Section and fixes the Rate amount, provided that the "Turn On" status is set.

#### 3.6. Termination of advertising services

Ozon shall terminate to provide services in the following events:

(a) in relation to all Advertising Materials added to the Advertising Campaign Section, when the Seller sets a "Turn Off" status in the Advertising Campaign Section in the PA;

(b) in relation to specific Advertising Material, when the Seller deletes it from the Advertising Campaign Section, provided that the "Turn On" status is set;

(c) in relation to all products and Banners, in the event if the total cost of Ozon services for the reporting period exceeds the limit set by the Seller in the PA, or if the Seller has a debt on any services provided under the Contract.

#### 3.7. Statistics

Ozon shall provide the Seller in the PA with statistics containing data on Displays and on amount of attracted products. The Parties shall recognize Ozon statistics as the sole reliable source of determination of the amount of services provided and the amount of Ozon remuneration.

#### 3.8. Suspension of services

Ozon shall have a right to suspend provision of electronic, technical and/or advertising services in relation to the Advertising Material in the event that a fact of presence of unauthentic information in it is revealed, or in the event of other violation of requirements to products and Advertising Materials set forth by the Contract.

#### 3.9. Additional services

By agreement of the Parties, Ozon may provide the Seller with services for the special placement of Advertising Materials. The Seller sends a request to Ozon for the provision of such services through the PA or by e-mail. If the Parties agree on the parameters for the provision of services, Ozon posts information about essential conditions (Advertising Materials, terms and procedure for special placement) of their provision in the PA, and the Seller accepts them by pressing the "Confirm" button.

#### 3.10. General provisions about promotions

The Seller may provide the Clients with discounts on the products.

In order to provide discounts, the Seller in the Personal Account:

(a) launches its own promotion and independently determines the terms, products, conditions, etc.; or

(b) adds products to one of the Ozon’s promotions (the conditions and terms of these promotions are determined by Ozon independently); or

(c) selects products to be added to the promotion, suggested to be added by Ozon. Ozon has the right to suggest the Seller to participate in the promotion by adding products to the promotion at least 5 (five) business days prior to its start and by sending the relevant Notice.  The Seller changes the list of products added to the promotion at its own discretion within a certain number of days, specified by Ozon, before the start of the promotion (if such a period is specified by Ozon). Upon the expiration of the period specified by Ozon, the Seller shall recognize all added products as participating in the promotion in full compliance with the terms and conditions of such promotion.

The Seller may set the minimum product price in the Personal Account for the purpose of considering it by Ozon when adding a product to the promotions. The Seller confirms the setting of considering the minimum product price in the promotions in the Personal Account every 30 days for remaining it active. If the Seller doesn’t activate the setting in the Personal Account, the minimum product price won’t be considered by Ozon when a product is added to the promotions and when the size of the discount is determined. At the same time, the Seller may activate the setting in the Personal Account at any time, in this case, the minimum product price will be considered when products will be added to the promotions next time.

In order to launch own promotion, the Seller independently determines in the Personal Account:

- Type of the promotion;

- Promotion period;

- Parameters of the buyers’ audience;

- List of products (from among those available to be added to the promotion);

- Other necessary conditions.

The Seller launches the promotion by changing the status to "Active" in the Personal Account.

By launching its own promotion or adding products to the Ozon’s promotion, the Seller unconditionally agrees that the discount is provided to the Clients on behalf and at the expense of the Seller on the terms and conditions specified in the Personal Account, and for such discount
[Points for discounts](/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/#2-4-product-discounts-points-for-discounts)
 are not awarded.

#### 3.11. Brand promotion

The Seller may order electronic service for the promotion of brand through customizing settings in the PA, and Ozon undertakes to provide with such a service for an additional fee. The Service for the promotion of brand includes the services listed on the page
["Promoted Brands"](/zh/promotion/product-promotions/promoted-brands/)
.

The Seller also has the right to order the service for the promotion of brand that is already connected and promoted on the Platform by third parties, specifying the necessary parameters in the PA.

If other persons connect the service for the promotion of brand specified in the Seller's Product Description Pages, Ozon will notify the Seller about this in the PA. From the moment of notice, the Seller is provided with a trial use the service for the period specified in the PA. During this period the Seller has the right to refuse the service by disconnecting it in the PA. Upon expiration of the period specified in the PA, the service is considered to be ordered by the Seller and is subject to payment in accordance with the
[ Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/commissions-for-other-services/)
.

By ordering the service in the PA, the Seller fully and unconditionally agrees to the service provision terms and conditions.

The Seller has the right to refuse the service in the PA at any time.

#### 3.12. “Brand Verified” Electronic Badge Service

The Seller may order the “Brand Verified” electronic badge service for an unlimited number of brands (hereinafter referred to as the “Brand Verified” Service).

The “Brand Verified” Service includes the “Brand Verified” badge on the Seller’s Product Description Page on the Website for the relevant brand. The Seller may choose to receive “Brand Verified” electronic badge service from among those available in Personal Account. To activate the “Brand Verified” Service, the Seller shall provide documents on the brand and comply with the conditions, specified in the

.  The Seller has the right to unilaterally refuse the “Brand Verified” Service in the PA. The cost of the “Brand Verified” Service is indicated in the PA and the
[Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/commissions-for-other-services/)
.

If there are reasonable suspicions of intellectual property rights infringement in accordance with the legislation of Country of destination, Ozon has the right to unilaterally suspend the “Brand Verified” Service and request additional documents. If the infringement is not confirmed, the “Brand Verified” Service can be reactivated by the Seller; if the infringement is confirmed, Ozon will unilaterally terminate the “Brand Verified” Service.

The Parties, guided by Article 381.1 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, agreed to secure the Seller’s obligations regarding compliance of intellectual property rights under the Contract with a securing payment in the amount specified in the
[Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees)
. When registering on the Platform or
[in other cases](/zh/policies/product-rules-and-documents/documents/originality-confirmation/security-deposit)
 the Seller undertakes to pay the amount of money specified in the Personal Account as the Securing Payment. The Securing Payment can be made through the Payment Service Provider, as specified in the PA. In this case, the moment of fulfillment of the Seller’s obligation to make the Securing Payment in favor of Ozon will be the date of debiting the funds from the Seller’s account to Ozon. Upon termination of the Contract or cancellation of the secured obligation the Securing Payment made by the Seller is subject to return minus the amount of the Seller's unfulfilled obligation (the penalty) in the manner and amount established in the
[Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/fines/)
. Interest on the amount of the Securing Payment, including those established by Art. 317.1 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, are not accrued. The Securing Payment is not a penalty, an advance or a deposit within the meaning of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation.

### 4. REMUNERATION OF OZON

#### 4.1. Remuneration amount

Procedure of Ozon remuneration payment shall be determined depending on the type of service and/or the type of advertising campaign chosen by the Seller. The total sum of Remuneration for the services provided by this section makes the total of Rates. Remuneration shall be displayed in the PA of the Seller in the Advertising Campaign Section and shall be determined basing on Ozon statistics.

The amount, procedure and terms of remuneration for the electronic service for the promotion of brand are specified in the
[ Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/commissions-for-other-services/)
.

The Seller guarantees that he has all IPRs in relation to the promoted Product.

#### 4.2. Calculation of remuneration on CPC

Ozon remuneration (CPC Rate) shall make an amount in rubles.

#### 4.3. Calculation of remuneration on CPM

Ozon remuneration (CPM Rate) shall make an amount in rubles.

#### 4.4. Attracted Product price

For the purposes of Ozon remuneration calculation, Attracted Product Price is a price fixed by the Seller and determined at the moment of execution of order by the Client on the Website.

#### 4.5. Limits of the Rate amount

The Seller shall determine Rates amount within the limits of maximal and minimal values set by Ozon in the PA.

#### 4.6. Remuneration payment procedure

Remuneration payment to Ozon that is calculated at the rates specified in the PA, on the base of the amount of services provided in the reporting period and converted at the rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation on the date of provision of the relevant service specified in the PA shall be carried out by deduction from the funds due to the Seller and being transferred in accordance with the Contract. In the event of negative balance on the account of the Seller, the latter shall be invoiced for payment of Ozon services. The remuneration of Ozon for the services provided by this section is included in the total remuneration for all services rendered.

### 5. LIABILITY OF THE PARTIES

#### 5.1. Liability of the Seller

The Seller warrants that any posted materials, including Advertising Materials, have been checked by the Seller and comply with the applicable laws, are accurate and do not violate the rights and legitimate interests of third parties, in particular, intellectual property rights, do not contain illegal borrowing of other people's copyright and related rights, do not violate the legislation on personal data.

If the Advertising Materials contain images and data of people or objects, for the use of which it is necessary to obtain appropriate permissions, the Seller warrants that it has obtained such permissions, including the consent of individuals to:

(a) the disclosure and use of their images,

(b) the processing of their personal data,

Ozon and/or a third party engaged by it.

In case of breach of warranty, the Seller undertakes to settle possible claims of third parties independently and at its own expense, and if Ozon will be held liable in any way, the Seller undertakes to provide Ozon immediately upon Ozon's request with all necessary and requested information regarding the said claims, and the Seller also assumes compensation for property losses incurred or inevitably to be incurred by Ozon in the future.

The amount of property losses is recognized as equal to:

- the amount of claims of the relevant state authority and/or third party, including fines, penalties, and

- the amount of legal expenses that Ozon will incur in connection with the claims and lawsuits.

Upon Ozon's request, the Seller shall within 2 days provide documents confirming the accuracy of the information contained in the Advertising Materials and any other materials, as well as all necessary documents, permits and certificates confirming the Seller’s rights to use the results of intellectual activity and means of individualization contained in the Advertising Materials.

In case the placement of the Advertising Material is canceled due to the fault or at the request of the Seller less than 10 calendar days before the agreed date of placement, the Seller shall pay the cost of the service in full.

#### 5.2. Compensation for Ozon's damages

If Ozon receives third-party claims related to violation of their rights, appeals of state authorities in connection with placement of information under the Contract, the Seller shall indemnify for losses, costs, expenses incurred by Ozon, unless It happened through the fault of the Seller.

#### 5.3. Ozon’s distributor of advertisement obligations

In accordance with the requirements of Article 18.1. of the Federal Law “On Advertising” on providing information on advertising placed on the Internet to Roskomnadzor through the Advertising Data Operator (ADO), Ozon, within the framework of fulfillment of obligations under the Contract, transmits information on the Seller's advertising through the ADO, and the Seller ensures that Ozon provides all necessary information on the Seller's advertising.

The list of advertising information to be transferred to Roskomnadzor via ADO is defined in the Order of the Government of the Russian Federation No. 1362-р dated May 30, 2022.

ADO means the owner of a program for electronic computing machines designed to establish the fact of the distribution of advertising on the information and telecommunications network “Internet”, authorized by Roskomnadzor to keep records of advertising on the information and telecommunications network “Internet” and to provide information to Roskomnadzor.

As part of the “Star Products” service, the Clients are granted a discount when purchasing the Seller's products, which is compensated to the Seller, and special terms for payment using the Bank’s credit card in accordance with the
[terms of the “Star Products” Loyalty Program](https://finance.ozon.ru/documents/loyalty-stars-rules-24)
 (hereinafter referred to as the «“Star Products” Loyalty Program Terms»).

The cost of the “Star Products” service is indicated in

.

Ozon has the right to suggest the Seller to participate in the “Star Products” Loyalty Program by activating the “Star Products” service with a trial period in accordance with the “Star Products” Loyalty Program Terms and by sending a corresponding Notice. Upon expiration of the trial period, the Seller acknowledges that the “Star Products” service is considered activated in full compliance with the “Star Products” Loyalty Program Terms and

.
