## SECTION “PERSONAL ACCOUNT”

### 1. Information About the Seller

The Seller shall specify in its PA its trade name in accordance with the requirements of the effective laws, including the trade name that does not mislead with regard to the PA's belonging to a specific party.

### 2. Registration and authentication using Ozon ID

When registering in the PA or in already existing PA, the Seller links Ozon ID when authorizing in the PA, and Ozon authenticates the Seller using a one-time password to the phone number and/or email linked to Ozon ID, certifying the Seller’s right to access the PA. By linking Ozon ID to the PA, the Seller undertakes to comply with the
[Terms of Use of Ozon ID](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/terms-of-use/site/ozon-id-terms/)
.

The Seller shall take all necessary measures to ensure the confidentiality of Ozon ID and not provide access to the PA and Ozon ID to third parties, except when these parties act on behalf of the Seller (the Seller is responsible for the actions of such third parties as for his own).

### 3. Access reset by the Seller

If the Seller has any doubts about the security of Ozon ID or the password or the possibility of its unauthorized use by third parties, the Seller should immediately notify the Support Service (via the PA or by contacting it).

### 4. Access reset by Ozon

If Ozon has any suspicions about use of the Seller's PA by a third party or by malicious software, Ozon may unilaterally reset the Seller's password of the PA and/or terminate access to the PA using the linked Ozon ID. The Seller may link new Ozon ID to the PA only during personal contact with the Support Service and identification of the Seller.

### 5. Filling orders placed

Unless it is contrary to the law, the Parties shall ensure filling all orders placed but not completed and shall continue to communicate with each other or with the Clients in respect of such orders upon the Contract cancellation date.

### 6. PA deletion after the Contract termination

Upon completion of all actions in respect of the orders previously placed, Ozon shall delete the PA and all information about the Seller's products from the Platform without the possibility of recovery.

### 7. PA Deactivation right

With a prior Notice, Ozon has the right to deactivate the Seller's Personal Account (suspend the provision of the Services) in case of violation of any term of this Contract, as well as if the Seller has activated two and more Personal Accounts and if the range of available products in the Seller's Personal Accounts coincides.

Ozon will deactivate all Personal Accounts except one at the Seller's choice. If the Seller fails to provide information about the Personal Account that should be left activated within 1 business day from the date of the Notice, Ozon will keep activated the Personal Account to which the Contract with the earliest date of conclusion is linked.

### 8. Ozon’s Actions in the PA

Ozon, represented by its employees and other authorized persons, has the right to perform all actions in the Seller's Personal Account necessary to test new services or functionality of the Platform, as well as to resolve the Seller's requests to the Support Service, which the Parties consider performed on the instruction of the Seller.

### 9. Separate PAs for Websites

If the Seller's products are to be sold on several Websites (for example,
[http://www.ozon.ru](http://www.ozon.ru/)
 and
[http://www.ozon.by](http://www.ozon.by/)
 or
[http://www.ozon.ru](http://www.ozon.ru/)
 and
[http://www.ozon.kz](http://www.ozon.kz/)
), the Seller undertakes, if necessary, to create separate Personal Accounts for each of the specified Websites.

### 10. Integration into Personal Account via Ozon Seller API

The Seller can use the tool for integrating his accounting system with the PA via Ozon Seller API. Through integration via Ozon Seller API, the Seller can upload, update and receive Product data. Terms of integration via Ozon Seller API are contained in the
[Ozon Seller API Documentation](https://docs.ozon.ru/api/seller/en/)
.

The Parties acknowledge that when integrating via Ozon Seller API, the data reflected in the Ozon system take precedence over the data reflected in the Seller's system.

### 11. Electronic signature in the PA

Simple electronic signature (SES) means a digital signature, which by use of codes, passwords or other tools, confirms that an electronic document has been drawn up by the Seller or by Ozon, performing actions in the PA.

SES key means a unique sequence of symbols intended for creation of the electronic signature. In respect of SES, codes, passwords and other tools or a combination thereof, play the role of the SES key. SES is created by the Seller in Ozon information system when confirming actions in the PA using the SES key: entering a password when the Seller successfully authenticates in the PA or a SMS-code received by the Seller, including when the Seller authenticates via Ozon ID. The Seller shall keep confidential the SES key.

The Seller’s actions in the PA are performed by drawing up an electronic document in Ozon information systems. Such electronic documents (files, electronic protocols, logs, program codes and other information in electronic form):

- are deemed signed by the Seller using SES;

- are equivalent to the paper documents signed by the Seller’s own hand;

- have legal consequences similar to handwritten signatures in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.

The Parties have agreed on the distribution of the burden of proof in disputes about SES:

- in respect of the presence or authenticity of the SES, the burden of proof is on the Party, which does not agree on the presence or authenticity of the SES;

- in respect of the fact of amendments in the electronic document, the burden of proof is on the Party that asserts this fact;

- in respect of the fact of receipt by one of the Parties of the electronic message signed by SES, the burden of proof is on the Party challenging this fact.

## SECTION “PRODUCT DESCRIPTION PAGE”

### 1. Product Description Page creation

The Seller shall independently create a new Product Description Page in his PA or adds its own price offer to the existing Product Description Page. The Seller has the right to establish a ban on copying and/or duplication by other Sellers. The Platform imposes limits on creating and/or modifying Product Description Pages as established in the PA. The Seller shall be solely responsible for the accuracy of all information provided in the Product Description Page. If Ozon is held liable due to the provision of inaccurate information, the Seller shall indemnify Ozon for any resulting losses.

#### 1.2. General terms of use of services of generation and/or processing of materials

Ozon for a fee provides the Seller with access to the services of generation and/or processing of materials in the Seller’s Personal Account for use in the Product Description Page (hereinafter referred to as the “Generation Services”):

(a) to the service of image editing using artificial intelligence technologies (hereinafter referred to as the “Photo editor”);

(b) to the service of generating of annotations on the Product Description Page using artificial intelligence technologies (hereinafter referred to as the “OzonGenerator”).

The Seller shall pay for the provision of access to the Generation Services in the amount set forth in the Fees and Tariffs Section.

The generation results obtained as a result of accessing the Generation Services may be used by the Seller only on the Platform.

When uploading any source materials (images, pictures, photos, videos, etc.) to the Generation Services, the Seller warrants that the Seller complies with the requirements specified in the clause “Rights of third parties”, “Intellectual property rights (IPRs)”, compliance with the
[User-Generated Content Policy for Ozon Resources](https://seller-edu.ozon.ru/policies/rules/ugc_policy)
, and
[Standard clauses](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/partners/standard-clauses/)
 when using the Generation Services.

The Seller independently checks the result of generation before uploading it to the Product Description Page.

Access to the Generation Services does not constitute Ozon's approval of the Seller's use of materials generated as a result of the Generation Services and confirmation of the legality of their use. The Seller is solely responsible for possible infringement of third party rights when using any materials generated by the Generation Services. Ozon does not guarantee to the Seller that the Seller will not infringe intellectual or other rights of third parties when using materials generated as a result of the Generation Services.

[The General Terms of Use of Ozon Generation Services](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/terms-of-use/site/ozon-generation/)
 also apply to the relationship regarding the use of the Generation Services, to the extent that they do not contradict the Contract.

#### 1.3. Grouping into a single Product Description Page

Goods of the same model, category and brand, but with different characteristics (hereinafter referred to as a "Group"), may be combined into a single product description page. When creating a Group, any actions aimed at manipulating customer behavior, misleading Clients, or abusing rights for the purpose of obtaining an unjustified benefit are prohibited. Violations of the contract and grouping rules include, but are not limited to, creating a Group consisting of products with:

(a) different models;

(b) different categories;

(c) different brands.

### 2. Responsibility for Product Description Page information

The Seller is responsible for the completeness and compliance of the information in the Product Description Page with the requirements of the law and the Contract.

The Seller should keep up to date any information about the Product, its range, and price which is provided on the Product Description Page. If a Product Description Page contains inaccurate information, the Seller shall assume any and all negative consequences that may arise in this regard, including when calculating the amount of Ozon's Remuneration based on inaccurate data.

The Seller is prohibited from placing information (including images) on the Product Description Page:

(a) not directly related to the Product and/or its description;

(b) distribution of which is prohibited in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and/or the Country of destination;

(c) for the distribution of which administrative or criminal liability is established in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and/or the Country of destination;

(d) containing (including but not limited to): public calls for terrorist activities or justification of terrorism; extremist materials; propaganda or scenes of pornography, violence and cruelty; foul language; information discrediting certain categories of persons on various grounds, including attitudes towards religion, place of residence, in connection with their political convictions, as well as other information prohibited by the
[User Content Policy](https://seller-edu.ozon.ru/policies/rules/ugc_policy)
;

(e) containing phone numbers, messenger accounts, email addresses, links to third-party Internet resources.

(f) infringing the intellectual property rights of third parties (IRPs).

The information specified in the clauses above is considered prohibited content.

Re-creating a PDP using content that infringes third-party IPR is prohibited if a previous Seller's PDP using the same IPR was blocked in accordance with Section 11, "Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)" of the "Representations and Warranties" Section. By re-creating and posting such a PDP, the Seller represents and warrants to Ozon that all disputes with the Rightsholder are resolved and that the publication of the PDP does not infringe third-party rights.

Photos / images (hereinafter referred to as the content) uploaded by the Seller to the Product Description Page may be automatically checked for coincidence with content previously posted in the Product Description Pages of other Sellers. If a coincidence is found, Ozon has the right to reject publication of such content. The Seller has the right to challenge the rejection of publication and provide evidence confirming its rights to the content. After confirmation of the rights, the Seller may re-upload such content to the Product Description Page.

### 3. Message about Product Description Page inconsistency

If any inconsistencies are discovered on any Product Description Page, the Seller should immediately advise Ozon about that indicating such inconsistencies.

### 4. Product Description Page processing

Ozon checks Product Description Pages both at the stage of their creation and after posting on the Platform, and in case of detection of:

(a) insufficient or unreliable information in the Product Description Page, Ozon requires the Seller to make changes (and the Seller is obliged to make such changes immediately).

(b) inconsistency of data in the Product Description Page with the specified categories or attributes, Ozon may independently change the product category, change or supplement the contents of the Product Description Page, incl. attribute values, translation of information. Ozon shall notify the Seller of the changes and additions made, except for cases when in order to improve the product description Ozon has supplemented the Product Description Page with attribute values not filled in by the Seller.

(c) non-compliance of the contents of the Product Description Page with the law or the terms of the Contract, Ozon blocks the Product Description Page on the Platform indicating the reasons and making the product unavailable for order by the Client.

(d) violation of Product Grouping rules, Ozon shall suspend the display of the Group to Clients and send a Notice to the Seller specifying the reasons. In the event of a gross violation of Grouping rules, Ozon reserves the right to impose a fine and suspend the display of all Groups created in the Seller’s PA until the violations are rectified. A gross violation is defined as a repeated violation and/or if the percentage of incorrectly created Groups exceeds 30% of the total number of Groups created by the Seller in the PA.

If Ozon detects in a Product Description Page:

(a) prohibited information as set forth in the "Product Description Page" Section;

(b) a product that is prohibited from sale;

(c) a product that requires confirming documents to be sold but has been posted in a wrong category;

(d) a product that infringes the intellectual property rights of Ozon or third parties,

and subsequently blocks such Product Description Page, and the Seller does not contest the violation in accordance with the procedure established in this clause, Ozon shall be entitled to recover from the Seller a fine in the amount set forth in the
[Fees and Tariffs](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/fines)
 Section.

The Seller may object the blocking of the Product Description Page by providing evidence of the absence of grounds for blocking within 7 days or by deleting prohibited information within 24 hours from the moment the notice of violation is sent.

If it is confirmed that there are no grounds for blocking, Ozon will unblock the Product Description Page within 3 days.

The Seller agrees that Ozon, when checking and making changes to the Product Description Page, may use information from the official websites of manufacturers/official distributors of products.

Ozon charges the Seller a penalty for exceeding of error index in relation to the relevant Order in case of cancellation of the Order on the initiative or fault of the Seller, including if the Client cancels the Order due to the fault of the Seller. The penalty amount is set in the
[Fees and Tariffs Section](/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/fines/)
.

### 5. Product Description Page blocking

Ozon has the right to block the Seller's Product Description Page without prior notice and the Seller's consent in the following cases:

(a) the Product is posted in the wrong category;

(b) the Product has the wrong Product type;

(c) the description is inconsistent with the Product name;

(d) the description does not meet Ozon's requirements;

(e) the image is inconsistent with the Product name;

(f) the image is inconsistent with the specifications stated;

(g) the Product is displayed "in stock" on the Website but the Seller cancels the Product order with the "out of stock" reason;

(h) upon receipt of an appeal from the copyright holder about the violation of his right to a trademark;

(i) upon receipt of information that the Product is counterfeit.

### 6. Product Description Page use

Ozon is entitled, in relation to the Product Description Page and/or any information blocks included therein:

(a) to place on the Platform together with other Sellers' price offers for similar products;

(b) to place on Platform or on third-party resources for advertising and marketing purposes; the cost of such placement shall be additionally determined by Ozon in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Contract;

(c) to place badges or other inscriptions intended for informing consumers;

(d) to independently determine and change the set of characteristics for describing and combining products on the Platform, as well as to determine their location in the Product Description Page;

(e) to change the location of information blocks, to manage the location of content in the Product Description Page without making any changes thereto. Such changes will not affect the content of product information in the Product Description Page.

As part of testing new functionality in the Product Description Page, Ozon has the right to move or hide some information blocks for some Clients, without changing the content and information in the Product Description Page.

### 7. Separate Product Description Pages on the Websites

If the Seller's products are to be sold on several Websites (for example,
[http://www.ozon.ru](http://www.ozon.ru/)
 and
[http://www.ozon.by](http://www.ozon.by/)
 or
[http://www.ozon.ru](http://www.ozon.ru/)
 and
[http://www.ozon.kz](http://www.ozon.kz/)
), the Seller undertakes, if necessary, to create separate Product Description Pages in the PA for each of the specified Websites.

### 8. Hiding of Product Description Page

Based on the overall sales volume on the Platform, Ozon reserves the right to hide low-demand Product Description Pages in order to ensure the quality and relevance of the assortment offered by Sellers. If a Product Description Page fails to meet demand metrics, Ozon shall hide it in accordance with the established procedure. The Seller has the right to restore the Product Description Page to the Platform after it has been hidden, at its own discretion.

Ozon detects duplication of Product Description Pages at the moment of creating a product or updating a product by the Seller in accordance with the rules specified
[here](/zh/products/upload/moderation/errors-with-pdps/)
. In this case Ozon hides the duplicate Product Description Pages with indication of the reasons for hiding. The Seller may correct the characteristics of the Product Description Page and send it for rechecking.

Ozon also has the right to hide Product Description Pages, if the characteristics of this product coincide with the characteristics of the Product Description Page from another Personal Account of the Seller.

## SECTION “REQUIREMENTS FOR GOODS”

### 1. GENERAL PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS

#### 1.1. Compliance with the requirements of the Platform

The Product shall comply with the terms of the Contract, correspond to the description on the Product Description Page and meet Ozon's other requirements in the PA. If the products do not comply with the requirements above, Ozon may suspend the performance of its obligations with regard to such products.

#### 1.2. Product quality

The Product shall be of adequate quality, i.e. they shall be usable for the purposes for which products of the respective type are normally used and the products themselves or their packages shall not be visibly altered, deformed, or broken. Upon Ozon's request submitted through the PA prior to or after the commencement of Product sale, the Seller shall specify in the PA the details of documents confirming the compliance of the products with all mandatory quality requirements (and/or upload copies of such documents), keep the documents in the PA updated (in case of changes).

#### 1.3. Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs)

In respect of all products the Seller shall receive the exclusive right or licenses or other necessary consents or be legally authorized to use of trade names, trademarks, service marks, trade designations, names, images and/or other protected IPRs of third parties. The Seller, at the request of Ozon, before or after the start of the sale of the products, is obliged to provide copies of documents confirming the right to use IPRs, including in the Country of destination.

The Seller guarantees that its provision of the respective documents does not violate any agreements between the Seller and third parties, including confidentiality terms (regarding trade secrets, personal data, etc.), as well as other provisions of applicable laws. The Seller agrees that Ozon may verify accuracy and validity of the provided documents by, including but not limited to, making requests to the persons who issued such documents, are their signatories or indicated in the documents as contact/authorized persons. The Seller also guarantees that Ozon’s communication with the abovementioned persons shall not violate such persons’ rights, and where provided for in applicable laws all consents/permissions for Ozon to communicate with such persons have been obtained.

#### 1.4. Appeal of IP rights holder

If Ozon receives a request from the trademark owner regarding the violation of exclusive rights to products placed by the Seller on the Platform, Ozon requests from the Seller documents confirming its right to sell such products, and the Seller is obliged to provide documents to Ozon within the time limit set by Ozon. Until the documents are provided, Ozon has the right to block the Seller's Product Description Page, making it unavailable for ordering by the Client.

After receiving the documents, Ozon decides on the legality of placing the Seller's products on the Platform for sale. If the products are placed legally, Ozon does not block the Product Description Page and removes the block from the Seller's Product Description Page, if it was block earlier.

The IP rights holder has the right to familiarize himself with the documents provided by the Seller in relation to the disputed products, as well as with the list of Sellers selling products in respect of which the results of intellectual activity and means of individualization to which the IP rights holder has exclusive rights, and the Seller gives its consent to such familiarization.

The Seller agrees that Ozon is also entitled to provide its contact details (e-mail address and/or phone number and/or registration address specified by the Seller when registering on the Platform or in the Personal Account) to the relevant right holder at the latter's reasoned request (sent from the Seller's Personal Account or from the brand's account) to contact the Seller for the purpose of pre-trial settlement of the dispute and / or going to court regarding the violation of exclusive rights. Ozon is not responsible for the transfer of such data to the IP rights holder, their use by the IP rights holder, and does not participate in further interaction between the Seller and the IP rights holder.

If the Seller registers on the Platform as a trademark right holder or its representative, the Seller agrees to the terms of the
[Trademark Holder Agreement](https://seller-edu.ozon.ru/contract-for-sellers/account-brand/contract-for-brands-en)
.

#### 1.5. Submission of documents

The Seller should provide Ozon with confirmation of the Product compliance with the requirements of the legislation and the Contract within 3 (three) calendar days as of the date of sending the request, as well as in case of receiving a request from the copyright holder, confirmation of the legality of placing the products on the Platform.

#### 1.6. Product packing

The Product shall be supplied in containers and/or packing to ensure its safety (and, if necessary, air tightness) during transportation, sorting, handling at the warehouse process, storage, loading into the vehicles and unloading from them in the standard conditions. The Product packing should be intended for the Product weight and should keep it. Products with protruding sharp parts and corners should have protective covers on the relevant parts or should have enduring packing not allowing penetration of sharp elements beyond it.

#### 1.7. Product conformity

The product must comply with mandatory legal requirements, as well as to the extent that various requirements apply to a particular product, including, but not limited to, the following conditions:

(a) Labels: Each product item must have an individual package with easy-to-read labels (in Russian and prominently pasted on the outside of the package) indicating the name of the product, its main characteristics and the date of manufacture;

(b) Customs clearance:  The Product must be legally imported into the territory of the Client's country and the customs clearance stipulated by the EAEU legislation must be carried out for the Product.

If the Shipment or the Product contained therein do not meet the specified requirements and are detained or seized in accordance with the procedure established by the applicable legislation, Ozon shall not be liable to the Seller.

### 2. LIST OF PROHIBITED PRODUCTS

The Seller may not post for sale on the Platform products the sale of which is prohibited or restricted by the laws of the Country of destination remotely, as well as products, the storage and/or delivery of which require a special permit and/or license, and/or compliance with special conditions of delivery and storage of such products, including (without limitation) the products indicated in the
[Section «Products prohibited for sale»](/zh/policies/product-rules-and-documents/product-rules/special-categories/)
.

## SECTION “SERVICE QUALITY INDICATORS”

### 1. Rating assignment

Ozon may assign service quality indicators of the Seller in front of the Client such as the Seller’s price index relative to market prices, order cancellation rate to the total number of orders, expired deliveries due to the Seller’s fault, as well as other indicators and their critical level. Ozon has the right to change indicators and their critical level unilaterally, notifying the Seller.

### 2. Rating change

If the Seller's service quality indicators downgrades, Ozon may set limits on his/her posting of products on the Platform and impose other restrictions on the Platform use. If the Seller's service quality indicators downgrades to critical values, Ozon may suspend performing the obligations under the Contract or terminate the Contract.

### 3. Blocking and restricting access

Ozon has the right to block the Seller's Product Description Pages and restrict his access to the Platform in case of a decrease in service quality indicators. Until the blocking and introduction of restrictions, Ozon sends a notice to the Seller about the need to correct the service quality indicators for 7 (seven) calendar days. After blocking the Product Description Pages and restricting access to the Platform, the Seller has the right to correct the service quality indicators and send Ozon a request to remove the blocking and restrictions.

In case of violation of the terms of the Contract, Ozon has the right to block the Seller’s Product Description Pages and to restrict access to the Platform without prior notice to the Seller.

## SECTION “REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES”

The Seller shall represent and guarantee to Ozon as follows:

### 1. Authenticity of representations

All Representations shall be authentic, valid, accurate, and not misleading as of the date of conclusion of the Contract and during the period of its validity. In case of occurrence of any circumstances which can indicate their unauthenticity, invalidity or inaccuracy, the Seller should immediately advise Ozon thereof. The Parties agree that Ozon relies on the representations and warranties provided by the Seller.

### 2. Compliance with legal requirements

The Seller represents and warrants that the Seller has all the rights and powers necessary to conduct economic activity (legal capacity), as well as the Seller has obtained all the necessary permits from the authorized bodies or organizations to exercise the rights and fulfil the obligations under the Contract.

All documents and information provided prior to the conclusion of the Contract and/or during the validity period of the Contract and / or during the preliminary legal and financial due diligence of the Seller according to Ozon's internal procedures, including due diligence and anti-money laundering procedures (where applicable), were accurate when submitted, valid, accurate and not misleading.

The Seller confirms that he undertakes to comply with the requirements (confirms that he complies with the requirements) of all applicable laws, including laws related to protection of the rights of consumers, anti-money laundering, anti-corruption and anti-bribery, in compliance with sanctions and anti-illegal trade, prohibition of the use of child or forced labor , the proper use of confidential information (including inside information), and also not to take any action that may lead to a violation of such laws, not to facilitate, encourage or induce anyone to participate in such activities.

The Seller agrees that, to control quality of the Platform use, placing and shipping Orders, as well as Seller’s performance of the Contract terms, Ozon may at any time conduct due diligence on the Seller by, including but not limited to, requesting supporting documents (constituent, governing, identity documents, etc.) and information from the Seller, as well as verifying their accuracy and validity. The Seller guarantees that the provision of relevant documents and information does not violate any agreements with third parties, including in terms of the confidentiality of restricted information (information constituting a trade secret, personal data, etc.), as well as the applicable provisions of the current legislation.

The Seller guarantees and confirms the implementation of a sufficient and effective internal control system; measures to detect and prevent the giving of bribes and commercial bribery with the participation and (or) in relation to their employees in the process of carrying out their official duties; legalization of proceeds from crime; violations of applicable sanctions and illegal trade; improper use of confidential information (including insider information).

The Seller represents and warrants that at the time of signing the Contract and in the tax periods during which operations are performed under the Contract, it does not and will not reduce the amount of taxes payable in the Russian Federation (if Russian Federation is the Country of destination) or other Country of destination as a result of misrepresentation of information about the facts of economic life (the totality of such facts); correctly qualifies its tax liabilities arising on the territory of the Russian Federation (if Russian Federation is the Country of destination) or other Country of destination, based on the actual circumstances of the execution of the Contract. The Seller also confirms its agreement with the main provisions of the Ozon anti-corruption and ethical business Policies posted on the Platform and follows them.

These representations and warranties, and other compliance obligations are fully reflected in the
[Anti-Corruption and Regulatory Compliance Clause](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/pravila-prodayoi-i-rekvizity/anticorrupzionnaya-ogovorka/#заверения-и-гарантии/)
 and the
[Standard Clauses](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/partners/standard-clauses/)
, which, by accepting the terms of the Contract, the Seller agrees to and undertakes to follow them.

The Parties agree that the above warranties have material significance for them for execution of the Contract and for performance of their obligations hereunder.

The Seller represents and warrants that at the time of signing the Contract and during the term of the Contract:

(a)    complies with the requirements of the legislation on protection of competition;

(b)    does not commit actions restricting competition.

### 3. Information disclosure

The Seller shall have the organizational, financial, human, and other resources necessary for due performance of the Contract and shall have expressly disclosed all material information about affiliates of the Seller, its financial situation and operation; no other documents or information which could adversely affect Ozon's opinion in assessing the potential risks associated with execution or performance of the Contract exist, and the Seller is not aware of any facts, issues or other circumstances which have not been disclosed in writing to Ozon the disclosure of which could affect Ozon's willingness to enter into the Contract with the Seller.

### 4. Freedom of the Contract

Prior to the Contract execution, the Seller:

(a) has not experienced inequality of bargaining power, and approval of the other content of the terms of the Contract was not substantially hindered;

(b) had a reasonable opportunity to review the terms of the Contract and to participate in determining its terms and conditions by providing its comments concerning the text of the Contract;

(c) has carefully studied the terms and conditions of the Contract and has independently accepted all the terms and conditions of the Contract in their entirety without amendments on the basis of its reasonably understood interests;

(d) was aware of and took into account the legal qualification of the Contract and, upon its conclusion, agreed that the provisions of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation on storage and on liability for loss, shortage or damage to the Seller's property shall not apply to the relations of the Parties.

### 5. Unburdensome nature of the Contract

Neither the entire Contract nor any of its terms:

(a) shall deprive the Seller of the rights normally granted under contracts of this type;

(b) shall not exclude or limit Ozon's liability for violation of the obligations under the Contract; and

(c) shall include terms manifestly burdensome to the Seller.

### 6. No risk of liquidation or insolvency

None of the following events occurred and does not occur on any date during the term of the Contract:

(a) the Seller decides to liquidate itself;

(b) the net assets of the Seller at any time during the term of the Contract are less than the amount of the minimum authorized capital required by the laws of the Seller’s Country (if applicable);

(c) The Seller submits an application for the application of bankruptcy procedures to him or becomes insolvent (bankrupt) or declares a moratorium on the satisfaction of creditors' claims or becomes unable to pay his/her debts;

(d) The Seller submits an application for the appointment of a trustee in bankruptcy, interim trustee, trustee or bankruptcy trustee or agrees to such appointment.

### 7. No obstacles to perform the Contract

Execution or performance of the Contract does not violate and will not result in violation of:

(a) the charter or other corporate or other internal documents of the Seller;

(b) the provisions of any legislative or regulatory acts of the Russian Federation and/or the Seller’s Country;

(c) any orders or decisions that are applicable to the Seller, issued by courts, commercial courts or arbitration or government agencies; or

(d) any terms or conditions of any other agreements or contracts to which the Seller is a party, or such that are binding on the Seller; and will not result in default under any such agreement or contract.

### 8. Compliance of Product with contractual requirements

The Seller confirms that each Product meets all requirements of the laws of the Russian Federation and/or the Seller’s Country and the Contract (to the extent that it is subject to such requirements); and the Seller undertakes to comply with all of Ozon's requirements to the list of the products posted, the quality of their images, the description of the products as well as other requirements in terms of the information provided by the Seller to the Platform via its PA. The Seller shall be obliged to assist Ozon in making checks of products and Product Description Pages for their compliance with the requirements of the laws of the Russian Federation and/or the Seller’s Country and the Contract, as well as to perform Ozon's decisions taken as a result of such checks.

The Seller also confirms that the Seller will use the functional features of the Platform strictly for executing transactions related to the sale of products. The Seller is neither entitled to use the Platform for fraudulent, misleading, profiteering or other mercenary purposes, nor to assume obligations with conscious intention to avoid them.

### 9. Advertising

The Product Description Page, its images and descriptions, advertising and marketing information (including, but not limited to, placement of advertising materials in the order transferred or in the Product packing) have no watermarks, links to the Seller’s website or other resources on the Internet (except for information about the website of the Seller, the manufacturer and/or the importer on the Product itself or on its packing).

### 10. Rights of third parties

The Product Description Pages created by the Seller, information in them as well as other records and information transferred to Ozon in connection with the Contract:

(a) do not violate the legal requirements of the Russian Federation and/or the Seller’s Country, the legitimate interests and rights of third parties (including, without limitation, the intellectual property rights) and are permissible for posting on the Internet; and

(b) do not violate the personal dignity, honor and good name, business reputation, privacy, personal and family secrets, and other intangible benefits; the Seller has duly received (and at the first request of Ozon is prepared to provide) the consent of all third parties to use of the images (including their photographs, works of the fine arts, audiovisual and other similar works in which they are depicted).

### 11. Intellectual property rights (IPRs)

In respect of the Product Description Pages created, their components and/or other records transferred to Ozon in connection with the Contract, the Seller has duly received:

(a) the exclusive right (or license/right to use and permit other persons to use) to any IPRs contained therein;

(b) all necessary consents to use the IPRs without specifying the name of the author and/or other persons who participated in their creation as well as to publish, modify, abridge, and complement, supply them in use with illustrations, a foreword, afterword, comments or any notes; and

(c) all necessary consents to use of trade and other names, trademarks, service marks, trade designations, images and/or other third parties' IPRs protected.

### 12. Claims

The Seller undertakes to address any claims independently and at its own expense:

(a) in respect of the products offered for sale on the Platform (including, among others, any claims in connection with aftersales service of the products) as well as undertakes to compensate Ozon for all documented and reasonable costs, expenses, and losses associated with consideration of such claims by Ozon;

(b) related to damage/loss of property of third parties, which occurred as a result of the transfer of products that do not meet the requirements of the Contract;

(c) in connection with violation of the rights or legitimate interests of third parties (including intellectual property rights) or any Representation. When considering disputes, the Seller should intervene at Ozon's request on its side (without prejudice to Ozon's other rights) and compensate the latter for documented and reasonable damage caused by the proceedings and their consequences;

(d) if Ozon receives claims from the IP rights holder and/or exclusive distributor (hereinafter referred to as the IP rights Holder) about the violation of exclusive rights in connection with the placement of the Product Description Page by the Seller on the Platform, Ozon has the right to block the Page of the relevant Product on the Platform, making it inaccessible for ordering Clients. In case of disagreement with the blocking, the Seller, independently and at his own expense, undertakes to negotiate with the Copyright Holder to settle his claim.

Ozon resumes the provision of services under the Contract in relation to the relevant Product in the event of:

(1) if the Copyright Holder has applied to Ozon with a request to unblock the Seller's Product Description Page;

(2) if the Seller has provided Ozon with the official written consent of the Copyright Holder to unblock the Product Description Page or a court decision confirming that the Seller's placement of the Product Description Pages does not violate the rights of the Copyright Holder of the exclusive right;

(3) if Ozon determines that the information contained in the Product Description Page does not violate the rights of the Copyright Holder.

### 13. Intellectual property

Either party shall retain all intellectual property rights, trademarks and/or other intellectual property (including logos, designs, drawings) which can be used within the Contract (IP Objects). Execution of the Contract may not be interpreted as granting the Seller any licenses and/or rights of use in respect of Ozon's IP Objects. Without Ozon's prior consent, the Seller may not publicly refer to Ozon's trade name (as well as its logo or trademarks). Ozon may publicly refer to the Seller’s trade name (as well as its logo or trademarks) to indicate it as one of the Seller s on the Platform as well as in other circumstances. Either party undertakes not to register the IP Objects similar to the IP Objects of the other party and not to use the information provided about the IP Objects of the other party except in connection with performance of the Contract.

### 14. Parties' assistance

The parties shall provide each other with reasonable assistance in protection of the IP Objects (including by advising each other of all known or suspected falsifications, copying, imitation or other violations of the rights to the IP Objects). At the same time, in order to avoid doubts, only the right holder shall retain the exclusive right to initiate proceedings in respect of the IP Objects owned by it.

## SECTION “CONFIDENTIALITY AND PERSONAL DATA”

### 1. Confidential Information

Confidential information means any information that has become known to the Parties in connection with the Contract, which has commercial value for any of the Parties due to its unknown to third parties, including but not limited to:

- inside information, trade secrets, personal data,

- know-how, intellectual property,

- information about products, deals, customers, price structure, marketing strategy, commercial opportunities, etc.,

- information on the types and prices of products / services, the amount of commissions and other payments under the Contract.

Confidential information under the Contract may be transferred by the Parties to each other both with and without a confidentiality stamp. The Parties may indicate the Confidentiality of the transmitted information in letters, acts of acceptance and transfer of documents, in e-mail, orally or in other ways. The Parties agreed that the Seller's sales volumes under the Contract, sales volumes of each Seller's product, rates in promotion tools are not confidential information.

The Parties undertake:

(1) use Confidential Information only for the purposes of the Contract;

(2) transfer Confidential Information only to those of its employees who need it for the purposes of the Contract, and with whom confidentiality obligations have been signed;

(3) not disclose Confidential Information to third parties without the consent of the transferring Party (except for disclosure to its professional consultants or on the basis of a reasonable request from a government agency);

(4) protect the received Confidential Information from unauthorized access by third parties for 3 (three) years after the termination of the Contract.

Information in the general public domain shall not be considered confidential.

Ozon's Confidential Information may potentially contain insider information of Ozon Group in accordance with the securities and stock exchange laws or the stock exchange rules applicable to such insider information. The Party accepting Ozon's insider information may be subject to the specified securities legislation or the rules of the stock exchange.

If the Seller’s Country is China, the Contractor shall also compile and provide the information about the Seller such as its name, tax identification number, revenue, turnover, remunerations, and other similar financial metrics as a seller of goods on the Platform to a subsidiary of the Contractor operating in China as a representative for the purposes of this clause, for subsequent submission of tax reports by such subsidiary in accordance with requirements of applicable legislation. The disclosure of such information shall not constitute a breach of this Contract and shall not require the Seller’s consent.

### 2. Personal Information

The provisions of the
["Personal Data Clause"](https://docs.ozon.ru/legal/en/partners/standard-clauses/#1-personal-data-clause)
 apply to the relations of the Parties.

### 3. Personal Data of the Clients

In cases where the Seller receives the Clients’ PD from Ozon and / or transfers PD to third parties to organize the delivery of products to the Clients, the Seller is obliged to comply and oblige such third parties to comply with the rules and principles of processing PD of Clients provided by the Federal Law of July 27, 2006 № 152-ФЗ "On personal data" and other applicable regulations, while remaining responsible for the actions / inactions of such third parties in relation to the Clients' PD, as well as:

(a) to destroy or ensure the destruction by third parties of the PD of Clients when the purpose of their processing has been achieved (sale of products to a Client), or when Ozon informs about the absence of grounds for their processing, as well as, upon Ozon's request, to provide evidence of destruction or ensuring the destruction of Clients’ PD by third parties within 5 (five) business days from the date of receipt of such a request;

(b) to provide with the information on the activities of third parties on the processing of PD of the Clients necessary for its control at Ozon’s request within 10 (ten) calendar days from the date of receipt of such request;

(c) immediately (within 24 (twenty-four) hours from the date of discovery) to notify Ozon about the leakage of Clients’ PD and/or other incident with Clients’ PD, as well as to provide detailed information about the leakage and/or other incident at
[pdn@ozon.ru](mailto:pdn@ozon.ru)
.

### 4. Responsibility for violations in the field of personal data of Clients

The Seller is responsible for any possible claims that may arise in connection with a violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation (if Russian Federation is the Country of destination) or other Country of destination on PD, including as a result of the Seller's use of the Seller's PD for purposes other than specified in this section, or due to non-compliance with security and confidentiality requirements and undertakes to compensate Ozon for documented losses of the latter caused by such a violation, including reimbursement of the amounts of possible fines, penalties and compensation that may be presented to Ozon for payment in court or out of court, within 5 (five) business days from the date of receipt of the relevant demand from Ozon.

## SECTION “MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS”

### 1. Communication rules

Unless the Contract expressly provides otherwise, the official correspondence and communication between the Parties, including all messages and/or notices under the Contract, but except for claims of the Seller:

(a) shall be made in the form of electronic messages in Russian or English;

(b) shall be sent via the PA and/or to the Seller's e-mail address specified during registration on the Platform; and

(c) shall be deemed received on the day of sending (if sent from 12:00 a.m. to 08:00 p.m. Moscow time) or on the following day after sending (if sent from 08:00 p.m. to 00:00 a.m. Moscow time).

The Seller shall regularly check its PA and e-mail for new communications. Ozon shall not be liable for any negative consequences stemming from the Seller's untimely familiarization with the notices.

The Seller confirms his consent to receive from Ozon any Notices by e-mail and by the phone number indicated in the PA, including, but not limited to, information and advertising notices about the services and products of Ozon and its group of companies.

### 2. Support Service

Ozon shall provide round-the-clock consulting to the Seller via the PA on any issues related to sale of the products on the Platform. Any verbal request to the Support Service shall be deemed received at the time of its registration by the Support Service.

### 3. Change of addresses and details

The Parties should advise each other of changes in their legal addresses, addresses for return of products by the Clients, details, telephone numbers and email addresses within 1 (one) business day as of the date of changes. Ozon shall update the Seller's details on the Website within 1 business day and the Seller's payment details within 7 calendar days from the receipt of the respective notification.

### 4. Applicable law and dispute resolution

The Contract shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Russian Federation. The Parties will make every effort to resolve any disputes and differences arising between them under the Contract or in connection with it through negotiations. The proper way for the Seller to file a claim to Ozon is to send it in paper form to the legal address specified in the Contract (in the Section “Definitions”). For the avoidance of any doubt, the Seller's claim shall have legally significant consequences (within the meaning of Article 165.1 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation) from the delivery date, which is indicated on the acknowledgement of receipt. The time for consideration of a claim shall be 30 (thirty) calendar days as of the date of receipt. Ozon has the right to request additional information and documents from the Seller. If the requested information is not provided, Ozon has the right to refuse to consider the claim. Any dispute not resolved through negotiations shall be settled at the Arbitrazh court of the city of Moscow.

When considering and resolving claims, as evidence of any actions performed by the Seller in the Personal Account, including integration through Ozon Seller API, or actions of the Parties to perform the Contract, the Parties shall recognize protocols of the Parties' actions and events occurring in connection therewith in the Personal Account, which are recorded by Ozon's technical devices and software. Such protocols, including but not limited to: files, electronic protocols, program codes, logs, Ozon Seller API data and other information in electronic form.

### 5. Third parties

Ozon may engage third parties in the performance of its obligations under the Contract and shall be liable to the Seller for the improper performance of obligations by such third parties. Within the meaning of this clause, the Payment Service Provider is not considered as a third party.

### 6. Assignment

The Seller may not assign and/or otherwise transfer its rights and/or obligations hereunder to third parties without Ozon's prior consent. Ozon may assign and/or otherwise transfer its rights hereunder to any third parties without the Seller's consent.

The Seller hereby grants Ozon consent to the transfer of rights and obligations under the Contract with Ozon to the Platform Aggregator at any time during the term of this Contract.

### 7. Entire Contract

The Contract contains complete and exhaustive terms and conditions regarding its subject matter and supersedes all previous oral or written agreements between the Parties. Ozon does not give or accept any other representations, warranties or obligations, with the exception of those expressly stipulated in the Contract.

### 8. Severability

The invalidity of individual provisions of the Contract does not affect the validity of the remaining provisions of the Contract and the Contract as a whole

### 9. Contract Qualification

The legal relations between Ozon and the Seller are subject to the provisions of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation on the provision of services for a remuneration (Chapter 39), agency relationship (Charter 52) and other legal acts adopted in accordance with them. The Contract is a framework agreement (Art. 429.1). The Contract is not public (Art. 426).

### 10. Testing new services

Ozon reserves the right to test new services or functionality of the Platform.

Ozon places the terms of participation in the testing in the Personal Account or sends to the Seller. By starting to use the new services or functionality, the Seller agrees to participate in the testing and agrees to its terms.

After the Seller starts to use the new services or functionality of the Platform, the terms of participation in the testing are recognized as an integral part of the Contract

### 11. Language of the Contract

This Contract is drawn up in Russian and English. In the event of any inconsistency between the Russian and English versions, the Russian version shall prevail.

Additional services for the special placement of advertising materials have been added (clause 3.9. in the "Advertising services" section). | [Contract for the placement of goods from abroad on OZON.RU (cross-border)_08012021.pdf](https://ir-20.ozonstatic.cn/s3/helppartners/dogovor-kb-08012021.pdf) |

## FBP物流介绍

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp/fulfilment-by-partner.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp/fulfilment-by-partner`

FBP (Fulfillment By
 Partner)是这样一种销售方案——您可以将您的商品存放在Ozon合作伙伴仓库中。

## FBP的优势

![](../../images/f4c5b1c203c959a9.jpeg)

## 工作原理

您定期向Ozon合作伙伴的仓库送货并补充库存，而Ozon和合作伙伴：

- 为您和买家计算配送时间和费用；

- 备货、包装、标记和发货订单；

- 运输订单并更新其状态；

- 通过Ozon的取货点、自助提货柜。

![](../../images/9d5415682b1910b5.jpeg)

## 首次交货

- 选择
[合作伙伴](/fulfillment/fbp/warehouse/)
。

- 请在Ozon个人中心中
[创建交货](/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/supply-work/create-supply/?country=CN)
。

- 如有需要，
[设置配送服务](/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/change-delivery-service/)
以及退货提供商。

> > 对于位于其他国家的仓库，开始合作前需要完成额外步骤。详情请参阅
> [仓库页面](/fulfillment/fbp/warehouse/wbbs/?country=CN)
> 。
>

## 可用的配送服务

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp/logistics/available-services.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp/logistics/available-services`

> > 我们会提前发布配送规则。如果新规尚未生效，请查阅
> [上一版本](/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/partner-delivery-ozon/new-archive/)
> 。
>

在FBP模式下，您需要为每个仓库单独配置配送服务。

如果您在创建首次交货时没有仓库，我们将自动创建一个仓库，并采用该合作伙伴最常用的配送服务。

[了解更多关于配送服务的验证与设置](/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/change-delivery-service/)

配送服务名称由以下部分组成：

- 承运商：CEL、 GUOO、RETS、Ural、Xingyuan、GBS、 DEX；

- 配送速度：Super Express、Express、Economy、Standard、Smart。

| 速度类型 | 从仓库到莫斯科的最长配送时限 |
| --- | --- |
| Super Express | ≤7天 |
| Express | ≤14天 |
| Standard | ≤19天 |
| Economy | 对于Small和Premium Small分组：≤ 24天；

 对于Extra Small、Budget、Big和Premium Big分组：≤ 29天 |

我们将为所选配送服务开通12种配送方式：6种用于配送至取货点，6种用于快递配送。每种方式均适用于配送特定重量和价格区间的货件分组。

用于广州、香港和阿联酋的仓库，可选的配送方式数量将会更少。

部分配送服务支持配送至独联体国家。在此情况下，将添加发往独联体国家的配送方式。

并非所有商品类目都支持配送。

[关于禁售商品的更多信息](/policies/product-rules-and-documents/product-rules/special-categories/?country=CN)

### Smart速度

为了让系统能够根据货件内商品的重量和价格自动选择配送速度类型，请选择Smart速度。

如果货件中的商品符合以下条件：

- 重量轻且价格高，则系统会应用最快的配送方式；

- 重量大且价格不高，则系统会应用价格较低的配送方式，但配送时间可能更长。

对于其余的商品，将采用标准的配送速度和费用。

速度的选择基于卖家的偏好设置数据。

## 货件分组

货件会根据其内所有商品的总重量和总价格被划分为不同的分组：Extra Small、Small、Budget、Big、Premium Small和Premium Big。配送费用取决于货件所属的分组。

![](../../../images/dfd520d01274de34.png)

**示例**

您的货件中有一件小型商品，重量为300克，价格为1300卢布。您选择了Ural FBP Standard 配送服务。系统将判定该包裹属于Extra Small分组，并应用Ural FBP Standard Extra Small配送方式。

**

Super Express货件分组的条件

对于Super Express配送服务，我们将开通三种配送方式：一种适用于Extra Small分组的商品，另外两种适用于其余分组的商品。

>

您可在个人中心
[FBP → 来自合作伙伴仓库的订单](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/postings/crossborder/fbp)
部分跟踪合作伙伴仓库订单。

![](../../images/e8fbd1dc9bc4bbab.png)

[如何设置合作伙伴仓库](/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/add-warehouse/)

## 状态

Ozon为每一笔订单都分配状态。状态可以帮助您了解您的商品处于哪个阶段：

- **等待备货**
——合作伙伴仓库已收到任务并开始为订单备货。

- **正在安排配送**
——合作伙伴仓库已完成订单备货。

- **已准备发运**
——合作伙伴仓库正在等待承运商，以转移订单。

- **已接收至物流**
——承运商已接收订单并将其发送至配送。

- **已到达取货点**
——订单已配送至取货点。

- **可能已收**
——订单已交付给买家。

- **已签收**
——买家没有提出收货争议并取走了订单。

- **已取消**
——订单已取消。

## 找到订单

要查看：

- 所有来自合作仓库的新订单——请转到
**等待备货**
选项卡。

- 仓库中已备货的订单——请转到
**等待发运**
选项卡。

仓库工作人员正在为订单交付给承运商做准备。处理和交付订单最多需要24小时。

- 承运商已收到的货件——请转到
**运输中**
选项卡。合作仓库的商品每天上午10:00（中国时间）被提取。

- 买家拒收的货件——请转到
**具争议**
选项卡。您可以联系买家确认原因：

- 在
**具争议**
选项卡上点击货件编号。

- 在货件页面点击
**联系买家**
。

- 已交付的订单——请转到
**已签收**
选项卡。
已取消的订单——请转到
**已取消**
选项卡。取消原因和它的发起者在
**取消原因**
和
**取消过失方**
列中显示。

![](../../images/e5d9e16a5045f6b7.png)

[物流 → 来自我的仓库的订单 → 已取消](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/postings/crossborder/fbs?tab=cancelled)

•
 订单在运输过程中丢失。 | 如果Ozon找不到订单，您将在取消后的20天内获得订单金额的赔偿。您可以在
[财务 → 商店经济状况 → 赔偿](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/finances/accruals)
标签页上查看补偿状态。 |

**等待备货**
，
**等待登记**
和

时取消订单。 |
| Ozon | • 订单违反了
[合同](/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor/)
的规定。

• 买家在下单后24小时内未提供护照信息。

•
 买家未取货。 | — |

## 销毁受损商品

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/fbp-utilization.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/fbp-utilization`

因FBP合作伙伴在仓库作业、存储或运输过程中操作不当导致受损的商品，视为残次品。

如果商品因FBP合作伙伴原因受损，合作伙伴将：

- 自费销毁此类商品；

- 向卖家支付相应补偿；

- 准备财务报表，并附上已销毁商品清单。

您可以拒绝销毁，并将商品从仓库运出。

## 查看哪些商品已被销毁

FBP合作伙伴会在销毁商品前通知您：

- 通过电子邮件；

- 通过电话；

- 通过个人中心通知。

如需确认沟通渠道，请联系FBP仓库。

## 商品销毁

销毁由FBP合作伙伴或承包商负责：

- 合作伙伴会通知您拟销毁商品，征求您的同意，并协商补偿金额。您可以拒绝销毁，并在30天内与合作伙伴协商将受损商品从FBP仓库运出。如果您未回复合作伙伴的通知，或未在规定期限内将商品运出，商品将被销毁。

- 合作伙伴自行销毁商品，或将商品交由承包商进行销毁。

- 合作伙伴提供包含已销毁商品清单的报告。您可以请求提供销毁过程的照片或视频报告，以及过往期间的销毁报告。

## 补偿已销毁商品

受损并被销毁商品的补偿由FBP合作伙伴支付。Ozon不支付补偿，也不设定补偿金额。

补偿金额取决于商品受损发生的时间：

- 在买家下单之前：补偿金额等同于商品的采购成本。卖家需提供证明商品成本的文件。

- 在买家下单之后：补偿金额等同于卖家在商品卡片中设置的售价。

## FBP 模式下的库存管理

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/stock-report.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/stock-report`

## 查看商品库存

在
[FBP → 库存管理](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/fbo-operations/fbp/stocks-management)
模块中，我们会展示所有在 FBP
 仓库有库存商品的详细信息，帮助您及时决定是否需要运出商品、参加促销活动或设置推广。这有助于降低付费仓储成本，并提升库存周转效率。

库存表格中显示以下内容：

- **货号**
——您数据库中的商品标识符。

- **SKU**
——商品在 Ozon
 系统中的标识符。

- **仓库库存**
——数据更新时间对应的库存件数。报告每天更新一次。我们会在表格顶部显示最后更新时间。系统会通过颜色指示器显示该商品库存中免费与付费存放的比例。

- **免费和付费**
——每个 SKU 在最后一次更新时的免费/付费存放件数。存储天数按每批商品从入库日期开始分别计算。商品按 FIFO
 原则发运——先入库的优先发运。我们会高亮需要重点关注的商品：

**将转为付费**
——在未来 28 天内，至少有 1
 件该商品将转为付费存放。信息以模块最后一次更新时的数据为准。
**很快将转为付费**
——在未来 14 天内，至少有 1
 件该商品将转为付费存放。信息以模块最后一次更新时的数据为准。
**付费存储开始**
——至少有 1
 件该商品开始计费存放的日期，以及距离开始计费的剩余天数。如果该商品至少有一部分库存已经是付费存放，对应单元格将显示“—”。
**商品卡片浏览量**
——近 28 天商品卡片的访问次数。如果浏览量低于该类目同类商品的平均水平，将显示提示“
 浏览量少”。
**从商品卡片浏览到加入购物车的转化率**
——近 28
 天销售与浏览的比值。如果该转化率低于该类目同类商品的平均水平，将显示提示“转化率低”。
**销售量**
——近 28 天的下单件数，以及与前 28
 天相比的销量变化百分比。我们会高亮显示：

销售量下降——红色；
销售量增长——绿色；
销售量无变化——灰色。
**库存卖光前的天数**
——根据近 28
 天平均销售量（IDC）测算，当前库存可维持的天数。对于销售周期较长且为付费存放的商品，我们会建议您进行运出。
**价格指数**
——通过价格指数，您可以了解自己的价格与竞争对手相比对买家的吸引力。

[关于价格指数的更多信息](/ratings/price-index/)
**建议**
——提升库存周转效率、促进销量增长的建议。可能的建议包括：

![](../../../images/dc9a7066c28f4cea.png)
 ——
将商品加入促销活动。适用于转化率较低或价格指数不利的商品。
![](../../../images/650549af8fcba63c.png)
 ——
设置商品推广。适用于浏览量较少的商品。
![](../../../images/afba712f6f84a06c.png)
 ——
创建运出申请。适用于按平均日销售量计算，库存可售天数超过 90
 天的商品。
点击
![](../../../images/40de45f8b91cb170.png)
可打开表格设置，选择报告中需要显示的列。

如需仅查看某一种存储类型的数据，请点击表格上方筛选器中的对应类型。

同一商品可能在选择
**收费**
和
**免费**
类型时都会显示在表格中。这表示该商品部分库存仍处于免费存放期，而另一部分库存的免费天数已结束。

商品支持以下操作：

通过商品名称、货号或 SKU
 搜索；

- 按免费存储期限、浏览量、转化率、价格指数和建议进行筛选。

如需查看商品存储在哪个仓库，请点击目标商品左侧的
![](../../../images/334ccbf6b535b71c.png)
。

如需下载表格，请点击
**以XLSX格式下载**
。下载文件将包含所有商品数据，不应用任何筛选条件。

## 下载库存报告

如需下载报告，请点击
**下载库存报告**
。它可以以XLSX格式为所有仓库下载。

![](../../../images/f3082e57c4510b8a.png)

报告包含：

- **SKU**
——Ozon上的商品标识符。

- **仓库名称**
——商品位于哪个仓库。

- **货号**
——您数据库中的商品标识符。

- **商品名称**
——卡片中的商品名称。

- **可供销售的商品**
——下载报告时Ozon上可供销售的商品数量。

- **预定**
——预定从仓库发运的商品数量。

## 编辑申请

在申请进入“仓库验收中”状态之前，您可以编辑交货申请。

如需编辑申请：

- 在
[FBP → 交货请求](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/fbp-supply/orders)
模块中，点击申请编号。

**商品**
选项卡中，点击

。
![](../../../../images/5a49a810476c78c9.png)

修改商品条目中的数量；
修改货位数量；
删除多余条目。

交货体积将自动重新计算。
点击
**保存**
。
无法修改或删除商品项的原因：

仓库无法在您所选的交货时间接收这么多商品；

- 仓库已经开始接收入库货物，但申请状态尚未更新；

- 您选择的交货时间已经过了。

在您向Ozon合作伙伴仓库发送的每个盒子上都应有独特的标签。

**

仓库标签示例
**

![](../../../../images/82d731b28098e2e1.png)

在确认申请后，请在个人中心下载标签并为盒子粘贴标志：

- 请进入
[FBP→交货请求](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/supply/fbp/create-order)
部分，选择申请并点击
**下载标签**
。

![](../../../../images/9a184f1ee9358d91.webp)

如果
**下载标签**
按键未出现，则说明交货申请中有错误，比如：

条形码包含20个以上字符；

- 条形码与您商店中另一个商品的条形码重复。

如果您无法更正错误，请联系
[客服](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/messenger?channel=SCRM)
。
请打印标签。标签尺寸要求：不小于12×7.5cm。您可以在A4纸上打印标签。
标签为独特标签。不可以将其复制或为其他盒子再次使用。

- 请将标签贴在盒子的最大表面上，条形码不要折到另一边或折进边角中。

请不要在盒子的接缝或开口处粘贴标签——它们可能会受损。

标签应完全位于可见处，以便可以对其进行扫描和阅读。

## 申请状态

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/supply-work/status.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/supply-work/status`

申请位于以下选项卡中：

- **新的**
——尚未登记的申请。其状态为：

**草稿**
——您尚未点击
**创建申请**
。
**等待确认**
——申请已创建并在等待登记。登记可能需要一些时间。
**需要编辑**
 — 仓库因错误拒绝了申请。要查看详细信息，请前往
**错误**
 选项卡并下载SKU详细报告。

[了解更多关于编辑的内容](/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/supply-work/application-cancelled/)
**运输和验收**
——已登记且生成的申请。它们的状态为：

**需要填写数据**
——请输入仓库通行证数据。
**已准备发运**
——申请已生成，仓库已确认申请并等待在您选择的时间接收交货。
**仓库验收中**
——合作伙伴已接收商品并在仓库中进行放置。
**已在“Drop-off”揽收点接收**
 —
 交货已在交货点接收。
**在运往存储仓库的途中**
 —
 交货已离开揽收点，正在运往仓库。
**档案**
——已关闭的申请。其状态：

**已完成**
——商品已发运。Ozon个人中心中的仓库库存将更新。

- **被仓库拒收**
——合作伙伴拒绝了申请。这可能是因为仓库暂时不接收交货、您未交货或者您的账号已被封锁。

- **由卖家取消**
——您取消了交货申请。

## 保税仓库特点

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp/warehouse/bonded-warehouse.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp/warehouse/bonded-warehouse`

保税仓库是一种仓库类型，从此类仓库可以销售商品，但无需在中国交税。

## 增值税退税

您可以为交货至保税仓库的商品办理增值税退税。

在从中国大陆销售时，您可以在将商品发运至保税仓库后办理增值税退税。您无需在出口时支付。

如果您从香港销售商品并免征增值税，则可以向保税仓库交货而无需缴纳增值税。

## 送货到保税仓库的条件

在向保税仓库交货时，商品由海关进行检查——这将减少配送时间。

> > 不满足这些条件，将不接受交货。
>

**对卖家的要求**
:

- 企业经营范围有进出口贸易权。

- 已在海关单一窗口完成了相应的备案。

- 企业为一般纳税人。

**随附文件的要求**
:

- 备货商品如果出口涉证涉检，是否满足并能提供相应的证书。

- 备货商品进项取得增值税的专用发票。

- 备货商品有完整的发票、装箱单、合同及报关草单（资料模板可以找各仓客服咨询）。

**对卖家的要求**
:

- 企业经营范围有进出口贸易权;

- 已在海关单一窗口完成了相应的备案;

- 企业为一般纳税人。

**随附文件的要求**
:

- 备货商品如果出口涉证涉检，是否满足并能提供相应的证书;

- 备货商品进项取得增值税的专用发票;

- 备货商品有完整的发票、装箱单、合同及报关草单（资料模板可以找各仓客服咨询）;

- 并经保税区海关确认相应货物符合保税区入区要求;

- 入仓商家提供其所在城市的税务局出口退(免)税备案凭证;

- 入仓商家提供其所在城市税务部门退税需要的海关退税材料明细，俄通收确认该明细与保税区可提供的海关材料相一致。

## 阿联酋保税仓交货条件

有关文件要求及与阿联酋仓库的操作流程，详见
[仓库页面](/fulfillment/fbp/warehouse/wbbs/)
。

## 交货限制

- 单个货件最大重量：29 公斤。

- 单个货件最大尺寸：边长总和 ≤ 310 厘米，长边 ≤ 150 厘米。

- 单个货件最高申报价值：500,000 卢布。

- 允许发送含电池商品。需提供化学品安全说明书（MSDS）。

[查看配送条件详情](/fulfillment/fbp/logistics/available-services/?country=CN#配送至取货点与快递上门的费用)

## 将商品送至仓库

- 与仓库签订合同。

未签署合同的情况下，交货申请不予受理。
创建
[交货申请](/zh/fulfillment/fbp/supplies/supply-work/create-supply)
。
准备交货所需的随货文件，并等待仓库确认。

该文件包对所有公司均为必需，在备货阶段即需提供。
若交货来自其他自由区，请提供办理通行证所需信息——司机及车辆证件。

### 库签订合同所需文件

请准备以下文件的扫描件并发送给仓库：

Trade license——公司在阿联酋或其他国家注册的证明。

- Tax registration card——税务登记证明（类似税号）。

- Memorandum of association——公司设立文件。 中国公司可提供简化版本或其他能证明股东信息的文件。可以接受带水印版本。

- Company bank details card —— 公司银行账户信息。

文件审核通过后，仓库将发送合同供签署。未签署合同将无法提交交货申请。

### 交货随货文件

该文件包在申请通行证时即需要，并将随货物贯穿整个运输流程。

**

公司及所选仓库注册于同一自由区
**

- Delivery note——送货单；

- Delivery advice——发货通知；

- Transfer of ownership——所有权转移文件；

- Invoice——发票（商业发票）。

**

大陆公司（Mainland）
**

- Import customs declaration——进口报关单；

- Invoice——发票；

- Packing list——装箱单；

- Delivery note——送货单；

- Transport manifest——运输单据（通过第三方物流配送时）。

**

公司及所选仓库注册于不同自由区
**

- Delivery note——送货单；

- Delivery advice——发货通知；

- Transfer of ownership——所有权转移文件；

- Invoice——发票；

- Packing list——装箱单；

- Customs declaration——报关单；

- FZ to FZ transfer form——自由区间货物转移文件（海关）。

自由区之间的运输需随附海关转运申报单（FZ Transit）。

货物流转需在双方自由区的 e-clearance 系统中完成登记。

### 办理入区通行证所需文件

> > 若交货与仓库位于同一自由区，您可跳过此步骤。
>

通行证由仓库统一办理，但前提是卖家已提交完整文件。

在提交通行证申请时，货物、车辆及司机的全部文件必须齐备。

请准备：

- 司机的 Emirates ID（EID）；

- 驾驶证；

- 车辆登记文件（vehicle registration）；

- 完整的随货文件包——用于办理通行证及后续交货。

若无有效通行证，车辆将被禁止进入仓库所在的自由区。

### 库签订合同所需文件

- Business license；

- Company bank details card — 公司银行账户信息；

- Company owners ID — 非必须。

文件审核通过后，仓库将发送合同供签署。未签署合同将无法提交交货申请。

### 交货随货文件

- Invoice——发票；

- Packing list——装箱单。

### 办理入区通行证所需文件

入库信息需在交货前与仓库协商确认。

### 通用建议

- 所有文件必须使用英文填写，不接受俄文信息；

- 提交带签字和盖章的 PDF 扫描件；

- 发票中必须标注所有商品的 HS 编码；

- 每次交货仅允许使用 1 份发票；

- 请确保文件中的信息与交货申请一致；

- 货物到达前提交完整文件进行预审；

- 在交货完成前妥善保存电子版和纸质版文件。

### 常见错误及避免方式

| **错误** | **后果** | **如何避免** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 未提交完整文件即申请通行证 | 车辆禁止进入仓库所在的自由区 | 提前准备车辆、司机和货物的所有文件 |
| 发票中未填写 HS 编码 | 海关检查延误，无法办理通行证 | 所有发票中均填写 HS 编码 |
| 发票与送货单（delivery note）信息不一致 | 验收被拒 | 上传文件前核对数量和 SKU |
| 所有权转移文件（transfer of ownership）未签字 | 交货流程无法完成 | 发运前由双方完成签字 |

## 部分赔偿

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/partial-compensation.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/partial-compensation`

部分赔偿时，买家将获得部分款项，商品留在买家处。这样可以减少因细微瑕疵导致的退货，并降低商品退回您仓库以及重新寄送给其他买家的物流费用。

## 赔偿机制

买家创建退货申请后，您可以在一天内选择退还部分款项。如果申请未通过预审核，退款决定可由Ozon做出。

[关于处理客户退货的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/process-requests)

处理申请时，请注明赔偿金额。赔偿金额必须至少比商品价格低1卢布。您可以使用推荐赔偿比例，在该比例下，大多数买家会接受部分赔偿，而不寄回退货商品。如果由我们对申请做出决定，我们会使用相同的推荐比例。

买家可以在3天内：

- 接受赔偿——我们将向买家支付款项并关闭申请。
拒绝赔偿或未回复提议——您必须做出其他决定：提出更高金额的赔偿、批准退货，或全额退款且无需退货。

[关于可能的决定的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/process-requests/#做出决定)

每个申请您最多可提出两次部分赔偿。

## 部分赔偿后的退货

即使已获得部分赔偿，只要满足买家退货条件和期限，买家仍可提交退货申请。

[买家帮助中心中关于退货条件和期限的更多信息](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/otmena-i-vozvrat-zakaza/usloviya-i-sroki-vozvrata/)

在新申请中无法提出部分赔偿。退款获批后，买家将收到扣除部分赔偿金额后的剩余款项。

[详情请参见《部分赔偿》培训课程](https://global-university.ozon.ru/program/1003050)

---

## 处理退货申请

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/process-requests.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/process-requests`

退货时，买家填写申请，说明退货原因并附上商品照片。申请会提交预审核，预审核后，退货决定可由以下一方做出：

- 由您做出——若申请不属于Ozon预审核标准范围。您可以在一天内做出决定，自申请创建时起算。

- 由Ozon做出——若出现以下情况：

按下单日期的兑换率计算，商品价格低于1800卢布。

[关于兑换率的更多信息](/zh/accounting/receiving-payments/conversion-rate/)
申请创建已超过24小时，但您尚未对其做出决定。
商品在配送过程中损坏。
您已将退货申请的审核委托给Ozon审核员。
买家此前曾成功对您拒绝退货的决定提出异议。

## 做出决定

如果申请中买家提供的信息不足，请在聊天中联系买家——审核期限将延长至三天。

您可以：

提出部分赔偿——您退还部分款项，商品留在买家处。

[关于部分赔偿的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/partial-compensation)

- 批准退货——买家将商品退回取货点或您的仓库，具体取决于您在个人中心中的设置和物流能力。

[关于设置的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/where-send-returns/)

- 拒绝申请——您拒绝退货，并详细说明原因。买家可以在5天内提出争议，或根据您的意见重新创建申请。

[关于争议的更多信息](#争议)

- 全额退款且无需退货——款项退还给买家，商品留在买家处。例如，在商品损坏且无法修复的情况下。

## 由Ozon做出决定

审核申请后，Ozon可以：

- 向买家提出部分赔偿；

- 批准退货；

- 拒绝退货。

您可以在
**[退货 → 退货和取消](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/returns/main?tab=20&sort=StatusDate&sortingType=Desc)**
部分查看Ozon对申请的决定。

### 给买家的部分赔偿

Ozon致力于将您的退货成本降至最低，并向买家提出部分赔偿，以代替实物退货。这样，买家将保留商品，换取部分款项。

[关于部分赔偿的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/partial-compensation)

### 批准退货

如果买家经常退货，我们将在商品退回后才做出退款决定。这样可以确认商品质量以及是否满足退货条件。

退货可按以下方式批准：

- 无需寄回商品，前提是满足以下条件：

按订单创建日期的兑换率计算，您个人中心中的商品价格低于1800卢布。
该商品不可使用“通过WHD发送退货”方式。

[关于“通过WHD发送退货”方式的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/where-send-returns/#通过whd仓库发送退货)
需寄回商品，前提是满足以下条件：

申请和商品符合退货条件和期限。

[关于客户退货条件和期限的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/time-conditions)
价格高于500卢布的商品可使用“通过WHD发送退货”方式，或您个人中心中的商品价格按订单创建日期的兑换率计算高于1800卢布。

[关于“通过WHD发送退货”方式的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/where-send-returns/#通过whd仓库发送退货)
[关于买家寄出后退货物流的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/where-send-returns/)

### 拒绝退货

如果买家的申请不符合退货条件，我们将拒绝该申请。例如，商品质量合格但有使用痕迹。

## 查看申请

您可以在以下位置查看新申请：

在
**[退货 → 退货和取消 → 申请](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/returns/main?tab=20&sort=StatusDate&sortingType=Desc)**
部分。如果您没有待审核的申请，将不会显示
**申请**
标签页。

- 在个人中心主页的“realFBS退货和取消”模块中。
![main-return-request-rFBS-zh](../../../images/d8f1d2750af40bbd.png)

在Ozon Seller应用的通知和您的电子邮件中。

## 争议

您可以在任何退货方式下拒绝退货申请。如果买家不同意您的拒绝，可以在您做出决定后5天内提出争议。

我们将查看照片以及与买家的聊天记录，并在3天内做出决定。如果决定对您有利，我们将拒绝买家的申请，款项将保留在您处。如果决定对买家有利，我们将批准退货或向买家退款。

按约定将商品退回您的仓库时，可能会出现其他争议：

| 情况 | 争议发起方 | 可能的解决方案 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 您已与买家约定实物退货，且商品在途中已超过14天。 | 买家 | 我们将向配送服务核实退货状态。如果已收到商品，我们将退款；如果未收到，我们将拒绝申请或延长“在途中”状态。 |
| 您已与买家约定实物退货，且商品在途中已超过31天。 | Ozon | 我们将向配送服务核实退货状态。如果已收到商品，我们将退款；如果未收到，我们将拒绝申请或延长“在途中”状态。 |
| 您已与买家约定实物退货并已收到商品，但拒绝退款。 | 买家 | 我们将核实拒绝理由是否充分。如果决定对您有利，款项将保留在您处。如果对您不利，我们将扣除相应款项并转给买家。 |

## 退货期限和条件

* 文件：`markdown/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/time-conditions.md`
* 路径：`/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/customer-returns/time-conditions`

退货期限取决于商品类目和质量。

| 商品类目 | 质量合格商品的退货期限 | 质量不合格或对订单履约提出投诉时的退货期限 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 食品。
宠物饲料。 | 不可退货 | 1天 |
| 数字商品。
具有个别确定属性的商品。 | 不可退货 | 7天 |
| 非连续出版物：图书、小册子、画册、地图出版物、乐谱出版物、单张出版物、日历、折页，以及在技术信息载体上复制的出版物。
个人卫生用品：牙刷、梳子、发夹、卷发器、假发、假发髻。
新年商品：人造圣诞树、电子彩灯串、圣诞树装饰品。
长筒袜、袜子、连裤袜、内衣、睡衣。
医疗器械。 | 7天 | 7天 |
| 其他类目的商品。 | 15天 | 15天 |

## 质量合格商品的退货条件

买家可以在以下情况下退货：

- 商品保持原有外观和消费属性；

- 无使用痕迹；

- 原厂包装未损坏；

- 未在电子产品上安装或激活程序；

- 商品未过保质期；

- 买家退回整套商品，例如两卷本图书须退回全部两卷。

需要加注易燃燃料才能运行的商品，只能在燃料箱或燃料瓶已排空的情况下退货。

## 质量不合格商品的退货条件

买家可以在以下情况下退货：

- 送达的商品、尺寸或颜色有误；

- 商品缺少部件；

- 商品已过保质期或在配送过程中损坏；

- 商品为假货；

- 商品无法使用或运行不稳定。

## 保修期内退货

如果您为非技术复杂商品设定了保修期，其退货期限不少于自送达之日起14天。您可以在商品卡片中注明保修期。

技术复杂商品可适用Ozon保修。对于此类商品，买家可在365天内退货，自送达之日起计算。退货时，我们可能会要求买家提供：

- 授权服务中心或专家出具的结论原件，确认商品缺陷属于生产缺陷且为重大缺陷。

[关于授权服务中心的更多信息](https://docs.ozon.ru/common/otmena-i-vozvrat-zakaza/remont-garantijnuh-tovarov/service-centers/)

- 保修卡原件。

在以下情况下，Ozon或卖家可能会要求买家提供补充照片、视频或问题描述：

- 买家所在地没有服务中心；

- 服务中心不接收商品进行检测或维修；

- 买家提供的退货原因信息不足。

如果在检查补充材料时发现商品不符合退货条件，买家将无法退货。

如果因错误分拣或商品损坏产生争议，请联系
[客服聊天](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/messenger?channel=SCRM)
并提供订单备货视频。

[关于拍摄订单处理过程的更多信息](/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/why-filming/)

## 何时可以联系客服申请赔偿

退货指已取消的订单、未认购商品，以及客户退货本身。

[取消订单、未认购商品和客户退货将送往何处](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/where-send-returns)

> > 如果商品上和商品卡片中都没有条形码（EAN），我们将无法支付赔偿——该规则已写入
> [要约](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor)
> 。
> [关于条形码的更多信息](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/products/upload/barcode-upload#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E6%9D%A1%E5%BD%A2%E7%A0%81%E7%9A%84%E5%8E%9F%E5%9B%A0)
>

如果出现以下情况之一，您可以向
[客服](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/messenger?channel=SCRM)
提交工单：

**

商品损坏
**

请在仓库收到退货后5天内检查退货，或联系退货合作伙伴进行检查。如果通过WHD仓库发送退货时商品损坏，相关信息请参见
**“错误销毁商品”。**

如果您收到退货时原包装或商品已损坏，且买家未收到过商品，请联系
[客服](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/messenger?channel=SCRM)
申请赔偿。如果订单曾交付给买家，则无法获得赔偿。

**

商品短缺或调换
**

请在您于仓库收到退货后、通过WHD仓库发送退货且发生错误销毁时，或将退货转交退货合作伙伴后的5天内检查退货。

您未收到订单中的全部商品，或收到的是其他商品而非您的商品（例如收到的是杯子而不是玩具）

如果货件中的商品不齐全，或者这些并非您的退货，请联系
[客服](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/messenger?channel=SCRM)
申请赔偿。

**

违反退货时限
**

请查看退货状态。如果商品未在下列时限内退回，时限届满后您可以在30天内提交赔偿申请：

- 从卖家所在国境内退回
**卖家仓库**
的退货——自取消之日起60天；

- 从买家所在国境内
**通过WHD仓库**
退回的退货——自登记退货或取消之日起60天；

- 从买家所在国境内退回
**合作伙伴仓库**
的退货——自登记退货或取消之日起60天；

- 对于从加里宁格勒退回的退货，处于“正在运送给您”状态超过150天的包裹视为丢失；对于从雅库特退回的退货，则为超过80天。

已过天数可在个人中心的
**退货 → 退货和取消**
选项卡中查看。

如果商品在上述天数内未到达目的地，请联系
[客服](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/messenger?channel=SCRM)
申请赔偿商品价值。

如果自退货之日起尚未满上述天数，请不要提交工单，也不要重复提交申请。这可能会延长申请的处理时间。

> > 处于
> **“正在运往仓库”**
> 、
> **“在取货点”**
> 、
> **“已由合作伙伴接受”、“已转交给合作伙伴”、“在仓库中”**
> 和
> **“已收货”**
> 状态时——Ozon不认为商品已丢失，因为商品仍在配送途中或已交付给您，并
> **有权拒绝**
> 受理工单
> **。**
> **[退货有哪些状态](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/refunds/returns-3pl)**
>

**

错误销毁商品
**

请在订单转为
**[已销毁](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/analytics/fulfillment-reports/seller-disposes)**
或
**[已核销](https://seller.ozon.ru/app/analytics/fulfillment-reports/seller-disposes)**
状态后30天内检查该订单
**。**

商品的销毁方式未在
[《取消订单、未认购商品和客户退货将送往何处》](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/fbp-rfbs-returns-cancellations/where-send-returns)
一文中说明（其中包括委托卖家销毁5000卢布以下商品及其他情况）。

向客服提交工单后，请等待处理决定，我们会通过右上角💬图标下的通知告知您。

> > **重要提示：**
> 如果您错过提交工单的期限，即使证据齐全，申请也不会被受理。
>

商品备货和拆包的视频。
[视频要求](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/ogl/shipping-from-your-warehouse/video-recording) |
| 未退回部分商品或商品的一部分
（例如您的商品以套装销售——杯子和碟子，而退回的只有碟子） | 问题描述。
商品和包装的照片。请从各个角度拍摄，使每张照片都能清楚看出商品缺少部分。另外还需一张特写照片，其中Ozon标签清晰可辨。
商品备货和拆包的视频。
[视频要求](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/ogl/shipping-from-your-warehouse/video-recording) |

商品备货视频。

## 我们对赔偿工单可以作出哪些处理决定

| **情况** | **可能的解决方案** |
| --- | --- |
| 您未收到全部退货，或收到了不属于您的退货 | • 我们会退还您的商品或赔偿其价值。

• 我们会将您转介至退货合作伙伴——如果退货已交给该合作伙伴，且调换发生在该环节。

重要提示：如果在交接货件时商品卡片中未注明条形码（EAN或OZN），Ozon不赔偿短缺商品的价值。
[关于赔偿的更多信息](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/ogl/dispute/compensation-for-shortage-of-goods) |
| 您收到了损坏的商品 | • 我们将提供全额或部分赔偿——如果理由得到确认。

• 我们将拒绝赔偿——如果订单包装不牢固、不符合Ozon的要求，或者订单曾交付给买家。这也适用于为转售而发往Ozon仓库的退货商品。
[关于订单包装的更多信息](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/order-packaging-requirements)

• 转介至退货合作伙伴——如果损坏发生在配送过程中。 |
| 我们未在退货期限内将退货商品交付给您 | • 我们会退还您的商品或赔偿其价值。

• 我们会将您转介至退货合作伙伴：
如果退货已交给该合作伙伴，且调换发生在该环节；
如果延误发生在该合作伙伴一方。
重要提示：条形码（EAN/OZN）条件同样适用（没有条形码则不支付赔偿）。
[关于赔偿的更多信息](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/ogl/dispute/compensation-for-shortage-of-goods) |

## 赔偿金额是多少

赔偿金额根据
[《赔偿系数确定程序》](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/poryadok-opredeleniya-koefficienta-vozmeshcheniya)
一文中规定的公式计算。

**

商品被取消或退回，随后在退货过程中丢失
**

Ozon向卖家赔偿丢失商品的价值（认定商品丢失的标准见上文“违反退货时限”一节，依据
[要约第5.1.1条](https://global-help.ozon.com/en/contracts-for-sellers/dogovor#5-compensation-for-lost-or-damaged-goods-of-the-seller)
）。赔偿金额的计算方式规定在
[佣金和费率](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/commissions/ozon-fees/returns-expenses)
部分中。

**

商品已交付给客户
**

Ozon不向卖家赔偿已交付给客户、之后又被退回的损坏商品的价值（包括在收货时直接退回的情况）。

如果确认因Ozon的过错，在通过WHD仓库或退货合作伙伴向卖家退货后缺少部分商品或全部商品，则按照合同中的赔偿金额计算公式，并结合下表条件计算赔偿金额：

| **依据** | **情况描述** | **赔偿比例** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 缺少部分商品 | 缺少配件（包括保修卡）、主产品的非重要部分。 | 20% |
| 缺少商品的重要部分 | 缺少主产品的重要部分（商品无损坏）。 | 50% |
| 缺少商品 | 产品完全缺失，收到的是空箱。 | 100% |
| 商品调换 | 收到的不是所订商品（包括其他制造商的类似商品）。 | 100% |

如果具有单独确定属性的定制优质商品（无明显损坏）被退回给卖家，Ozon将按合同中规定的公式计算出的赔偿金额的一半予以赔偿。

对于由快递员或在取货点交付给网站客户、之后由客户直接退回给卖家的被调换商品或缺失商品，Ozon不向卖家赔偿其价值，因为卖家有义务确保网站客户了解订单的组成商品，而网站客户未以相应理由拒绝接收。

**

商品未交付给客户
**

如果卖家不遵守
[包装要求](https://global-help.ozon.com/zh/fulfillment/rfbs/logistic-settings/order-packaging-requirements)
，商品可能会损坏，在这种情况下Ozon不赔偿损坏商品的价值。如果卖家认为不存在违规，则有权按照合同规定的程序和期限提出异议。

如果在遵守包装要求的情况下商品发生损坏，以及缺少部分商品或全部商品，则按照合同中的赔偿金额计算公式，并结合下表条件计算赔偿金额：

| **依据** | **情况描述** | **赔偿比例** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 包装损坏 | 商品的原厂品牌包装存在严重损坏：穿孔、撕裂、包装受潮，缺少部分包装或全部包装，但商品本身未损坏。 | 10% |
| 缺少部分商品 | 缺少配件（包括保修卡）、主产品的非重要部分。 | 20% |
| 商品有轻微损坏 | 商品有使用痕迹、机械损伤（划痕、磨损）、污渍、折痕、裂纹、凹陷、几何形状变形、线缝开裂、图案磨损，以及已激活的笔记本电脑、Apple设备、智能手机、平板电脑、智能手表和智能手环。 | 20% |
| 商品有严重损坏 | 严重缺陷。可以维修后继续使用。 | 50% |
| 缺少商品的重要部分 | 缺少主产品的重要部分。 | 50% |
| 缺少商品 | 产品完全缺失，收到的是空箱。 | 100% |
| 商品调换 | 收到的不是所订商品（包括其他制造商的类似商品）。 | 100% |

商品上的Ozon标签不视为包装损坏。如果卖家的异议仅涉及拉伸膜、玻璃纸/聚乙烯袋或无品牌纸箱，则不提供包装赔偿。

## 如何跟踪赔偿

我们会在

部分显示应计金额。

部分。

## 退货申请状态

### Global退货和取消申请：

| **状态** | **含义** |
| --- | --- |
| **正在运往仓库** | 商品正在运往仓库的途中 |
| **在途中** | 商品正在运往退货合作伙伴，对于取消聚合商——运往正向物流的承运商 |
| **在取货点** | 由正向物流承运商运回的取消订单，或自动退货 |
| **已由合作伙伴接受** | 商品已交给退货合作伙伴 |
| **在仓库中** | 商品已送达仓库 |
| **已核销商品** | 商品丢失 |
| **已销毁** | 商品已核销 |

### WHD退货和取消申请：

| **状态** | **含义** |
| --- | --- |
| **等待发货** | 等待通过仓库（WHD）发货 |
| **正在运往仓库** | 经由仓库（WHD）运送 |
